id: Merasakan anginnya, kau sadar sebentar lagi keluar gua. Sebelum melanjutkan, kalahkan dahulu setan legendaris.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1154_DESCRIPTION
desc: Feeling the wind, you realize you might soon be out of the cave. But before proceeding, you must first defeat a legendary demon.

raw.en: Feeling the wind, you realize you might soon be out of the cave. But before proceeding, you must first defeat a legendary demon.
raw.es: Sientes el viento. La cueva debe terminar pronto. Antes de continuar, tendrás que derrotar a un demonio legendario.
raw.id: Merasakan anginnya, kau sadar sebentar lagi keluar gua. Sebelum melanjutkan, kalahkan dahulu setan legendaris.
raw.pt: Sentindo o vento, você percebe que logo sairá da caverna. Mas antes de continuar, precisa derrotar um demônio lendário.
raw.th: สัมผัสได้ถึงลม คุณตระหนักได้ว่าจะได้ออกจากถ้ำในไม่ช้า แต่ก่อนที่จะได้ทำเช่นนั้น คุณต้องเอาชนะปีศาจในตำนานให้ได้เสียก่อน
raw.vi: Thấy có gió, bạn nhận ra rằng bạn có thể sắp ra khỏi hang. Nhưng trước khi tiếp tục, bạn phải đánh bại một con quỷ huyền thoại trước tiên.

id: Memasuki aula, kau dikelilingi musuh. Kalahkan sebelum maju, seberapa lelahnya dirimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1160_DESCRIPTION
desc: Entering the hall, you're surrounded by enemies. You must defeat them before moving forward, as exhausted as you may be.

raw.en: Entering the hall, you're surrounded by enemies. You must defeat them before moving forward, as exhausted as you may be.
raw.es: Entras al salón y los enemigos te rodean. Por más exhausto que estés, debes derrotarlos antes de poder continuar.
raw.id: Memasuki aula, kau dikelilingi musuh. Kalahkan sebelum maju, seberapa lelahnya dirimu.
raw.pt: Entrando no salão, inimigos te cercam. Você precisa derrotá-los antes de continuar, não importa a exaustão.
raw.th: เข้าไปสู่ห้องโถง, คุณถูกล้อมรอบด้วยศัตรู คุณต้องเอาชนะพวกมันก่อนที่จะมุ่งหน้าต่อไปแม้ว่าจะต้องเหนื่อยสักแค่ไหนก็ตาม
raw.vi: Bước vào trong sảnh, bạn bị kẻ thù bao vây. Bạn phải đánh bại chúng trước khi tiếp tục tiến lên, cho dù bạn có thể kiệt sức.

id: Meninggalkan aula, ada sepasang musuh memanen kekuatan gelap dan terang. Kalahkan anak buahnya sebelum mengalahkan yang dua ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1161_DESCRIPTION
desc: Leaving the hall, you come across a pair of foes harvesting the powers of light and dark. Defeat the minions before taking on these two.

raw.en: Leaving the hall, you come across a pair of foes harvesting the powers of light and dark. Defeat the minions before taking on these two.
raw.es: Dejas el salón y encuentras a dos enemigos que absorben el poder de la luz y la oscuridad. Derrota a los esbirros antes de atacar a los dos guardianes.
raw.id: Meninggalkan aula, ada sepasang musuh memanen kekuatan gelap dan terang. Kalahkan anak buahnya sebelum mengalahkan yang dua ini.
raw.pt: Deixando o salão, você encontra um par de inimigos reunindo os poderes da luz e da sombra. Derrote os capangas antes de enfrentar a dupla.
raw.th: ออกจากห้องโถง คุณมาพบกับศัตรูคู่หนึ่งที่เก็บเกี่ยวอำนาจของแสงและความมืด กำจัดพวกลิ่วล้อก่อนที่จะต่อสู้กับสองคนนี้
raw.vi: Rời khỏi sảnh, bạn đi qua một cặp kẻ thù đang khai thác sức mạnh của ánh sáng và bóng tối. Đánh bại bọn tay sai trước khi đấu với 2 kẻ thù này.

id: Keluar memasuki ruang besar berdekorasi pedang. Jumlah goresan tak terhingga menghiasi tembok dan pilar, menunjukkan intensnya perang di sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1162_DESCRIPTION
desc: You exit into a grand space decorated with swords. The countless scars that adorn the walls and pillars show the intense battle that took place here.

raw.en: You exit into a grand space decorated with swords. The countless scars that adorn the walls and pillars show the intense battle that took place here.
raw.es: Sales y descubres un gran espacio decorado con espadas. Por las incontables cicatrices de los muros te das cuenta de que aquí se libró un gran combate.
raw.id: Keluar memasuki ruang besar berdekorasi pedang. Jumlah goresan tak terhingga menghiasi tembok dan pilar, menunjukkan intensnya perang di sini.
raw.pt: Você sai para um grande espaço decorado com espadas. As incontáveis cicatrizes nas paredes e pilares mostram que houve uma batalha intensa no lugar.
raw.th: คุณออกมาสู่พื้นที่กว้างใหญ่ซึ่งตกแต่งด้วยดาบ ร่องรอยนับไม่ถ้วนที่ถูกทิ้งไว้บนผนังและเสาแสดงให้เห็นถึงการต่อสู้อันรุนแรงที่เกิดขึ้นที่นี่
raw.vi: Bạn thoát vào một không gian rộng lớn được trang trí bằng kiếm. Vô số những vết sẹo tô điểm cho các bức tường và cột cho biết cuộc chiến dữ dội đã diễn ra ở đây.

id: Sepertinya ini halaman. Patung-patung cantik berbaris sederet, kolam berisikan air bersih. Namun musuh masih mengintai di dekat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1163_DESCRIPTION
desc: This seems to be the courtyard. It is lined with beautiful sculptures, and the pond is filled with clean water. However, enemies still lurk nearby.

raw.en: This seems to be the courtyard. It is lined with beautiful sculptures, and the pond is filled with clean water. However, enemies still lurk nearby.
raw.es: Parece ser el patio. Ves varias esculturas hermosas, y el estanque está lleno de agua cristalina. Sin embargo, hay enemigos cerca.
raw.id: Sepertinya ini halaman. Patung-patung cantik berbaris sederet, kolam berisikan air bersih. Namun musuh masih mengintai di dekat.
raw.pt: Esse parece ser o pátio. É enfeitado por belas esculturas, o lago preenchido com água limpa. Porém, os inimigos ainda espreitam.
raw.th: นี่ดูเหมือนน่าจะเป็นสวนด้านหลัง มันเรียงรายไปด้วยประติมากรรมที่สวยงาม และบ่อที่เต็มไปด้วยน้ำสะอาด แต่ศัตรูยังคงแฝงตัวอยู่ใกล้ๆ ในบริเวณนั้น
raw.vi: Đây có vẻ là sân trong. Nó được lót bằng các tác phẩm điêu khắc tuyệt đẹp và chiếc ao chứa đầy nước sạch. Tuy nhiên, kẻ thù vẫn ẩn nấp gần đây.

id: Begitu masuk lagi, mata memandang perapian yang masih menyala. Di dekatnya, dalam ruang remang-remang, ada kursi kulit.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1164_DESCRIPTION
desc: Entering once again inside, your eyes spot a great fireplace glowing red. Nearby, in the dimly lit room, stands a chair made of leather.

raw.en: Entering once again inside, your eyes spot a great fireplace glowing red. Nearby, in the dimly lit room, stands a chair made of leather.
raw.es: Entras otra vez y detectas un gran hogar ardiendo. Cerca, en el cuarto a media luz, hay una silla hecha de cuero.
raw.id: Begitu masuk lagi, mata memandang perapian yang masih menyala. Di dekatnya, dalam ruang remang-remang, ada kursi kulit.
raw.pt: Entrando novamente, seus olhos vêem uma grande lareira brilhando em vermelho. Perto, na sala parcamente iluminada, uma cadeira de couro.
raw.th: กลับเข้าสู่ข้างในอีกครั้ง สายตาของคุณมองเห็นเตาผิงขนาดใหญ่ที่ลุกเป็นไฟสีแดง ใกล้กันนั้น ในห้องที่มีแสงสลัวมีเก้าอี้ที่ทำจากหนังตั้งอยู่
raw.vi: Vào lại bên trong một lần nữa, mắt bạn phát hiện ra một lò sưởi lớn phát sáng đỏ rực rỡ. Gần đó, trong căn phòng được chiếu sáng mờ ảo có một chiếc ghế da ở đó.

id: Keluar memasuki atap kastel. Dewa Zurg bilang seharusnya ada di puncak menara di depan. Namun pahlawan petir memblokir jalan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1165_DESCRIPTION
desc: You exit onto the castle's roof. The god Zurg spoke of should be at the top of the tower ahead. However, a hero of lightning blocks your way.

raw.en: You exit onto the castle's roof. The god Zurg spoke of should be at the top of the tower ahead. However, a hero of lightning blocks your way.
raw.es: Sales al techo del castillo. El dios del que habló Zurg debe estar en la torre que está delante. No obstante, un héroe eléctrico bloquea tu camino.
raw.id: Keluar memasuki atap kastel. Dewa Zurg bilang seharusnya ada di puncak menara di depan. Namun pahlawan petir memblokir jalan.
raw.pt: Você chega ao telhado do castelo. O deus de quem Zurg falou deve estar no topo da torre adiante. Porém, um herói do trovão bloqueia o caminho.
raw.th: คุณออกไปบนหลังคาของปราสาท เทพเจ้าที่เซิร์กพูดถึงน่าจะอยู่ที่ด้านบนของหอคอยที่อยู่ข้างหน้า อย่างไรก็ตามผู้กล้าแห่งสายฟ้าขวางทางคุณอยู่
raw.vi: Bạn thoát ra trên mái lâu đài. Vị thần mà Zurg đã kể ở trên cùng của tòa tháp phía trước. Tuy nhiên, một anh hùng sấm sét chặn đường bạn.

id: Sampai di tangga spiral di dalam menara kastel. Tidak tinggi, tapi penuh musuh. Yang terkuat menunggumu di ujung.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1166_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the spiral staircase inside the tower of the castle. It isn't tall, but it's full of enemies, the strongest awaiting you at the end.

raw.en: You've reached the spiral staircase inside the tower of the castle. It isn't tall, but it's full of enemies, the strongest awaiting you at the end.
raw.es: Llegas a la escalera en espiral que yace dentro de la torre del castillo. No es alta, pero está llena de enemigos. Los más fuertes esperan al final.
raw.id: Sampai di tangga spiral di dalam menara kastel. Tidak tinggi, tapi penuh musuh. Yang terkuat menunggumu di ujung.
raw.pt: Você chegou à escada espiral dentro da torre do castelo. Ela não é alta, mas está cheia de inimigos, o mais poderoso aguardando você ao final.
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงบันไดเวียนด้านในหอคอยของปราสาท มันไม่ได้สูงนัก แต่ก็เต็มไปด้วยศัตรู และที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุดก็รอคุณอยู่ในตอนท้าย
raw.vi: Bạn đã đặt chân đến cầu thang xoắn ốc bên trong tòa tháp của lâu đài. Nó không cao, nhưng đầy kẻ thù, kẻ thù mạnh nhất đang chờ bạn ở cuối.

id: Sepertinya kata-kata Zurg masih mengganggu Tilith. Maju terus, semangati dia, jangan menoleh ke belakang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1200_DESCRIPTION
desc: It seems that Zurg's words are still bothering Tilith. Keep moving forward to bring her spirits back up, never looking back.

raw.en: It seems that Zurg's words are still bothering Tilith. Keep moving forward to bring her spirits back up, never looking back.
raw.es: Parece que Tilith todavía está preocupada por las palabras de Zurg. Sigue avanzando para levantarle la moral. Nunca mires atrás.
raw.id: Sepertinya kata-kata Zurg masih mengganggu Tilith. Maju terus, semangati dia, jangan menoleh ke belakang.
raw.pt: Parece que as palavras de Zurg ainda estão incomodando a Tilith. Continue em frente para reanimá-la, sem olhar para trás.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่าคำพูดของเซิร์กยังคงรบกวนทิลิธ ก้าวต่อไปข้างหน้าเพื่อนำพาจิตวิญญาณของเธอกลับมา ไม่ต้องมองกลับไปข้างหลัง
raw.vi: Dường như những lời nói của Zurg vẫn làm Tilith phiền toái. Hãy tiếp tục tiến về phía trước để xốc lại tinh thần của nàng, đừng bao giờ nhìn lại.

id: Meski suhu naik, moral grupmu tidak terpengaruh. Gabungkan kekuatan dan sasar Dewa Sesat terakhir bersama-sama.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1201_DESCRIPTION
desc: Though the temperature is rising, the morale of your party never wanes. Combine your powers and aim for the last Fallen God together.

raw.en: Though the temperature is rising, the morale of your party never wanes. Combine your powers and aim for the last Fallen God together.
raw.es: Si bien la temperatura está aumentando, la moral de tu equipo nunca decae. Combinen los poderes y ataquen al último Dios caído juntos.
raw.id: Meski suhu naik, moral grupmu tidak terpengaruh. Gabungkan kekuatan dan sasar Dewa Sesat terakhir bersama-sama.
raw.pt: Embora a temperatura esteja subindo, o moral do seu grupo não cai. Combine seus poderes e mirem juntos no último Deus Caído.
raw.th: แม้อุณหภูมิจะเพิ่มขึ้น แต่กำลังใจในปาร์ตี้ของคุณก็ไม่ได้ลดลง รวมพลังของคุณและมุ่งเป้าไปยังเทพมารตนสุดท้ายด้วยกัน
raw.vi: Mặc dù nhiệt độ đang tăng lên, tinh thần nhóm người của ngươi không bao giờ suy yếu. Kết hợp sức mạnh của ngươi cùng với mục tiêu cho Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần cuối cùng.

id: Teriakan gema drake menembus pegunungan, tapi tidak ada musuh untuk ditakuti sekarang. Tembuslah jalanan panas secepat mungkin.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1202_DESCRIPTION
desc: The cries of the drake echo through the mountains, but this is no foe to fear now. Make your way through the scorching path ahead as fast as you can.

raw.en: The cries of the drake echo through the mountains, but this is no foe to fear now. Make your way through the scorching path ahead as fast as you can.
raw.es: Los gritos del draco atraviesan las montañas, pero ya no es un enemigo temible. Avanza por la ardiente senda lo más rápido posible.
raw.id: Teriakan gema drake menembus pegunungan, tapi tidak ada musuh untuk ditakuti sekarang. Tembuslah jalanan panas secepat mungkin.
raw.pt: Os rugidos dos dragões ecoam pelas montanhas, mas não precisamos temê-los agora. Abra caminho pela estrada escaldante adiante o mais rápido que puder.
raw.th: เสียงร้องของมังสะท้อนผ่านภูเขา แต่นี่ไม่ใช่ศัตรูที่จะต้องกลัวแล้วในตอนนี้ เดินทางผ่านเส้นทางที่ลุกไหม้ให้เร็วที่สุดเท่าที่คุณจะทำได้
raw.vi: Tiếng kêu của con vịt vang vọng qua những ngọn núi, nhưng lúc này chẳng có kẻ thù nào để lo sợ. Hãy mở đường xuyên qua lối đi nóng thiêu đốt phía trước nhanh nhất có thể.

id: Seakan menjawab jiwa petarungmu, pejuang kuat menanti di depan. Diselimuti sayap api, dua jago pedang ini penuh energi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1203_DESCRIPTION
desc: As if answering to your fighting spirit, strong warriors await ahead. Enveloped in wings of flames, these two swordsmen are swelling with energy.

raw.en: As if answering to your fighting spirit, strong warriors await ahead. Enveloped in wings of flames, these two swordsmen are swelling with energy.
raw.es: Te esperan guerreros poderosos, como si respondieran a tu espíritu de lucha. Envueltos en alas de fuego, estos dos espadachines rebosan de energía.
raw.id: Seakan menjawab jiwa petarungmu, pejuang kuat menanti di depan. Diselimuti sayap api, dua jago pedang ini penuh energi.
raw.pt: Como se respondessem ao seu espírito de luta, guerreiros poderosos aguardam adiante. Envolvidos em asas de fogo, esses dois espadachins estão cheios de energia.
raw.th: ราวกับตอบรับในจิตวิญญาณการต่อสู้ของคุณ นักรบที่แข็งแกร่งรออยู่ข้างหน้า ห่อหุ้มอยู่ในปีกของเปลวไฟ นักดาบทั้งสองคนนี้ท่วมท้นไปด้วยพลังงาน
raw.vi: Như thể trả lời cho tinh thần chiến đấu của ngươi, các chiến binh mạnh mẽ đang chờ đợi phía trước. Được bao bọc trong đôi cánh lửa, hai kiếm sĩ này đang tràn đầy năng lượng.

id: Bayangan raksasa memblokir jalanmu di puncak pegunungan. Sepertinya tidak ada jalan menembus gunung berapi tanpa konfrontasi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1204_DESCRIPTION
desc: A gigantic shadow blocks your path at the top of the mountain. It seems there is no way to pass through the volcano without a confrontation.

raw.en: A gigantic shadow blocks your path at the top of the mountain. It seems there is no way to pass through the volcano without a confrontation.
raw.es: Una sombra gigante te bloquea el camino en la cima de la montaña. Parece que no hay manera de atravesar el volcán sin un combate.
raw.id: Bayangan raksasa memblokir jalanmu di puncak pegunungan. Sepertinya tidak ada jalan menembus gunung berapi tanpa konfrontasi.
raw.pt: Uma sombra gigantesca bloqueia seu caminho no topo da montanha. Parece que não há forma de passar pelo vulcão sem um confronto.
raw.th: เงาขนาดยักษ์ขวางทางคุณบนยอดเขา ดูเหมือนว่าจะไม่มีทางที่จะผ่านภูเขาไฟไปได้โดยที่ไม่ต้องเผชิญหน้ากับมัน
raw.vi: Bóng tối khổng lồ đã chắn lối đi của ngươi ở trên đỉnh núi. Dường như chẳng có cách nào xuyên qua ngọn núi lửa ngoài việc đương đầu với nó.

id: Sepertinya Tilith memikirkan sesuatu. Jika semua orang bilang: percayai dia, apa yang mungkin salah? Tetap saja mengkhawatirkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1210_DESCRIPTION
desc: It looks like something's on Tilith's mind. If everyone said they trust her, then what could be wrong? It's a tad worrisome.

raw.en: It looks like something's on Tilith's mind. If everyone said they trust her, then what could be wrong? It's a tad worrisome.
raw.es: Parece que Tilith tiene algo en mente. Si todos dijeron que confían en ella, ¿cuál será el problema? Es un poco preocupante.
raw.id: Sepertinya Tilith memikirkan sesuatu. Jika semua orang bilang: percayai dia, apa yang mungkin salah? Tetap saja mengkhawatirkan.
raw.pt: Parece que a Tilith tem algo em mente. Se todos dissessem que confiam nela, o que teria de errado nisso? É um pouco preocupante.
raw.th: ดูเหมือนว่ามีบางสิ่งอยู่ในใจของทิลิธ หากทุกคนบอกว่าไว้วางใจเธอ แล้วมันมีอะไรที่ผิดปกติกันล่ะ? นี่มันน่ากังวลใจเสียจริง
raw.vi: Dường như là có thứ gì đó trong tâm tưởng của Tilith. Nếu tất cả mọi người đều nói họ tin tưởng nàng, thì có gì sai sót đâu? Đấy là một chút lo ngại.

id: Dikejutkan suara langkah kaki, ternyata hanya kepiting kecil. Berjalan di daerah berbatu yang basah oleh ombak, rasanya mudah tergelincir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1211_DESCRIPTION
desc: Surprised by the sounds of footsteps, they turn out to be only small crabs. Walking on the rocky area washed by the waves, you feel like you'll slip.

raw.en: Surprised by the sounds of footsteps, they turn out to be only small crabs. Walking on the rocky area washed by the waves, you feel like you'll slip.
raw.es: Te sorprenden algunas pisadas, pero son solo pequeños cangrejos. Caminas esta área rocosa bañada por el agua y no logras evitar pensar en resbalarte.
raw.id: Dikejutkan suara langkah kaki, ternyata hanya kepiting kecil. Berjalan di daerah berbatu yang basah oleh ombak, rasanya mudah tergelincir.
raw.pt: Surpreendidos por sons de passos eles percebem que foram só pequenos caranguejos. Andando na área rochosa banhada pelas ondas, você sente que vai escorregar.
raw.th: ประหลาดใจโดยเสียงของฝีเท้า แต่ปรากฏว่าพวกมันกลายเป็นปูตัวเล็กๆ กำลังเดินอยู่บนแผ่นหินที่ถูกชะล้างโดยคลื่น คุณรู้สึกเหมือนว่าคุณจะลื่น
raw.vi: Ngạc nhiên bởi tiếng bước chân, họ mới biết đó chỉ là những con cua nhỏ. Bước trên chỗ đá bị những con sóng bào mòn, ngươi cảm thấy như sắp trượt ngã.

id: Suara ombak bergabung dengan nyanyian lagu sihir tentang roh air. Musuh tidak kuat, tapi jangan sampai memperlambatmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1212_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sounds of waves mix with a voice in song. They sing the magical song of a water spirit. The enemy isn't strong, but don't let it slow you down.

raw.en: The sounds of waves mix with a voice in song. They sing the magical song of a water spirit. The enemy isn't strong, but don't let it slow you down.
raw.es: El sonido de las olas se mezcla con una voz. Cantan la mágica melodía de un espíritu acuático. El enemigo no es fuerte, pero no bajes la guardia.
raw.id: Suara ombak bergabung dengan nyanyian lagu sihir tentang roh air. Musuh tidak kuat, tapi jangan sampai memperlambatmu.
raw.pt: Os sons das ondas se misturam com uma voz em uma canção. Elas cantam a canção mágica do espírito da água. O inimigo não é forte, mas não deixe que ele te atrase.
raw.th: เสียงของคลื่นผสมกับเสียงร้องเพลง พวกนั้นร้องเพลงอันมหัศจรรย์เกี่ยวกับจิตวิญญาณของน้ำ ศัตรูไม่แข็งแกร่งนักแต่ก็อย่าได้ประมาท
raw.vi: Những âm thanh của ngọn sóng hòa lẫn với một giọng ca trong bài hát. Họ hát lên bài hát kỳ diệu về linh hồn nước. Kẻ thù không mạnh, nhưng đừng để chúng làm ngươi chậm bước.

id: Mencapai pasir setelah melewati area berbatu. Pahlawan dengan ambisi sebesar laut, dan pahlawan dengan keinginan es, menyerbumu begitu tiba.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1213_DESCRIPTION
desc: You reach the sand after the rocky area. A hero with an ambition as great as the sea, and another with a will of ice, ambush you upon arrival.

raw.en: You reach the sand after the rocky area. A hero with an ambition as great as the sea, and another with a will of ice, ambush you upon arrival.
raw.es: Después de las piedras, llegas a la arena. Un héroe con una ambición grande como el mar y otro con la voluntad del hielo te emboscan al llegar.
raw.id: Mencapai pasir setelah melewati area berbatu. Pahlawan dengan ambisi sebesar laut, dan pahlawan dengan keinginan es, menyerbumu begitu tiba.
raw.pt: Você chega na areia depois da área rochosa. Um herói com uma ambição tão grande quanto o oceano e outro com uma vontade gélida preparam uma emboscada na sua chegada.
raw.th: คุณมาถึงผืนทรายหลังจากพื้นที่ที่เป็นหิน ผู้กล้าที่มีความทะเยอทะยานยิ่งใหญ่ราวกับทะเลและอีกคนที่มีเจตจำนงแห่งน้ำแข็ง ซุ่มโจมตีเมื่อคุณมาถึง
raw.vi: Ngươi sẽ tới được bờ cát đằng sau chỗ đá. Một anh hùng với ước vọng mênh mông như biển, và một kẻ khác với ý chí băng giá, sẽ phục kích ngươi khi đến nơi.

id: Tebing di kejauhan tempat tujuanmu mulai bergerak. Itu ternyata musuhmu, dan tidak ada pilihan selain mengalahkannya agar bisa maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1214_DESCRIPTION
desc: The cliff in the distance you were headed towards begins to move. It was actually your enemy, and you have no choice but to defeat it to move forward.

raw.en: The cliff in the distance you were headed towards begins to move. It was actually your enemy, and you have no choice but to defeat it to move forward.
raw.es: El risco distante al que te dirigías comienza a moverse. De hecho, era tu enemigo y no te queda opción más que derrotarlo.
raw.id: Tebing di kejauhan tempat tujuanmu mulai bergerak. Itu ternyata musuhmu, dan tidak ada pilihan selain mengalahkannya agar bisa maju.
raw.pt: O penhasco para onde você ia ao longe começa a se mover. Na verdade era o seu inimigo e você não tem escolha a não ser derrotá-lo para seguir adiante.
raw.th: หน้าผาในระยะทางไกล ที่คุณกำลังมุ่งหน้าไปเริ่มเคลื่อนไหว อันที่จริงมันเป็นศัตรูของคุณและคุณก็ไม่มีทางเลือก นอกจากกำจัดมันเพื่อเดินหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Vách đá phía xa ngươi đã hướng đến đang bắt đầu di chuyển. Đó thực ra là kẻ thù của ngươi, và ngươi không có lựa chọn nào ngoài việc đánh bại nó để tiến lên phía trước.

id: Kebenaran apa yang disebut-sebut Zurg? Seberapa dapat diandalkan kesaksiannya, imajinasi tetaplah liar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1220_DESCRIPTION
desc: What could be the truth Zurg keeps mentioning? Regardless of how reliable his testimony may be, it still gets the imagination going.

raw.en: What could be the truth Zurg keeps mentioning? Regardless of how reliable his testimony may be, it still gets the imagination going.
raw.es: ¿Cuál puede ser la verdad que Zurg no deja de mencionar? Sin importar lo confiable que sean sus palabras, la mente no deja de maquinar.
raw.id: Kebenaran apa yang disebut-sebut Zurg? Seberapa dapat diandalkan kesaksiannya, imajinasi tetaplah liar.
raw.pt: O que será a verdade que Zurg vive falando? Independente da confiabilidade do relado dele, isso ainda alimenta a imaginação.
raw.th: อะไรคือความจริงที่เซิร์กชอบพูดถึงกันนะ? ไม่ว่าคำพูดนั้นจะเชื่อถือได้มากน้อยแค่ไหน มันก็ยังทำให้ต้องคิดอยู่ดี
raw.vi: Sự thật nào có thể khiến Zurg vẫn cứ nhắc đến? Bất kể lời hắn đáng tin cậy như thế nào đi nữa thì trong đó vẫn có chút ảo mộng.

id: Ibu kota hutan Vriksha. Melihat betapa berbedanya dari Vriksha zaman dahulu, kau penasaran apa yang sebenarnya terjadi pada negara ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1221_DESCRIPTION
desc: The forest capital of Vriksha. Seeing how much it truly differs from the Vriksha of yore, you can't help but wonder what happened to this country.

raw.en: The forest capital of Vriksha. Seeing how much it truly differs from the Vriksha of yore, you can't help but wonder what happened to this country.
raw.es: La capital boscosa de Vriksha. Te percatas de lo mucho que se diferencia de la Vriksha de antaño y no comprendes qué pudo haberle pasado a esta nación.
raw.id: Ibu kota hutan Vriksha. Melihat betapa berbedanya dari Vriksha zaman dahulu, kau penasaran apa yang sebenarnya terjadi pada negara ini.
raw.pt: A floresta capital de Vriksha. Ao ver o tamanho da diferença com a antiga Vriksha, não dá para evitar se perguntar o que aconteceu a esta nação.
raw.th: เมืองหลวงป่าของพฤกษา เมื่อได้เห็นว่าแท้จริงมันแตกต่างจากพฤกษาในสมัยก่อนอย่างไร มันก็ช่วยไม่ได้ที่คุณจะสงสัยว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับประเทศนี้
raw.vi: Trung tâm cánh rừng Vriksha. Chứng kiến biết bao nhiêu khác biệt với Vriksha ngày xưa, ngươi không thể không tự hỏi điều gì đã xảy ra với đất nước này.

id: Aneh, ini jalan yang sama dengan yang kautempuh sebelumnya. Sepertinya hutannya disihir. Temukan sumber mantra dan hapuslah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1222_DESCRIPTION
desc: Strange, this is the same path you took before. It seems that the forest is enchanted. You must find the source of this spell and eliminate it.

raw.en: Strange, this is the same path you took before. It seems that the forest is enchanted. You must find the source of this spell and eliminate it.
raw.es: De alguna manera, este es el mismo camino que ya tomaste. Parece que el bosque está encantado. Tienes que encontrar la fuente del conjuro y destruirla.
raw.id: Aneh, ini jalan yang sama dengan yang kautempuh sebelumnya. Sepertinya hutannya disihir. Temukan sumber mantra dan hapuslah.
raw.pt: Estranho, este é o mesmo caminho que você pegou antes. Parece que a floresta é encantada. Você precisa achar a fonte desta magia para eliminá-la.
raw.th: น่าแปลก นี่เป็นเส้นทางที่คุณเดินผ่านมาก่อนแล้ว ดูเหมือนว่าป่านี้จะต้องมนต์ คุณต้องค้นหาต้นตอของคาถานี้และทำลายมันซะ
raw.vi: Lạ thật, đây giống hệt con đường ngươi đã đi qua trước đó. Dường như cách rừng này đã bị bỏ bùa chú. Ngươi phải tìm ra nguồn gốc bùa chú này và tiêu diệt nó.

id: Keluar ke ruang terbuka bercahaya matahari, burung-burung menjerit. Pahlawan bersenjata dari dunia lain, dan satu dengan tombak sihir, menghadangmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1223_DESCRIPTION
desc: Exiting to an open space lit by the sun, the birds shriek. A hero with a weapon from another world, and another with a magic lance, stand before you.

raw.en: Exiting to an open space lit by the sun, the birds shriek. A hero with a weapon from another world, and another with a magic lance, stand before you.
raw.es: Sales a un área abierta bajo el sol. Los pájaros pían. Un héroe con un arma de otro mundo y otro con una lanza mágica se posan frente a ti.
raw.id: Keluar ke ruang terbuka bercahaya matahari, burung-burung menjerit. Pahlawan bersenjata dari dunia lain, dan satu dengan tombak sihir, menghadangmu.
raw.pt: Ao sair a um espaço aberto iluminado pelo sol, os pássaros guincham. Um herói com uma arma de outro mundo e outro com uma lança mágica estão em seu caminho.
raw.th: ออกไปสู่ที่โล่งที่สว่างจากแสงอาทิตย์และมีเสียงนกร้อง ผู้กล้ากับอาวุธจากโลกอื่น และอีกคนที่มาพร้อมกับหอกวิเศษยืนอยู่เบื้องหน้าคุณ
raw.vi: Thoát khỏi không gian mở được ánh nắng mặt trời chiếu sáng, lũ chim kêu ríu rít. Vị anh hùng với vũ khí từ thế giới khác, và một người khác cầm cây thương ma thuật, đang đứng trước ngươi.

id: Pegunungan dari batu tiba-tiba muncul. Saat kaupikir itu adalah jalan, dia malah terayun ke arahmu. Seperti boneka yang dikontrol sihir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1224_DESCRIPTION
desc: A mountain made of stone suddenly appears before you. Just when you thought it was in your way, it swings at you. It's a puppet controlled by magic!

raw.en: A mountain made of stone suddenly appears before you. Just when you thought it was in your way, it swings at you. It's a puppet controlled by magic!
raw.es: De repente aparece una montaña de piedras. Cuando pensabas que estaba en tu camino, te ataca. ¡Es una marioneta controlada con magia!
raw.id: Pegunungan dari batu tiba-tiba muncul. Saat kaupikir itu adalah jalan, dia malah terayun ke arahmu. Seperti boneka yang dikontrol sihir.
raw.pt: Uma montanha rochosa aparece em sua frente de repente. E quando você pensava que ela estava no seu caminho, ela tenta golpear. É uma marionete controlada por magia!
raw.th: ทันใดนั้นภูเขาที่ทำจากหินก็ปรากฏขึ้นเบื้องหน้าคุณ เพียงเมื่อคุณคิดว่ามันขวางทางคุณอยู่ มันก็โจมตีคุณ มันเป็นหุ่นเชิดที่ควบคุณโดยเวทย์มนต์!
raw.vi: Một ngọn núi bằng đá đột nhiên xuất hiện trước mặt ngươi. Vừa mới nghĩ rằng nó đang cản đường ngươi, nó lại đập vào ngươi. Đó là một con rối được điều khiển bởi phép thuật!

id: Meski Paris kasar terhadap Aula Pemanggil, ada antagonisme tertentu saat ia menatap Grahdens. Pasti ada artinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1230_DESCRIPTION
desc: Though Paris is hostile towards the Summoners' Hall, there's a particular antagonism in the air when she looks at Grahdens. It must mean something.

raw.en: Though Paris is hostile towards the Summoners' Hall, there's a particular antagonism in the air when she looks at Grahdens. It must mean something.
raw.es: Si bien Paris está en contra del Consejo de invocadores, hay un antagonismo particular en el aire cuando mira a Grahdens. Debe significar algo.
raw.id: Meski Paris kasar terhadap Aula Pemanggil, ada antagonisme tertentu saat ia menatap Grahdens. Pasti ada artinya.
raw.pt: Embora Paris não goste do Salão dos Invocadores, há um certo antagonismo no ar quando ela olha para Grahdens. Isso deve significar algo.
raw.th: แม้ว่าปารีสจะไม่เป็นมิตรต่อสภาซัมมอนเนอร์ มันยังมีบรรยากาศมาคุเมื่อไหร่ก็ตามที่เธอจ้องมองไปยังกราห์เดนส์ มันน่าจะมีเรื่องอะไรบางอย่าง
raw.vi: Mặc dù Paris có thái độ thù địch đối với Đại Sảnh Người Triệu Hồi, dường như vẫn có chút gì đó đối lập trong không khí khi nàng quan sát Grahdens. Phải có một chuyện gì đó.

id: Air berwarna merah dan makhluk misterius memantulkan sinarnya. Dari semua tempat yang pernah kaulalui, yang ini paling ngeri. Berhati-hatilah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1231_DESCRIPTION
desc: Water tainted red and a mysterious creature shining light by it. Out of all the places you've been to so far, this one feels the eeriest. Be careful.

raw.en: Water tainted red and a mysterious creature shining light by it. Out of all the places you've been to so far, this one feels the eeriest. Be careful.
raw.es: El agua se tiñó de rojo y una criatura misteriosa le da luz. De todos los lugares que visitaste, este es el más perturbador. Ten cuidado.
raw.id: Air berwarna merah dan makhluk misterius memantulkan sinarnya. Dari semua tempat yang pernah kaulalui, yang ini paling ngeri. Berhati-hatilah.
raw.pt: Há água tingida de vermelho e uma criatura misteriosa emitindo uma luz ao lado. De todos os locais por onde você passou, este é o mais sinistro. Tome cuidado.
raw.th: น้ำที่ปนเปื้อนสีแดงและสิ่งมีชีวิตลึกลับที่ส่องแสงโดยมัน จากทุกสถานที่ที่คุณเคยไปมาก่อน ที่แห่งนี้รู้สึกน่าขยะแขยงที่สุดแล้ว ระวังตัวให้ดี
raw.vi: Nước bị nhiễm đỏ và một sinh vật bí ẩn trở nên lấp lánh dưới ánh nước. Trong tất cả những nơi ngươi đã đặt chân tới cho đến nay, nơi này có cảm giác kỳ quặc nhất. Hãy cẩn thận.

id: Suara menulikan telinga bergabung dengan kilatan halilintar. Burung melayang di angkasa menciptakan kejutan listrik. Tidak hanya satu burung...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1232_DESCRIPTION
desc: A deafening voice combined with the flash of thunder. A bird soars the skies creating electric shocks as it revolves. But it's not just one bird...

raw.en: A deafening voice combined with the flash of thunder. A bird soars the skies creating electric shocks as it revolves. But it's not just one bird...
raw.es: Una voz ensordecedora combinada con un trueno. Un ave traza los cielos y crea choques eléctricos mientras da vueltas. Pero no es solo un ave...
raw.id: Suara menulikan telinga bergabung dengan kilatan halilintar. Burung melayang di angkasa menciptakan kejutan listrik. Tidak hanya satu burung...
raw.pt: Uma voz ensurdecedora combinada com o clarão de um relâmpago. Um pássaro voa pelos céus criando descargas elétricas enquanto passa. Mas não é só um pássaro...
raw.th: เสียงอึกทึกรวมกับสายฟ้าแล่บ นกที่โบยบินอยู่บนท้องฟ้าสร้างไฟฟ้าช็อตขณะที่มันบินวน แต่มันไม่ใช่แค่นกตัวเดียว ...
raw.vi: Một giọng nói chát chúa kết hợp với ánh chớp của sấm sét. Một con chim vọt lên bầu trời tạo nên những cú sốc điện khi nó xoay vòng. Nhưng đó không chỉ là một con chim...

id: Guntur menyambar-nyambar di langit, hujan mulai turun. Dua pahlawan muncul dan menghadang jalanmu. Pertarungan sudah dekat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1233_DESCRIPTION
desc: As the thunder clouds roar in the sky, rain starts to fall. At the same time, two heroes appear and obstruct your path. You sense a fight is imminent.

raw.en: As the thunder clouds roar in the sky, rain starts to fall. At the same time, two heroes appear and obstruct your path. You sense a fight is imminent.
raw.es: Mientras los truenos cubren el cielo, la lluvia empieza a caer. Al mismo tiempo, aparecen dos héroes que obstruyen tu camino. La pelea es inminente.
raw.id: Guntur menyambar-nyambar di langit, hujan mulai turun. Dua pahlawan muncul dan menghadang jalanmu. Pertarungan sudah dekat.
raw.pt: Enquanto as nuvens de tempestade rugem no céu, a chuva começa a cair. Ao mesmo tempo, dois heróis aparecem para obstruir sua passagem. Você sente que uma luta está próxima.
raw.th: ขณะที่เมฆฝนร้องคำรามบนท้องฟ้า ฝนเริ่มตกลงมา ในเวลาเดียวกันผู้กล้าสองคนปรากฏตัวขวางหน้าเส้นทางของคุณ คุณรู้สึกว่ามันจะเป็นการต่อสู้ที่อันตรายมาก
raw.vi: Khi những đám mây lôi điện gầm gừ trên bầu trời, cơn mưa bắt đầu rơi xuống. Cùng lúc, hai vị anh hùng xuất hiện và chắn đường ngươi. Ngươi có cảm giác một cuộc chiến sắp xảy ra.

id: Hujan sudah berhenti dan cahaya menembus awan. Bagai berada di tangga cahaya, malaikat pun turun. Kalahkan dia dan lanjutkan ke Istana Langit.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1234_DESCRIPTION
desc: The rain has ceased and light trickles through the clouds. As if on a staircase of light, an angel descends. Defeat her and proceed to the Sky Palace.

raw.en: The rain has ceased and light trickles through the clouds. As if on a staircase of light, an angel descends. Defeat her and proceed to the Sky Palace.
raw.es: La lluvia ha cesado y se ven luces entre las nubes. Un ángel desciende como si estuviera en una escalera de luz. Derrótalo y ve al Palacio astral.
raw.id: Hujan sudah berhenti dan cahaya menembus awan. Bagai berada di tangga cahaya, malaikat pun turun. Kalahkan dia dan lanjutkan ke Istana Langit.
raw.pt: A chuva para e a luz se espreme entre as nuvens. Como se estivesse em uma escadaria de luz, um anjo desce. Derrote-a e siga para o Palácio Celeste.
raw.th: ฝนได้หยุดลงและแสงก็ส่องผ่านก่อนเมฆราวกับบันไดแห่งแสง ทูตสวรรค์ปรากฏตัวลงมา เอาชนะเธอและมุ่งหน้าไปสู่ปราสาทท้องฟ้า
raw.vi: Cơn mưa đã ngừng hẳn và tia nắng len lỏi xuyên qua các đám mây. Như thể đứng trên bậc thang ánh sáng, một thiên thần đang bước xuống. Hãy đánh bại ả và tiến tới Cung điện bầu trời.

id: Tidak peduli seberapa benar perkataan Zurg, membantunya menghancurkan manusia bukanlah pilihan. Tentu saja kau tidak mau mengkhianati Dewi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1240_DESCRIPTION
desc: No matter how true Zurg's words may be, helping him to destroy humans is not an option. Of course, you wouldn't betray the Goddess anyway.

raw.en: No matter how true Zurg's words may be, helping him to destroy humans is not an option. Of course, you wouldn't betray the Goddess anyway.
raw.es: Sin importar si las palabras de Zurg son verdad, ayudarlo a destruir a los humanos no es una opción. Está claro que tú no traicionarías a la diosa.
raw.id: Tidak peduli seberapa benar perkataan Zurg, membantunya menghancurkan manusia bukanlah pilihan. Tentu saja kau tidak mau mengkhianati Dewi.
raw.pt: Não importa a sinceridade nas palavras de Zurg, ajudá-lo a destruir os humanos não é uma opção. É claro, você não trairia a deusa de qualquer forma.
raw.th: ไม่สำคัญว่าคำพูดของเซิร์กจะเป็นจริงแค่ไหน การช่วยเหลือเขาเพื่อทำลายมนุษย์นั้นไม่ใช่ตัวเลือกเลย แน่นอนยังไงเสียคุณก็ไม่มีทางทรยศเทพธิดาอยู่แล้ว
raw.vi: Cho dù những lời nói của Zurg là sự thật đến mức nào thì việc giúp hắn ta tiêu diệt loài người không phải là một lựa chọn. Dĩ nhiên, dù sao ngươi cũng sẽ không phản bội Nữ thần.

id: Tidak dapat dipercaya bahwa taman indah melayang di udara seperti itu. Sihir macam apa yang ada di sini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1241_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can't believe that such a beautiful garden floats in midair just like that. What sort of magic could be at work here?

raw.en: You can't believe that such a beautiful garden floats in midair just like that. What sort of magic could be at work here?
raw.es: No puedes creer que un jardín hermoso como este flote en el aire como si nada. ¿Qué tipo de magia será esta?
raw.id: Tidak dapat dipercaya bahwa taman indah melayang di udara seperti itu. Sihir macam apa yang ada di sini?
raw.pt: Você não consegue acreditar que um jardim tão lindo esteja flutuando no ar dessa forma. Isso é trabalho de que tipo de magia?
raw.th: คุณไม่อยากจะเชื่อเลยว่าสวนที่สวยงามจะลอยอยู่ในอากาศได้แบบนี้ เวทย์มนต์แบบไหนกันที่ทำให้มันเกิดขึ้นได้?
raw.vi: Ngươi không thể tin rằng một khu vườn xinh đẹp thế lại trôi nổi trong không trung như vậy. Loại phép thuật nào có thể có tác dụng ở đây?

id: Dewi yang bertarung melarangmu maju seakan dia tidak bisa memaafkan orang yang mengganggu tamannya. Namun tidak bisa berhenti sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1242_DESCRIPTION
desc: A fighting goddess forbids you from moving forward, as if she cannot forgive those who disturb her garden. However, there's no stopping now.

raw.en: A fighting goddess forbids you from moving forward, as if she cannot forgive those who disturb her garden. However, there's no stopping now.
raw.es: Una diosa luchadora te prohíbe seguir avanzando. Es como si no pudiera perdonar a los que perturban su jardín. Aun así, detenerse no es una opción.
raw.id: Dewi yang bertarung melarangmu maju seakan dia tidak bisa memaafkan orang yang mengganggu tamannya. Namun tidak bisa berhenti sekarang.
raw.pt: Uma deusa lutadora não permite sua passagem, como se não pudesse perdoar aqueles que incomodam seu jardim. No entanto não tem como parar agora.
raw.th: เทพธิดาแห่งการต่อสู้ห้ามไม่ให้คุณมุ่งหน้าต่อไป ราวกับว่าเธอไม่สามารถให้อภัยผู้ที่มารบกวนสวนของเธอได้ อย่างไรก็ตามมันหยุดไม่ได้แล้วในตอนนี้
raw.vi: Một nữ thần chiến đấu sẽ ngăn không cho ngươi tiến về phía trước, cứ như là nàng ta không thể tha thứ cho những ai quấy phá khu vườn của mình. Tuy nhiên, không được dừng lại lúc này.

id: Sampai ke kastel di pusat taman. Saat menginjakkan kaki, pahlawan memegang pedang suci dan ksatria dengan pedang besar muncul.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1243_DESCRIPTION
desc: You reach the castle at the heart of the garden. When you set foot there, a hero wielding a holy blade and a knight with a great sword appear.

raw.en: You reach the castle at the heart of the garden. When you set foot there, a hero wielding a holy blade and a knight with a great sword appear.
raw.es: Llegas al castillo en el corazón del jardín. Cuando pones tu pie en él, aparecen un héroe con una hoja divina y un caballero con una gran espada.
raw.id: Sampai ke kastel di pusat taman. Saat menginjakkan kaki, pahlawan memegang pedang suci dan ksatria dengan pedang besar muncul.
raw.pt: Você chega ao castelo no coração do jardim. Quando você pisa lá, um herói empunhando uma lâmina sagrada e um cavaleiro com uma grande espada aparecem.
raw.th: คุณมาถึงปราสาทที่อยู่ใจกลางของสวน เมื่อคุณย่ำเท้าไปที่นั่น ผู้กล้าที่กวัดแกว่งดาบศักดิ์สิทธิ์ และอัศวินผู้ใช้ดาบใหญ่ก็ปรากฏตัวขึ้น
raw.vi: Ngươi sẽ đến được tòa lâu đài ở trung tâm khu vườn. Khi ngươi đặt chân đến đó, một vị anh hùng cầm gươm thiêng và một hiệp sĩ với thanh đại kiếm sẽ xuất hiện.

id: Gerbang yang menandai jalan keluar Istana Langit sudah terlihat. Di depannya berdiri raja beast yang pucat dan bersinar. Waktunya bertarung.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1244_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see the gate that marks the exit of the Sky Palace. However, in front of it stands a shiny and pale king of beasts. It's time for battle.

raw.en: You can see the gate that marks the exit of the Sky Palace. However, in front of it stands a shiny and pale king of beasts. It's time for battle.
raw.es: Ves la puerta que simboliza la salida del Palacio astral. No obstante, frente a ella, está el pálido y brillante rey de las bestias. Hora de luchar.
raw.id: Gerbang yang menandai jalan keluar Istana Langit sudah terlihat. Di depannya berdiri raja beast yang pucat dan bersinar. Waktunya bertarung.
raw.pt: Você pode ver o portão que marca a saída do Palácio Celeste. Mas na frente dele está um brilhante e claro rei das feras. Chegou a hora da batalha.
raw.th: คุณสามารถมองเห็นประตูที่เป็นทางออกของปราสาทท้องฟ้า อย่างไรก็ตามข้างหน้านั้นมีราชันแห่งอสูรที่เปล่งประกายส่องสว่างขวางทางคุณอยู่ มันได้เวลาต่อสู้แล้ว
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể nhìn thấy cánh cổng đánh dấu lối ra của Cung điện bầu trời. Tuy nhiên, ở phía trước đó đứng sừng sững một vua quái thú lấp lánh và xanh xao. Đấy là thời khắc bắt đầu trận chiến.

id: Tillith sepertinya sudah merasa lebih baik. Tidak ada yang mengungkit-ungkit perkataan Zurg. Dengan tim bersatu, maju ke Menara Adan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1250_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tilith seems to be feeling better, which is a relief. No one else is hung up on Zurg's words either. With a unified front, head towards Adan's Tower.

raw.en: Tilith seems to be feeling better, which is a relief. No one else is hung up on Zurg's words either. With a unified front, head towards Adan's Tower.
raw.es: Parece que Tilith está mejor. Es un alivio. Tampoco nadie confía en las palabras de Zurg. Con un frente unificado, dirígete a la Torre de Adán.
raw.id: Tillith sepertinya sudah merasa lebih baik. Tidak ada yang mengungkit-ungkit perkataan Zurg. Dengan tim bersatu, maju ke Menara Adan.
raw.pt: Parece que a Tilith está se sentindo melhor, o que é um alívio. Ninguém mais está se atrasando com as palavras do Zurg também. Com uma frente unida, avance até a Torre de Adan.
raw.th: เหมือนว่าทิลิธจะรู้สึกดีขึ้น ซึ่งนั่นก็ทำให้โล่งใจ ไม่มีใครเชื่อในคำพูดของเซิร์กเช่นกัน เมื่อเกิดความสามัคคีก็มุ่งหน้าไปสู่หอคอยของอะดาน
raw.vi: Tilith dường như cảm thấy khá hơn, giống như cảm thấy khuây khỏa. Chẳng có ai khác bị treo lên theo lời của Zurg. Với khung cảnh phía trước chẳng thay đổi gì, hãy hướng về Tòa tháp của Adan.

id: Tempat angker membuatmu merasa hantu bisa muncul kapan saja. Waspadalah. Kau semakin dekat ke wilayah musuh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1251_DESCRIPTION
desc: This eerie place makes it feel like ghosts could appear at any moment. Proceed with caution. You're getting closer to enemy territory now.

raw.en: This eerie place makes it feel like ghosts could appear at any moment. Proceed with caution. You're getting closer to enemy territory now.
raw.es: Este tenebroso lugar te hace pensar en fantasmas. Procede con cautela. Es estás acercando a territorio enemigo.
raw.id: Tempat angker membuatmu merasa hantu bisa muncul kapan saja. Waspadalah. Kau semakin dekat ke wilayah musuh.
raw.pt: Esse lugar sinistro me faz sentir como se fantasmas fossem aparecer a qualquer momento. Siga com cuidado. Você está chegando perto do território inimigo agora.
raw.th: สถานที่ที่น่าขนลุกนี้ ทำให้รู้สึกเหมือนราวกับว่าผีจะปรากฏตัวได้ตลอดเวลา จงไปต่อด้วยความระมัดระวัง คุณกำลังเข้าใกล้กับพื้นที่ของศัตรูแล้วในตอนนี้
raw.vi: Nơi kỳ lạ này khiến nó cảm thấy như những bóng ma có thể xuất hiện bất cứ lúc nào. Hãy tiến hành thận trọng. Ngươi đang tiến gần hơn đến lãnh địa kẻ thù lúc này.

id: Merasa ada yang tidak beres, kau tetap melangkah dengan ringan. Kau harus mengalahkan Dewa Sesat, tidak boleh buang-buang waktu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1252_DESCRIPTION
desc: A feeling of uneasiness lingers in the air, but you travel lightly on your feet. Knowing you must defeat the Fallen God, there's no time to waste.

raw.en: A feeling of uneasiness lingers in the air, but you travel lightly on your feet. Knowing you must defeat the Fallen God, there's no time to waste.
raw.es: Un sentimiento de desasosiego colma el aire, pero viajas ligero de pies. Sabes que debes derrotar al Dios caído. No hay tiempo que perder.
raw.id: Merasa ada yang tidak beres, kau tetap melangkah dengan ringan. Kau harus mengalahkan Dewa Sesat, tidak boleh buang-buang waktu.
raw.pt: Um sentimento de desconforto paira no ar, mas você anda com cuidado. Sabendo que você precisa derrotar o Deus Caído, não há tempo a perder.
raw.th: ความรู้สึกไม่สบายใจลอยอยู่ในอากาศ แต่คุณก็เดินทางอย่างรวดเร็วด้วยเท้าของคุณ เมื่อรู้ว่าคุณจำเป็นต้องเอาชนะเทพมาร ไม่มีเวลาให้เสียอีกต่อไปแล้ว
raw.vi: Một cảm giác băn khoăn lắng đọng lại trong không khí, nhưng ngươi vẫn nhẹ bước trên đôi chân của mình. Biết rằng ngươi phải đánh bại Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần, sẽ chẳng có thời gian nào để lãng phí.

id: Keinginan buruk balas dendam dan gila mencegahmu melangkah lebih jauh. Pahlawan yang menunggu di depan terlihat kuat, persiapkan dirimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1253_DESCRIPTION
desc: The ill wills of revenge and madness prevent you from stepping any further. The hero waiting ahead looks powerful, so prepare yourself.

raw.en: The ill wills of revenge and madness prevent you from stepping any further. The hero waiting ahead looks powerful, so prepare yourself.
raw.es: El rencor, la venganza y la locura te evitan dar el siguiente paso. El héroe que ves ahí delante parece poderoso, así que prepárate.
raw.id: Keinginan buruk balas dendam dan gila mencegahmu melangkah lebih jauh. Pahlawan yang menunggu di depan terlihat kuat, persiapkan dirimu.
raw.pt: A hostilidade da vingança e da loucura evitam que você siga em frente. O herói aguardando adiante parece poderoso, então prepare-se.
raw.th: เจตจำนงชั่วร้ายของการล้างแค้นและความบ้าคลั่ง ขัดขวางคุณไม่ให้เดินหน้าต่อไป ผู้กล้าที่รออยู่เบื้องหน้าดูทรงพลัง ฉะนั้นจงเตรียมตัวให้ดี
raw.vi: Ý chí trả thù xấu xa và sự điên rồ ngăn cản ngươi tiến thêm bước nữa. Vị anh hùng đang chờ phía trước trông rất cường đại, vì vậy ngươi hãy chuẩn bị.

id: Wanita muda menanti di pinggir gerbang kastel. Sepertinya ia memegang pedang di tangan kanannya, dan sihir terkonsentrasi di tangan kirinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1254_DESCRIPTION
desc: A young woman awaits outside the rear gate of the castle. It would seem she's holding a sword in her right hand, and concentrated magic on the other.

raw.en: A young woman awaits outside the rear gate of the castle. It would seem she's holding a sword in her right hand, and concentrated magic on the other.
raw.es: Una joven espera fuera de la puerta trasera del castillo. Parece que lleva una espada en la mano derecha y conjura magia con la mano izquierda.
raw.id: Wanita muda menanti di pinggir gerbang kastel. Sepertinya ia memegang pedang di tangan kanannya, dan sihir terkonsentrasi di tangan kirinya.
raw.pt: Uma jovem mulher espera do lado de fora do portão dos fundos do castelo. Parece que ela empunha uma espada na mão direita e magia concentrada na esquerda.
raw.th: หญิงสาวกำลังรอคอยอยู่ด้านนอกประตูหลังของปราสาท ดูเหมือนเธอกำลังถือดาบเอาไว้ที่มือขวา และรวบรวมพลังเวทย์อยู่ที่มืออีกข้าง
raw.vi: Một phụ nữ trẻ đang chờ đợi bên ngoài cánh cổng phía sau tòa lâu đài. Dường như cô ấy đang nắm giữ một thanh kiếm ở tay phải của mình, và tay kia đang làm phép thuật.

id: Sekelilingmu penuh musuh. Terus maju ke atas selagi Karl mengalihkan perhatian. Perang yang sebenarnya sudah dekat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1260_DESCRIPTION
desc: The surroundings are overflowing with the presence of the enemy. Head for the top while Karl serves as a distraction. The real battle draws near.

raw.en: The surroundings are overflowing with the presence of the enemy. Head for the top while Karl serves as a distraction. The real battle draws near.
raw.es: Los alrededores están rebosantes de enemigos. Sigue hacia la cima mientras Karl los distrae. La batalla real está cerca.
raw.id: Sekelilingmu penuh musuh. Terus maju ke atas selagi Karl mengalihkan perhatian. Perang yang sebenarnya sudah dekat.
raw.pt: Os arredores estão transbordando com a presença do inimigo. Vá até o topo enquanto Karl serve como distração. A verdadeira batalha está chegando.
raw.th: ล้อมรอบนั้นเต็มไปด้วยการปรากฏตัวของศัตรู มุ่งหน้าไปชั้นบนสุด ขณะที่คาร์ลกำลังถ่วงเวลาศัตรูอยู่ การต่อสู้ที่แท้จริงใกล้เข้ามาแล้ว
raw.vi: Xung quanh đang tràn đầy bóng dáng kẻ thù. Hãy tiến lên phía trên đỉnh trong khi Karl làm sao nhãng sự chú ý. Trận chiến thực sự sắp đến gần.

id: Tangga ke atas tidak ditemukan. Satu-satunya jalan ada di dalam. Jalurnya miring, perlahan naik ke atas.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1261_DESCRIPTION
desc: You cannot find the staircase that leads upstairs, so you take the only way available deep inside. The path seems slanted, slowly curving upwards.

raw.en: You cannot find the staircase that leads upstairs, so you take the only way available deep inside. The path seems slanted, slowly curving upwards.
raw.es: No encuentras una escalera que te lleve arriba, así que tomas el camino interno y profundo. Se lo ve levemente inclinado hacia arriba.
raw.id: Tangga ke atas tidak ditemukan. Satu-satunya jalan ada di dalam. Jalurnya miring, perlahan naik ke atas.
raw.pt: Você não consegue encontrar a escada que vai até o topo, então você segue pelo único caminho disponível no interior. O caminho parece inclinado, se curvando para cima lentamente.
raw.th: คุณไม่สามารถหาบันไดที่นำไปสู่​​ชั้นบนได้ ดังนั้นคุณจึงใช้เส้นทางเดียวที่มีที่ลึกเข้าไปด้านใน เส้นทางดูเหมือนเอียงขึ้นและชันทีละน้อย
raw.vi: Ngươi không thể tìm thấy cầu thang dẫn lên tầng trên, vậy nên ngươi chỉ còn con đường duy nhất sâu bên trong. Con đường dường như nghiêng ngả, từ từ cong vặn lên.

id: Aula lengkung melingkar ke atas dan ke atas. Kalau terjerembap, kau kalah perang, bisa merosot jauh ke bawah lagi...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1262_DESCRIPTION
desc: The curved hallway spirals upwards and upwards. If you stumble when you lose in battle, you may end up tumbling all the way down...

raw.en: The curved hallway spirals upwards and upwards. If you stumble when you lose in battle, you may end up tumbling all the way down...
raw.es: El curvo salón sube en forma de espiral. Si llegas a perder una batalla y te desplomas, podrías terminar cayendo durante todo el trayecto recorrido...
raw.id: Aula lengkung melingkar ke atas dan ke atas. Kalau terjerembap, kau kalah perang, bisa merosot jauh ke bawah lagi...
raw.pt: O corredor curvado sobe cada vez mais em espiral. Se tropeçar quando perder nas lutas, você pode acabar caindo até lá embaixo.
raw.th: โถงทางเดินที่ชัน หมุนวนโค้งเกลียวขึ้นไปและขึ้นไป ถ้าคุณสะดุดลงเมื่อคุณพ่ายแพ้ในการสู้ คุณอาจจบลงด้วยการกลิ้งตกลงมาจนสุดทาง...
raw.vi: Hành lang cong lại xoắn ốc lên trên và hướng lên trên. Nếu ngươi vấp ngã khi thua trận, có thể ngươi sẽ gục ngã rơi đập xuống dưới...

id: Sampai di atas ada kamar besar. Seakan musuh kuat setipe telah menantimu di sana, tiba-tiba kau diserang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1263_DESCRIPTION
desc: You reach the top to find a large room. As if the same type of powerful enemy had been waiting for you all along, you're suddenly attacked.

raw.en: You reach the top to find a large room. As if the same type of powerful enemy had been waiting for you all along, you're suddenly attacked.
raw.es: Llegas a la cima y ves un gran cuarto. Te atacan de repente, como si el mismo tipo de enemigo poderoso te hubiera estado esperando todo este tiempo.
raw.id: Sampai di atas ada kamar besar. Seakan musuh kuat setipe telah menantimu di sana, tiba-tiba kau diserang.
raw.pt: Você chega ao topo e encontra um salão amplo. Como se o mesmo tipo de inimigo poderoso estivesse esperando o tempo todo, você é atacado de repente.
raw.th: คุณไปถึงด้านบนและพบห้องขนาดใหญ่ ราวกับว่าศัตรูทรงพลังชนิดเดียวกันกำลังรอคอยคุณอยู่มาโดยตลอด ทันใดนั้นคุณก็ถูกโจมตี
raw.vi: Ngươi lên phía trên đỉnh để tìm một căn phòng lớn. Bởi nơi đó có một kẻ thù có sức mạnh tương đương đã chờ đợi ngươi từ lâu, ngươi sẽ bị tấn công bất ngờ.

id: Naik tangga ke atas, buka pintu, ada kamar besar lainnya. Setelah selangkah, pintu tertutup dan musuh kuat dipanggil. Sedikit lagi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1264_DESCRIPTION
desc: You go upstairs, open the doors, and find another large room. After just one step, the doors close and a strong enemy is summoned. Just a bit more.

raw.en: You go upstairs, open the doors, and find another large room. After just one step, the doors close and a strong enemy is summoned. Just a bit more.
raw.es: Subes la escalera, abres la puerta y ves otro gran cuarto. Das un paso, se cierra la puerta y un poderoso enemigo se hace presente. Solo un poco más.
raw.id: Naik tangga ke atas, buka pintu, ada kamar besar lainnya. Setelah selangkah, pintu tertutup dan musuh kuat dipanggil. Sedikit lagi.
raw.pt: Você segue para cima, abre as portas e encontra um salão amplo. Depois de só um passo, as portas se fecham e um poderoso inimigo é invocado. Só mais um pouco.
raw.th: คุณไปชั้นบนเพื่อเปิดประตู และพบห้องขนาดใหญ่อีกห้องหนึ่ง หลังจากแค่เพียงหนึ่งก้าว ประตูก็ปิดลง และศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งก็ถูกเรียกออกมา อีกนิดเดียวเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Ngươi sẽ đi lên cầu thang, mở cửa ra vào, và tìm thấy một căn phòng lớn khác. Chỉ sau một bước chân, cánh cửa sẽ đóng lại và một kẻ thù mạnh mẽ sẽ được triệu tập. Chỉ cần thêm một chút.

id: Setelah perang ganas, naik ke tangga sempit. Dalam jalan ke puncak, musuh menampakkan diri, tetapi tidak ada jalan mundur sekarang!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1265_DESCRIPTION
desc: After a fierce battle, you climb your way up through some narrow stairs. On your way to the top an enemy shows itself, but there's no going back now!

raw.en: After a fierce battle, you climb your way up through some narrow stairs. On your way to the top an enemy shows itself, but there's no going back now!
raw.es: Tras una feroz batalla, trepas y llegas a unas estrechas escaleras. Mientras subes, un enemigo se hace presente. ¡Este no es momento de detenerse!
raw.id: Setelah perang ganas, naik ke tangga sempit. Dalam jalan ke puncak, musuh menampakkan diri, tetapi tidak ada jalan mundur sekarang!
raw.pt: Depois de uma batalha dura, você segue até o topo por uma escada estreita. No caminho do topo um inimigo aparece, mas agora não há volta!
raw.th: หลังจากการสู้รบที่ดุเดือด, คุณปีนขึ้นไปบนบันไดแคบๆ ระหว่างทางที่คุณจะไปถึงชั้นบนสุด ศัตรูก็ปรากฏตัวขึ้น แต่ไม่มีทางให้ถอยอีกแล้วตอนนี้
raw.vi: Sau trận chiến khốc liệt, ngươi sẽ bước lên theo cách của mình xuyên qua một vài cầu thang nhỏ hẹp. Trên đường lên đỉnh một kẻ thù sẽ hiện thân, nhưng lúc này chẳng còn gì để quay lại!

id: Akhirnya sampai puncak, tidak diragukan lagi Zurg sudah menanti. Kalau kau mengalahkan si murid, maka musuhmu tinggal satu: Dewa Sesat terakhir, Afla Dilith!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1266_DESCRIPTION
desc: Finally at the top, there's no doubt that Zurg is waiting. If you defeat the disciple of the last Fallen God, Afla Dilith will be the only enemy left!

raw.en: Finally at the top, there's no doubt that Zurg is waiting. If you defeat the disciple of the last Fallen God, Afla Dilith will be the only enemy left!
raw.es: Por fin llegas a la cima. No hay duda: Zurg está esperándote. Si vences al discípulo del último Dios caído, ¡Afla Dilith será el único enemigo en pie!
raw.id: Akhirnya sampai puncak, tidak diragukan lagi Zurg sudah menanti. Kalau kau mengalahkan si murid, maka musuhmu tinggal satu: Dewa Sesat terakhir, Afla Dilith!
raw.pt: Ao finalmente chegar no topo, não há dúvidas de que Zurg aguarda. Se você derrotar o discípulo do último Deus Caído, Afla Dilith será o único inimigo restante!
raw.th: ในที่สุดก็ถึงชั้นบนสุด ไม่แปลกใจเลยว่าเซิร์กกำลังรอคอยอยู่ ถ้าคุณสามารถเอาชนะสาวกของเทพมารตนสุดท้ายได้ อัฟล่า ดิลิธ จะเป็นศัตรูตัวสุดท้าย
raw.vi: Cuối cùng khi ở trên đỉnh, chẳng nghi ngờ gì rằng Zurg đang chờ đợi. Nếu ngươi đánh bại đệ tử của Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần cuối cùng, Afla Dilith sẽ là kẻ thù duy nhất còn lại!

id: Melihat ke kejauhan dan ada bayangan kastel mengerikan. Katanya itu bentuk terakhir metamorfosis Afla Dilith...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1300_DESCRIPTION
desc: You look far into the distance and notice the shadow of an eerie castle. They say that it is the last form Afla Dilith morphed into...

raw.en: You look far into the distance and notice the shadow of an eerie castle. They say that it is the last form Afla Dilith morphed into...
raw.es: Miras a lo lejos y ves la sombra de un castigo siniestro. Dicen que es la última forma en la que mutó Afla Dilith...
raw.id: Melihat ke kejauhan dan ada bayangan kastel mengerikan. Katanya itu bentuk terakhir metamorfosis Afla Dilith...
raw.pt: Você olha na distância e percebe a sombra de um castelo sinistro. Dizem que é a última forma em que Afla Dilith se transformou...
raw.th: เจ้ามองไปไกลๆ และสังเกตุเห็นประสาทแปลกประหลาด เขาว่ากันว่านั่นคือการเปลี่ยนแปลงครั้งสุดท้ายของอัฟลา ดิลิธเพื่อจะเป็น...
raw.vi: Ngươi nhìn ra phía xa và nhận thấy cái bóng của một lâu đài kỳ lạ. Họ nói rằng đó là hình dạng cuối cùng Afla Dilith đã biến thành...

id: Jejak kaki Lugina dkk yang jalan duluan sudah lenyap. Angin kuat memukul bukit pasir, terus mengubah bentuknya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1301_DESCRIPTION
desc: The footprints of Lugina and the others who had gone ahead have vanished. Strong gusts of wind hit the sand dunes, continuously changing their shape.

raw.en: The footprints of Lugina and the others who had gone ahead have vanished. Strong gusts of wind hit the sand dunes, continuously changing their shape.
raw.es: Las huellas de Lugina y los demás que se te adelantaron desaparecen. Fuertes ráfagas de viento golpean las dunas, que cambian de forma constantemente.
raw.id: Jejak kaki Lugina dkk yang jalan duluan sudah lenyap. Angin kuat memukul bukit pasir, terus mengubah bentuknya.
raw.pt: As pegadas de Lugina e dos outros que seguiram adiante sumiram. Fortes ventos atingem as dunas de areia, mudando suas formas constantemente.
raw.th: รอยเท้าของลูจิน่ากับคนอื่นที่เดินทางไปก่อนได้จางหายไป ลมแรงที่พัดทรายติดต่อกันและทำให้รอยทรายเปลี่ยนไปเรื่อยๆ
raw.vi: Dấu chân của Lugina và những người khác đi trước đã biến mất. Từng cơn gió mạnh xoay vần các cồn cát, liên tục thay đổi hình dạng chúng.

id: Sinar surya menyengat melelahkanmu, membuat dehidrasi. Kau sudah melewati banyak daerah panas, tapi tidak pernah terbiasa dengan panas ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1302_DESCRIPTION
desc: The blazing sun is wearing you down, dehydrating you. You've crossed many scorching territories so far, but somehow never seem to grow used to them.

raw.en: The blazing sun is wearing you down, dehydrating you. You've crossed many scorching territories so far, but somehow never seem to grow used to them.
raw.es: El ardiente sol te cansa y te deshidrata. Ya has cruzado muchos territorios abrasadores pero, de alguna manera, nunca terminas de acostumbrarte.
raw.id: Sinar surya menyengat melelahkanmu, membuat dehidrasi. Kau sudah melewati banyak daerah panas, tapi tidak pernah terbiasa dengan panas ini.
raw.pt: O sol escaldante está deixando você cansado e desidratado. Você passou por muitos lugares quentes até aqui, mas de alguma forma nunca se acostumou com eles.
raw.th: พระอาทิตย์ที่ส่องสว่างทำให้เจ้าเหนื่อยไวและหิวน้ำ เจ้าได้พาพื้นที่แห้งแล้งมาหลายแห่งแล้ว แต่ก็ยังไม่คุ้นเคย
raw.vi: Mặt trời chói chang bào mòn sức lực, làm ngươi mất nước. Ngươi đã vượt qua nhiều vùng đất nóng như thiêu đốt, nhưng lại chẳng bao giờ có vẻ dần quen với chúng.

id: Pasir yang berkilau memantulkan sinar surya, kakimu bertambah panas. Kalau begini terus, kakimu akan terpanggang gosong...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1303_DESCRIPTION
desc: As the sparkling sand reflects the sunlight, your feet grow hotter and hotter. At this rate they'll end up well-done while they roast...

raw.en: As the sparkling sand reflects the sunlight, your feet grow hotter and hotter. At this rate they'll end up well-done while they roast...
raw.es: La brillante arena refleja la luz solar, y con cada paso, sientes los pies más y más calientes. A esta altura, terminarás por rostizarte...
raw.id: Pasir yang berkilau memantulkan sinar surya, kakimu bertambah panas. Kalau begini terus, kakimu akan terpanggang gosong...
raw.pt: Enquanto a areia brilhante reflete a luz do sol, seus pés ficam cada vez mais quentes. Nessas condições você vai cozinhar enquanto eles torram...
raw.th: เมื่อทรายวับวาวสะท้อนแสงพระอาทิตย์ เท้าของเจ้าก็รู้สึกร้อนขึ้นเรื่อยๆ ถ้าเป็นแบบนี้ต่อไป เท้าต้องไหม้แน่ๆ
raw.vi: Khi cát lấp lánh phản chiếu ánh nắng, bàn chân ngươi ngày càng nóng rực. Với tốc độ này họ sẽ kết thúc sớm khi vẫn đang bị nướng chín...

id: Musuhmu bukan hanya rasa haus dan matahari. Afla Dilith telah mengiriman banyak pembunuh yang mengejarmu. Akhir gurun sudah dekat sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1304_DESCRIPTION
desc: Your thirst and the sun aren't your only enemies. Afla Dilith has dispatched assassins who are closing in on you. The end of the desert isn't far now.

raw.en: Your thirst and the sun aren't your only enemies. Afla Dilith has dispatched assassins who are closing in on you. The end of the desert isn't far now.
raw.es: La sed y el sol no son tus únicos enemigos. Afla Dilith ha enviado asesinos que te están siguiendo la pista. El final del desierto no está lejos.
raw.id: Musuhmu bukan hanya rasa haus dan matahari. Afla Dilith telah mengiriman banyak pembunuh yang mengejarmu. Akhir gurun sudah dekat sekarang.
raw.pt: Sua sede e o sol não são seus únicos inimigos. Afla Dilith enviou assassinos que estão se aproximando. O fim do deserto já não está longe.
raw.th: ความหิวน้ำและพระอาทิตย์ไม่ได้เป็นอุปสรรคอย่างเดียว อัฟลา ดิลิธได้สั่งนักล่าตามเจ้า ทุกสิ่งคงจะจบลงในไม่ช้านี้
raw.vi: Cơn khát và mặt trời chẳng phải là những kẻ thù duy nhất của ngươi. Afla Dilith đã cử sát thủ tiếp cận ngươi. Điểm cuối sa mạc chẳng còn xa nữa.

id: Benar, ada dewa-dewa lain selain Empat Dewa Sesat yang menolak keberadaan manusia. Ayo fokus ke tugas sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1310_DESCRIPTION
desc: Indeed there are other gods besides the Four Fallen that reject the existence of humans. However, let's focus on the task at hand for now.

raw.en: Indeed there are other gods besides the Four Fallen that reject the existence of humans. However, let's focus on the task at hand for now.
raw.es: Queda claro que hay otros dioses además de los cuatro caídos que rechazan la existencia humana. Por lo pronto, concentrémonos en la tarea actual.
raw.id: Benar, ada dewa-dewa lain selain Empat Dewa Sesat yang menolak keberadaan manusia. Ayo fokus ke tugas sekarang.
raw.pt: E há mesmo outros deuses além dos Quatro Caídos que rejeitam a existência dos humanos. No entanto, vamos nos concentrar na tarefa que está em andamento.
raw.th: แน่นอนว่า ยังมีเทพอื่นนอกจากจตุรเทพมารที่ปฏิเสธมนุษย์ อย่างไรก็ตาม ตอนนี้ต้องจัดการปัญหานี้ให้เสร็จก่อน
raw.vi: Thực tế có những vị thần khác ngoài Bốn Vị Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần đã từ chối sự tồn tại của con người. Tuy nhiên, chúng ta hãy tập trung vào các nhiệm vụ hiện tại bây giờ.

id: Matahari menembus tembok es dan meski tidak ada cahaya dalam kuil, di luar terang. Tiba-tiba cahaya terbiaskan, membentuk pelangi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1311_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sun shines through an ice wall and though no light is lit within the temple, it's bright inside. The light suddenly refracts, creating a rainbow.

raw.en: The sun shines through an ice wall and though no light is lit within the temple, it's bright inside. The light suddenly refracts, creating a rainbow.
raw.es: El sol brilla a través de un muro gélido. Aunque no hay ninguna luz dentro del templo, está brillando. La luz se refracta rápido y crea un arcoíris.
raw.id: Matahari menembus tembok es dan meski tidak ada cahaya dalam kuil, di luar terang. Tiba-tiba cahaya terbiaskan, membentuk pelangi.
raw.pt: O sol brilha através de uma parede de gelo e, embora não haja luz acesa dentro do templo, ele está claro. A luz se refrata de repente, criando um arco-íris.
raw.th: พระอาทิตย์ส่องแสงผ่านกำแพงน้ำแข็ง ต่อให้ไม่มีแสงไฟในวัดนี้ ก็ยังสว่าง แสงวิ่งผ่านอากาศและน้ำก่อให้เกิดสายรุ้ง
raw.vi: Mặt trời chiếu ánh sáng xuyên qua bức tường băng đá và dù cho không một ánh sáng nào được thắp lên trong đền thờ, thì ngôi đền vẫn sáng lên ở bên trong. Ánh sáng đột nhiên khúc xạ, tạo thành một chiếc cầu vồng.

id: Kuil es yang sepi memberikan suasana sangat santai. Namun dengan banyaknya musuh yang berdatangan, kau tidak bisa beristirahat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1312_DESCRIPTION
desc: The solitude of the ice temple makes for a very relaxing atmosphere. However, with enemies incoming, you have no time to rest.

raw.en: The solitude of the ice temple makes for a very relaxing atmosphere. However, with enemies incoming, you have no time to rest.
raw.es: La soledad del templo gélido genera una atmósfera emocionante. Sin embargo, los enemigos se acercan y no hay tiempo para descansar.
raw.id: Kuil es yang sepi memberikan suasana sangat santai. Namun dengan banyaknya musuh yang berdatangan, kau tidak bisa beristirahat.
raw.pt: O isolamento do templo de gelo gera uma atmosfera muito relaxante. No entanto, com inimigos se aproximando, não há tempo para descansar.
raw.th: วัดน้ำแข็งที่ตั้งอยู่อย่างโดดเดี่ยวทำให้เกิดความรู้สึกที่สงบ แต่เพราะศัตรูยังคงตามล่า เจ้าไม่มีเวลาที่จะมานั่งพัก
raw.vi: Sự tĩnh mịch của ngôi đền băng tạo thành một bầu không khí vô cùng dễ chịu. Tuy nhiên, bởi kẻ thù đang tiến đến, ngươi chẳng phút giây nào để nghỉ ngơi!

id: Apakah kuil ini juga karya para dewa? Atau mahakarya manusia dengan kekuatan dunia lain? Sangat memancing rasa penasaran.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1313_DESCRIPTION
desc: Could this temple also be the work of the gods? Or is it the masterpiece of a person with otherworldly powers? It piques your curiosity.

raw.en: Could this temple also be the work of the gods? Or is it the masterpiece of a person with otherworldly powers? It piques your curiosity.
raw.es: ¿Este templo será acaso también obra de los dioses? ¿O quizá sea la obra maestra de alguna persona con poderes ultraterrenales? Te mata la curiosidad.
raw.id: Apakah kuil ini juga karya para dewa? Atau mahakarya manusia dengan kekuatan dunia lain? Sangat memancing rasa penasaran.
raw.pt: Será que esse templo também é trabalho dos deuses? Ou será que é a obra prima de uma pessoa com poderes de outro mundo? Isso atiça sua curiosidade.
raw.th: วัดนี้จะเป็นสิ่งก่อสร้างของเทพหรือเปล่า หรือเป็นสิ่งก่อสร้างโดยคนที่มีพลังดั่งเทพ? มันทำให้เจ้าสนใจเหลือเกิน
raw.vi: Phải chăng ngôi đền này cũng là một tác phẩm của các vị thần? Hoặc là kiệt tác của một người có quyền năng của thế giới khác? Nó gợi lên sự tò mò của ngươi.

id: Semua perlahan menjadi lebih terang. Jalan keluar mungkin sudah dekat, tapi situasi tidak sesederhana pemikiranmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1314_DESCRIPTION
desc: Everything is gradually turning brighter. The exit may be close, but things will probably not be as simple as you think.

raw.en: Everything is gradually turning brighter. The exit may be close, but things will probably not be as simple as you think.
raw.es: Gradualmente, todo se vuelve más brillante. La salida quizá esté cerca, pero es probable que las cosas no sean tan fáciles como crees.
raw.id: Semua perlahan menjadi lebih terang. Jalan keluar mungkin sudah dekat, tapi situasi tidak sesederhana pemikiranmu.
raw.pt: Tudo está ficando cada vez mais claro. A saída pode estar próxima, mas as coisas provavelmente não serão tão simples quanto você acha.
raw.th: ทุกสิ่งค่อยๆ เริ่มจะสว่างขึ้น ทางออกอาจจะอยู่ใกล้ๆ นี้ แต่อาจจะไม่ได้ง่ายอย่างที่เจ้าคิด
raw.vi: Tất cả mọi thứ đang dần trở nên tươi sáng hơn. Gần đó có thể có một lối ra, nhưng mọi thứ có thể sẽ không đơn giản như ngươi nghĩ.

id: Hutan kuno yang pernah dikunjungi sedikit orang. Sepertinya tidak ada jalan alami. Kau harus memakai insting arahmu untuk keluar dari sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1320_DESCRIPTION
desc: An ancient forest that few have visited before. There seem to be no natural paths. You'll have to use your sense of direction to get out of this one.

raw.en: An ancient forest that few have visited before. There seem to be no natural paths. You'll have to use your sense of direction to get out of this one.
raw.es: Un bosque ancestral que pocos han visitado. Parece que no hay caminos naturales. Tendrás que usar tu sentido de la dirección para salir de aquí.
raw.id: Hutan kuno yang pernah dikunjungi sedikit orang. Sepertinya tidak ada jalan alami. Kau harus memakai insting arahmu untuk keluar dari sini.
raw.pt: Uma floresta antiga que poucos visitaram. Parece que não há caminhos naturais. Você terá que usar seu senso de direção para escapar dessa.
raw.th: ป่าเก่าแก่ที่มีเพียงไม่กี่คนที่ได้เข้าไป มันไม่มีทางเดินหรือทางผ่านที่แน่ชัด เจ้าจะต้องใช้ความรู้สึกอันเฉียบแหลมในการออกจากที่
raw.vi: Một khu rừng cổ xưa mà trước đây ít người ghé qua. Dường như không có lấy một lối mòn tự nhiên. Ngươi sẽ phải sử dụng linh cảm định hướng của mình để ra khỏi chốn này.

id: Ada perasaan aneh. Suasana ini ada di banyak hutan lain yang sudah kaulalui. Tidak diragukan lagi, ada banyak roh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1321_DESCRIPTION
desc: A strange feeling overcomes you. You've sensed this atmosphere in many of the forests you have passed through so far. No doubt spirits are near.

raw.en: A strange feeling overcomes you. You've sensed this atmosphere in many of the forests you have passed through so far. No doubt spirits are near.
raw.es: Una extraña sensación se apodera de ti. Has sentido lo mismo en muchos de los otros bosques que has atravesado. Es obvio: hay espíritus cerca.
raw.id: Ada perasaan aneh. Suasana ini ada di banyak hutan lain yang sudah kaulalui. Tidak diragukan lagi, ada banyak roh.
raw.pt: Um sentimento estranho toma conta de você. Você sentiu essa atmosfera em muitas das florestas que já passou. Não há dúvidas de que os espíritos estão perto.
raw.th: ความรู้สึกที่ประหลาดนี้ เจ้าสามารถสัมผัสได้ถึงบรรยากาศที่ในป่าอื่นๆ ที่ได้เคยเดินผ่าน แน่นอนว่าวิญญาณต้องอยู่ใกล้ๆ นี้
raw.vi: Một cảm giác kỳ lạ sẽ bao trùm lấy ngươi. Ngươi đã từng cảm nhận về bầu không khí này khi băng qua nhiều khu rừng từ trước giờ. Không nghi ngờ gì nữa, những linh hồn đang ở quanh đây.

id: Bersama teriakan melengking, sekumpulan burung terbang ketakutan. Raungan keras mengikuti. Suara mesin dunia lain sedang aktif!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1322_DESCRIPTION
desc: Along with a shrilling cry, a flock of birds flies off frightened. A loud roar follows after. It's the sound of an otherworldly machine at work!

raw.en: Along with a shrilling cry, a flock of birds flies off frightened. A loud roar follows after. It's the sound of an otherworldly machine at work!
raw.es: Con un grito estridente, una bandada de aves sale volando atemorizada. Luego se oye un gran rugido. ¡Es el sonido de una máquina de otro mundo!
raw.id: Bersama teriakan melengking, sekumpulan burung terbang ketakutan. Raungan keras mengikuti. Suara mesin dunia lain sedang aktif!
raw.pt: Junto com um pranto estridente, uma revoada de pássaros sai voando assustada. Um rugido alto vem em seguida. É o som de uma máquina de outro mundo funcionando!
raw.th: เสียงร้องไห้ที่สั่นเครื่อนี้ ทำให้กลุ่มนกถึงกับบินหนีด้วยความตกใจ เสียงคำรามดังก้องตามมา นี้มันเป็นเสียงเครื่องยนต์กำลังทำงาน
raw.vi: Cùng với một tiếng kêu the thé inh tai, một đàn chim sợ hãi bay vút lên. Sau đó là một tiếng gầm lớn. Đó là âm thanh của một cỗ máy đến từ thế giới khác đang làm việc!

id: Kau merasa sesuatu mengundangmu masuk ke dalam lautan pohon. Kau berpikir bahwa kau sedang dipimpin ke sarang penuh musuh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1323_DESCRIPTION
desc: You get the feeling that something is inviting you deep into the sea of trees. You can't help thinking you're being led to a den full of enemies.

raw.en: You get the feeling that something is inviting you deep into the sea of trees. You can't help thinking you're being led to a den full of enemies.
raw.es: Sientes que algo te está llamando hacia este mar de árboles. No puedes evitar pensar que te están llevando hacia un cubil lleno de enemigos.
raw.id: Kau merasa sesuatu mengundangmu masuk ke dalam lautan pohon. Kau berpikir bahwa kau sedang dipimpin ke sarang penuh musuh.
raw.pt: Você sente que tem algo convidando você para as profundezas desse mar de árvores. Você não consegue não pensar que está sendo levado a um refúgio cheio de inimigos.
raw.th: เจ้ารู้สึกถึงบางสิ่งบางอย่างที่กำลังเชิญชวนให้เดินเข้าไปในป่าลึกที่ปกคลุมไปด้วยต้นไม้ เจ้าคิดได้อย่างเดียวว่า เจ้ากำลังถูกดึงไปในกลุ่มศัตรู
raw.vi: Ngươi có cảm giác rằng một thứ gì đó đang mời gọi ngươi tiến sâu vào biển cây. Ngươi không thể ngừng nghĩ rằng ngươi đang bị dẫn đến sào huyệt của kẻ thù.

id: Jarak antarpohon telah melebar. Akhir hutan mungkin sudah dekat. Artinya musuh lebih kuat sudah menunggu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1324_DESCRIPTION
desc: The space between the trees has widened. The end of the forest may be near. This can only mean that enemies more powerful than before await you.

raw.en: The space between the trees has widened. The end of the forest may be near. This can only mean that enemies more powerful than before await you.
raw.es: El espacio entre los árboles es más amplio. Quizá el final del bosque esté cerca. Esto significa que te esperan enemigos más poderosos.
raw.id: Jarak antarpohon telah melebar. Akhir hutan mungkin sudah dekat. Artinya musuh lebih kuat sudah menunggu.
raw.pt: O espaço entre as árvores aumentou. O fim do floresta pode estar perto. Isso só pode significar que inimigos mais poderosos do que antes o esperam.
raw.th: ความกว้างระหว่างต้นไม้เริ่มขยาย ทางออกจากป่านี้อาจจะอยู่ใกล้ๆ แต่นี้หมายความว่า ศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งกว่านี้กำลังรอเจ้าอยู่
raw.vi: Khoảng cách giữa các cây đã được mở rộng. Bìa rừng chắc cũng gần đây. Điều này chỉ có thể có nghĩa là những kẻ thù mạnh hơn trước đang chờ đón ngươi.

id: Takdir masa depan... Apa yang Paris katakan mulai masuk akal. Namun kau harus fokus dulu untuk mengalahkan Dewa Sesat terakhir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1330_DESCRIPTION
desc: The fate of the future... What Paris told you is starting to make sense. However, you must first focus on defeating the last Fallen God.

raw.en: The fate of the future... What Paris told you is starting to make sense. However, you must first focus on defeating the last Fallen God.
raw.es: El destino del futuro... Lo que te dijo Paris empieza a tener sentido. Sin embargo, debes concentrarte en derrotar al último Dios caído.
raw.id: Takdir masa depan... Apa yang Paris katakan mulai masuk akal. Namun kau harus fokus dulu untuk mengalahkan Dewa Sesat terakhir.
raw.pt: O destino do futuro... O que a Paris disse para você está começando a fazer sentido. No entanto, primeiro você precisa se concentrar em derrotar o último Deus Caído.
raw.th: ชีวิตของอนาคต สิ่งที่ปารีสบอกเจ้าเริ่มจะเป็นจริง อย่างไรก็ตาม เจ้าต้องล้มเทพสุดท้ายของเทพมารก่อน
raw.vi: Số phận của tương lai... Những gì Paris đã nói với ngươi bắt đầu có ý nghĩa. Tuy nhiên, trước tiên ngươi phải tập trung vào việc đánh bại Vị Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần cuối cùng.

id: Tetes besar hujan tak mau berhenti, jatuh menimpamu. Badan terasa lebih dingin, kau bersin-bersin, suara guntur beresonansi di sekitarmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1331_DESCRIPTION
desc: The large drops of rain won't stop, striking you as they fall. Your body gets colder, and as you sneeze, the sound of thunder resonates around you.

raw.en: The large drops of rain won't stop, striking you as they fall. Your body gets colder, and as you sneeze, the sound of thunder resonates around you.
raw.es: La lluvia no cesa y las grandes gotas te golpean al caer. Sientes el cuerpo más frío y mientras estornudas, oyes el sonido del trueno alrededor de ti.
raw.id: Tetes besar hujan tak mau berhenti, jatuh menimpamu. Badan terasa lebih dingin, kau bersin-bersin, suara guntur beresonansi di sekitarmu.
raw.pt: As grandes gotas de chuva não param e o atingem com força. Seu corpo fica mais gelado e, quando você espirra, o som de trovão ressoa ao seu redor.
raw.th: ฝนเม็ดใหญ่ไม่หยุดตกลงบนตัวเจ้า มันเจ็บ ร่างกายเริ่มเย็นขึ้น และเมื่อเจ้าจาม เสียงฟ้าฝ่าก็ร้องคำราม
raw.vi: Những giọt mưa táp không ngừng, quất thẳng vào ngươi khi rơi xuống. Cơ thể ngươi trở nên lạnh giá hơn và khi hắt hơi, tiếng sấm rền vang quanh ngươi.

id: Kau bisa melihat bahwa bangunan di Aldahlia terendam air hujan dan terkena erosi. Kau mulai penasaran sampai kapan hujan akan terus turun.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1332_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can tell that in Aldahlia the buildings soaked in rainwater have been eroding away. You start to wonder how long this rain will keep falling.

raw.en: You can tell that in Aldahlia the buildings soaked in rainwater have been eroding away. You start to wonder how long this rain will keep falling.
raw.es: Te das cuenta de que en Aldahlia las edificaciones se han erosionado por el agua. Comienzas a preguntarte cuánto durará la lluvia.
raw.id: Kau bisa melihat bahwa bangunan di Aldahlia terendam air hujan dan terkena erosi. Kau mulai penasaran sampai kapan hujan akan terus turun.
raw.pt: Você percebe que, em Aldahlia, os prédios encharcados com água da chuva andaram se desgastando. Você começa a se perguntar por quanto tempo a chuva vai continuar.
raw.th: เจ้าสามารถบอกได้ว่า สิ่งปลูกสร้างในอัลดาห์เลียพวกนี้ที่เปียกน้ำเริ่มจะพุพัง เจ้าเริ่มสงสัยว่า ฝนยังจะตกอีกนานเท่าไร
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể nói rằng ở Aldahlia các tòa nhà dầm trong mưa đang bị xói mòn đi. Ngươi bắt đầu tự hỏi cơn mưa này sẽ tiếp tục đổ xuống bao lâu nữa.

id: Petir terang membelah langit. Setelah sedetik, suara guntur memekakkan telinga. Halilintar menyambar sangat dekat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1333_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bright bolt of lightning tears the sky apart. After a second of waiting, a deafening sound hits your ears. Lighting struck dangerously close.

raw.en: A bright bolt of lightning tears the sky apart. After a second of waiting, a deafening sound hits your ears. Lighting struck dangerously close.
raw.es: Un brillante destello parte el cielo en dos. Tras unos segundos, un sonido ensordecedor te rompe los tímpanos. El rayo cayó demasiado cerca.
raw.id: Petir terang membelah langit. Setelah sedetik, suara guntur memekakkan telinga. Halilintar menyambar sangat dekat.
raw.pt: Um raio brilhante rasga o céu. Depois de um segundo de espera, um som ensurdecedor atinge seus ouvidos. O raio caiu perigosamente perto.
raw.th: เส้นสายฟ้าฝ่าได้ผ่าท้องฟ้าออก ไม่กี่วินาทีต่อมา เจ้าก็ได้ยินเสียงดังก้องกังวาน ฟ้าฝ่าลงมาใกล้มาก
raw.vi: Một tia sáng chớp rạch ngang bầu trời. Sau một giây chờ đợi, một âm thanh chát chúa làm chói tai ngươi. Tia sét đánh gần cực nguy hiểm.

id: Raungan guntur telah membuat telingamu berdengung. Kau tak akan selamat jika diserbu dalam keadaan ini, jadi lebih baik waspada.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1334_DESCRIPTION
desc: The continuous roaring of the thunder has made your ears feel funny. You wouldn't survive an ambush in this state, so you best be cautious.

raw.en: The continuous roaring of the thunder has made your ears feel funny. You wouldn't survive an ambush in this state, so you best be cautious.
raw.es: Los continuos truenos hacen que sientas raros los oídos. No sobrevivirías a una emboscada en este estado, así que mantente alerta.
raw.id: Raungan guntur telah membuat telingamu berdengung. Kau tak akan selamat jika diserbu dalam keadaan ini, jadi lebih baik waspada.
raw.pt: O rugido contínuo do trovão causou uma sensação estranha nos seus ouvidos. Você não sobreviveria a uma emboscada nesse estado, então é melhor tomar cuidado.
raw.th: เสียงร้องของฟ้าผ่าดังไม่หยุดและเริ่มทำให้หูของเจ้าอื้อ เจ้าไม่สามารถรอดจากการซุ่มโจมตีได้ ฉะนั้นต้องระวังตัวให้มากที่สุด
raw.vi: Tiếng sấm sét rền vang liên tục đã làm đôi tai ngươi cảm thấy là lạ. Ngươi sẽ không thể sống sót trong cuộc phục kích ở trạng thái này, tốt nhất ngươi nên thận trọng.

id: Jalan masih panjang menuju Afla Dilith, tapi semua orang terus membicarakan apa yang akan terjadi setelahnya. Jangan ikut khawatir tentang masa depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1340_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's still a long way to Afla Dilith, but everyone keeps talking about what will come after that. Let's not worry about those things for now.

raw.en: It's still a long way to Afla Dilith, but everyone keeps talking about what will come after that. Let's not worry about those things for now.
raw.es: Todavía falta un largo trecho para llegar a Afla Dilith, pero todos hablan de lo que pasará luego. Por ahora, no vale la pena preocuparse por eso.
raw.id: Jalan masih panjang menuju Afla Dilith, tapi semua orang terus membicarakan apa yang akan terjadi setelahnya. Jangan ikut khawatir tentang masa depan.
raw.pt: Ainda tem um longo caminho até Afla Dilith, mas todos ficam falando sobre o que vai acontecer depois disso. Não vamos nos preocupar com essas coisas agora.
raw.th: หนทางยังอีกไกลกว่าจะถึงอัฟลา ลิดิธ แต่ทุกคนพูดถึงแต่ว่าจะทำยังไงเมื่อถึงที่นั้น ยังไม่ต้องกังวลเรื่องพวกนั้น
raw.vi: Vẫn còn một chặng đường dài để đến được Afla Dilith, nhưng mọi người luôn nói về những gì sẽ đến sau đó. Đừng lo lắng về những điều đó vào lúc này.
