id: Sekawanan Pegasus ketakutan, ada yang lebih membahayakan melayang di udara. Para dewi perang mengepakkan sayap bersiap untuk bertempur.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1341_DESCRIPTION
desc: The herd of Pegasus was just frightened, but something more alarming soars the skies. War goddesses spread their wings to prepare for battle.

raw.en: The herd of Pegasus was just frightened, but something more alarming soars the skies. War goddesses spread their wings to prepare for battle.
raw.es: La manada de Pegasos era temible, pero algo más alarmante sobrevuela los cielos. Diosas guerreras abren las alas y se preparan para el combate.
raw.id: Sekawanan Pegasus ketakutan, ada yang lebih membahayakan melayang di udara. Para dewi perang mengepakkan sayap bersiap untuk bertempur.
raw.pt: A tropa de pégasos estava só assustada, mas algo mais alarmante está voando pelo céu. Deusas da guerra abrem as asas para se prepararem para a batalha.
raw.th: กลุ่มฝูงม้าเปกาซัสตกใจ แต่บางสิ่งอย่างอื่นที่ตกใจมากกว่าบินถลาลงท้องฟ้า เทพีแห่งสงครามกางปีกและเตรียมตัวเข้าสู่สงคราม
raw.vi: Lũ ngựa Pagasus vừa hoảng sợ, nhưng một thứ gì đó dè chừng hơn nữa đang vọt lên bầu trời. Nữ thần chiến tranh dang rộng đôi cánh sắp sửa xông vào trận chiến.

id: Pemandangan sekeliling terlihat jelas di jalan ini, tak mungkin mendadak diserang. Tapi tak ada yang bisa dipakai untuk menangkis serangan udara.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1342_DESCRIPTION
desc: This road offers a clear view of the surroundings, so there's no fear of an ambush. However, there's nothing you can use to deflect aerial attacks.

raw.en: This road offers a clear view of the surroundings, so there's no fear of an ambush. However, there's nothing you can use to deflect aerial attacks.
raw.es: El camino está despejado, así que no tienes que temer una emboscada. Sin embargo, no hay nada que puedas usar para defenderte de los ataque aéreos.
raw.id: Pemandangan sekeliling terlihat jelas di jalan ini, tak mungkin mendadak diserang. Tapi tak ada yang bisa dipakai untuk menangkis serangan udara.
raw.pt: Esta estrada dá uma vista clara dos arredores, então não há preocupações com emboscadas. No entanto, não há nada que você possa usar para evitar ataques aéreos.
raw.th: ถนนสายนี้มองเห็นสิ่งรอบๆ อย่างชัดเจน ฉะนั้นไม่ต้องกลัวการถูกซุ่มโจมตี อย่างไรก็ตาม ก็ไม่มีสิ่งกีดขวางไว้ใช้ในการหลบหนีเช่นกัน
raw.vi: Con đường này sẽ giúp ngươi nhìn rõ xung quanh, nên sẽ chẳng cần sợ hãi chuyện phục kích. Tuy nhiên, ngươi chẳng thể dùng thứ gì để làm chệch hướng các cuộc tấn công trên không.

id: Seberapa jauh kau sudah maju? Kastel asimilasi Afla Dilith sudah terlihat. Apakah itu yang akan kauhadapi di masa depan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1343_DESCRIPTION
desc: How long have you advanced? Now you can really see the castle Afla Dilith has assimilated with. Is that what you will face in the future?

raw.en: How long have you advanced? Now you can really see the castle Afla Dilith has assimilated with. Is that what you will face in the future?
raw.es: ¿Cuánto has avanzado? Ahora sí puedes ver el castillo con el que se ha asimilado Afla Dilith. ¿A eso te enfrentarás en el futuro?
raw.id: Seberapa jauh kau sudah maju? Kastel asimilasi Afla Dilith sudah terlihat. Apakah itu yang akan kauhadapi di masa depan?
raw.pt: O quanto você avançou? Agora você pode ver realmente o castelo a que Afla Dilith se afiliou. É isso o que você vai enfrentar no futuro?
raw.th: เจ้าเดินทางมานานเท่าไรแล้ว ตอนนี้เจ้าสามารถมองเห็นอัฟลา ดิลิธ นั้นคือสิ่งที่เจ้าจ้ต้องเผชิญในอนาคต
raw.vi: Ngươi tiến bộ được bao lâu rồi? Bây giờ ngươi thực sự có thể thấy lâu đài mà Afla Dilith đã đồng hóa. Đó có phải là những gì ngươi sẽ đối mặt trong tương lai?

id: Jalan untuk ziarah. Zaman dahulu, peziarah lewat sini untuk berdoa pada para dewa. Ironisnya, kau lewat sini untuk mengalahkan dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1344_DESCRIPTION
desc: A road for pilgrims. Long ago, pilgrims passed through here to pray to the gods. Ironically, you're taking this road in order to defeat a god.

raw.en: A road for pilgrims. Long ago, pilgrims passed through here to pray to the gods. Ironically, you're taking this road in order to defeat a god.
raw.es: Camino de peregrinos Antes, los viajantes pasaban por aquí y le rezaban a los dioses. Irónicamente, tú vas de camino a derrotar a uno de ellos.
raw.id: Jalan untuk ziarah. Zaman dahulu, peziarah lewat sini untuk berdoa pada para dewa. Ironisnya, kau lewat sini untuk mengalahkan dewa.
raw.pt: Uma estrada para peregrinos. Há muito tempo, peregrinos passaram por aqui para rezar aos deuses. Ironicamente, você está passando por essa estrada para derrotar um deus.
raw.th: ถนนของนักบุญ นานมาแล้ว เหล่านักบุญเดินผ่านทางนี้เพื่อสวดอ้อนวอนต่อเทพ ตลกนะที่เจ้าก็ใช้ถนนเส้นนี้ แต่เพื่อไปกำราบเทพ
raw.vi: Đường hành hương. Rất lâu trước đây, khách hành hương đã đi qua đây để cầu xin các vị thần. Trớ trêu thay, ngươi đang dùng con đường này để đánh bại một vị thần.

id: Akhir jalan sudah dekat. Kekuatan super terasa keluar dari sana. Musuh bersembunyi di sana kemungkinan besar adalah halangan terakhirmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1345_DESCRIPTION
desc: The end of the road is near. A strong power can be felt coming from it. The enemy lurking there will most likely be your last obstacle here.

raw.en: The end of the road is near. A strong power can be felt coming from it. The enemy lurking there will most likely be your last obstacle here.
raw.es: El final del camino está cerca. Sientes un gran poder que viene de ahí. Es probable que el enemigo que merodea ese lugar sea tu último obstáculo aquí.
raw.id: Akhir jalan sudah dekat. Kekuatan super terasa keluar dari sana. Musuh bersembunyi di sana kemungkinan besar adalah halangan terakhirmu.
raw.pt: O fim da estrada está próximo. Um grande poder pode ser sentido vindo dela. O inimigo que espreita por aqui provavelmente será seu último adversário do lugar.
raw.th: ทางสุดถนนอยู่ใกล้ๆ นี้แล้ว ยังสามารถรู้สึกถึงพลังที่แข็งแกร่ง ศัตรูคงจะหลบซุ่มอยู่ที่นั้นคงจะเป็นอุปสรรคสุดท้าย
raw.vi: Điểm cuối con đường đã hiện ra. Có thể được cảm nhận một sức mạnh cường đại từ nó. Kẻ thù rình rập nơi đó nhiều khả năng sẽ là trở ngại cuối cùng của ngươi ở đây.

id: Kau terpukau oleh struktur raksasa bak kastel si Afla Dilith. Namun semuanya mengandalkanmu, jadi tidak bisa buang-buang waktu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1350_DESCRIPTION
desc: You are overwhelmed by the gigantic stature of the castle-like Afla Dilith. However, everyone is counting on you, so there's no time to waste.

raw.en: You are overwhelmed by the gigantic stature of the castle-like Afla Dilith. However, everyone is counting on you, so there's no time to waste.
raw.es: Te abruma la estatura gigantesca de la estructura en la que ha mutado Afla Dilith. Todos cuentan contigo, así que no desperdicies tu tiempo.
raw.id: Kau terpukau oleh struktur raksasa bak kastel si Afla Dilith. Namun semuanya mengandalkanmu, jadi tidak bisa buang-buang waktu.
raw.pt: Você fica espantado com a estatura gigantesca de Afla Dilith. No entanto, todos estão contando com você, então não há tempo a perder.
raw.th: เจ้ากำลังสับสนและเกรงกลัวกับชื่อเสียงที่ยิ่งใหญ่ของปราสาทอัฟลา ดิลิธ อย่างไรก็ตาม ทุกๆ คนตั้งความหวังไว้กับเจ้า ไม่มีเวลาจะเสียแล้ว
raw.vi: Ngươi đang bị choáng ngợp bởi chiều cao khổng lồ như một lâu đài của Afla Dilith. Tuy nhiên, mọi người đang trông chờ ở ngươi, đừng để phí thời gian.

id: Masih banyak musuh dalam jalan menuju kastel. Pastinya Karl dkk harus menghadapi lebih banyak lagi selagi kau maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1351_DESCRIPTION
desc: There are still many enemies left on the way to the castle. Surely Karl and the others will have to face even more of them as you move on ahead.

raw.en: There are still many enemies left on the way to the castle. Surely Karl and the others will have to face even more of them as you move on ahead.
raw.es: Todavía quedan muchos enemigos de camino al castillo. Está claro que Karl y los demás se las tendrán que enfrentar con muchos más esbirros que tú.
raw.id: Masih banyak musuh dalam jalan menuju kastel. Pastinya Karl dkk harus menghadapi lebih banyak lagi selagi kau maju.
raw.pt: Ainda há muitos inimigos restantes no caminho até o castelo. Com certeza Karl e os outros vão ter que enfrentar mais deles ainda enquanto você avança.
raw.th: ยังมีศัตรูมากมายก่อนที่จะถึงปราสาท แน่นอนว่าคาร์ลและคนอื่นๆ ที่ตามมาทีหลังจะต้องต่อสู้มากกว่านี้
raw.vi: Trên đường đến lâu đài vẫn còn rất nhiều kẻ thù. Chắc chắn Karl và những người khác sẽ phải đối mặt với chúng thậm chí còn nhiều hơn khi ngươi tiến về phía trước.

id: Suara sekutumu bertempur di belakangmu semakin keras. Maju menuju kastel selagi semua orang menarik perhatian musuh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1352_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sound of your allies fighting behind you grows louder. Head towards the castle while everyone else draws the enemies' attention.

raw.en: The sound of your allies fighting behind you grows louder. Head towards the castle while everyone else draws the enemies' attention.
raw.es: El sonido de tus aliados en la lucha se hace más intenso. Adéntrate en el castillo mientras los demás captan la atención de los enemigos.
raw.id: Suara sekutumu bertempur di belakangmu semakin keras. Maju menuju kastel selagi semua orang menarik perhatian musuh.
raw.pt: O som dos seus aliados lutando mais atrás fica mais alto. Siga até o castelo enquanto os outros chamam a atenção dos inimigos.
raw.th: เสียงของเพื่อนร่วมต่อสู้จากข้างหลังเริ่มดังขึ้น รีบเดินทางเข้าปราสาทตอนที่ศัตรูกำลังสนใจกับเสียงนั้น
raw.vi: Âm thanh từ đồng minh của ngươi đang chiến đấu ở phía sau dội đến càng lớn hơn. Hãy đi về phía lâu đài trong khi những người khác đang thu hút sự chú ý của kẻ thù.

id: Musuh di jalanmu semakin bertambah kuat. Artinya target terakhirmu semakin dekat. Gerbang kastel sudah di depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1353_DESCRIPTION
desc: The enemies in your path continue getting stronger. It can only mean that your last target is drawing near. The castle's gates should be just ahead.

raw.en: The enemies in your path continue getting stronger. It can only mean that your last target is drawing near. The castle's gates should be just ahead.
raw.es: Tus enemigos no dejan de fortalecerse. Esto significa que tu objetivo final está cerca. Las puertas del castillo deben estar delante.
raw.id: Musuh di jalanmu semakin bertambah kuat. Artinya target terakhirmu semakin dekat. Gerbang kastel sudah di depan.
raw.pt: Os inimigos no seu caminho continuam ficando mais fortes. Isso só pode significar que o seu último alvo está se aproximando. Os portões do castelo devem estar logo adiante.
raw.th: ศัตรูที่เจอเริ่มแข็งแกร่งขึ้นเรื่อยๆ มันหมายความว่า ศัตรูตัวสุดท้ายก็เข้ามาใกล้เรื่อยๆ ประตูเข้าปราสาทน่าจะอยู่ใกล้ๆ นี้
raw.vi: Những kẻ thù trên con đường của ngươi đang tiếp tục trở nên mạnh hơn. Điều đó chỉ có thể có nghĩa là mục tiêu cuối cùng của ngươi đang ở rất gần. Cổng lâu đài có lẽ đang ở phía trước rồi.

id: Kastel sudah dekat sekali, dan hawa dewa sakti semakin kuat. Tidak ada waktu untuk gentar. Melangkah masuk.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1354_DESCRIPTION
desc: The castle is within a stone's throw, and the god's powerful presence grows stronger. However, it's no time to buckle under pressure. Step inside.

raw.en: The castle is within a stone's throw, and the god's powerful presence grows stronger. However, it's no time to buckle under pressure. Step inside.
raw.es: Estás a tiro de piedra del castillo y la fuerte presencia del dios se intensifica. Pero este no es momento de ceder ante la presión. Adelante.
raw.id: Kastel sudah dekat sekali, dan hawa dewa sakti semakin kuat. Tidak ada waktu untuk gentar. Melangkah masuk.
raw.pt: O castelo está a apenas alguns metros e a presença poderosa do deus se intensifica. Mas não é hora de ceder à pressão. Entre no castelo.
raw.th: ปราสาทอยู่แค่เอื้อมมือ และสามารถรู้สึกถึงพลังของเทพมากกว่าเดิม แต่ไม่มีเวลามากังวลแล้ว บุกเข้าไปเลย
raw.vi: Lâu đài chỉ còn cách một quãng ngắn và sức mạnh hiện diện của thần thánh trở nên mạnh hơn. Tuy nhiên, chẳng có thời gian để oằn mình dưới áp lực. Hãy tránh ra một bên.

id: Segerombolan musuh menghadang di depan gerbang. Jika bisa melewati mereka, kau akhirnya akan berada di dalam Afla Dilith!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1355_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see the last hoard of enemies in front of the gate. If you can get past them, you will finally be inside Afla Dilith!

raw.en: You can see the last hoard of enemies in front of the gate. If you can get past them, you will finally be inside Afla Dilith!
raw.es: Puedes ver a la última horda de enemigos frente a la puerta. Si logras superarlos, finalmente estarás dentro de Afla Dilith.
raw.id: Segerombolan musuh menghadang di depan gerbang. Jika bisa melewati mereka, kau akhirnya akan berada di dalam Afla Dilith!
raw.pt: Você pode ver a última horda de inimigos na frente do portão. Se conseguir passar por ela, finalmente entrará em Afla Dilith!
raw.th: เจ้าสามารถมองเห็นกลุ่มศัตรูมากหน้าประตู ถ้าสามารถผ่านไปได้ ก็จะถือว่าเข้าสู่ปราสาทของอัฟลา ดิลิธ
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể thấy chỗ ẩn nấp cuối cùng của kẻ thù ở trước cổng vào. Nếu ngươi có thể vượt qua chúng thì cuối cùng ngươi sẽ vào được bên trong Afla Dilith!

id: Tilith, Karl, semuanya... Kau mengkhawatirkan kawan-kawan yang bertempur di belakang. Tidak boleh berbalik sekarang. Terus maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1360_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tilith, Karl, everyone... You're worried about the friends you left behind fighting. However, there's no turning back now. You must press forward.

raw.en: Tilith, Karl, everyone... You're worried about the friends you left behind fighting. However, there's no turning back now. You must press forward.
raw.es: Tilith, Karl, todos... Te preocupas por los amigos que están peleando detrás de ti. Sin embargo, no puedes regresar. Debes seguir avanzando.
raw.id: Tilith, Karl, semuanya... Kau mengkhawatirkan kawan-kawan yang bertempur di belakang. Tidak boleh berbalik sekarang. Terus maju.
raw.pt: Tilith, Karl, todo mundo... Você se preocupa com os amigos que deixou lutando lá atrás. Mas agora não há mais volta. Você precisa seguir em frente.
raw.th: ทิลิธ คาร์ล และทุกๆ คน เจ้ากำลังเป็นห่วงเพื่อนๆ ที่กำลังต้องสู้อยู่ อย่างไรก็ตาม ไม่มีการถอยหลังแล้ว เจ้าต้องเดินหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Tilith, Karl, mọi người... Ngươi đang lo lắng về những người bạn ngươi đã bỏ lại sau trận chiến. Tuy nhiên, không được quay lại vào lúc này. Ngươi phải dấn bước về phía trước.

id: Melihat isi kastel, tidak ada yang aneh. Kalau tanpa penghalang dari Tilith yang melindungimu, kau mungkin terjebak Afla Dilith.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1361_DESCRIPTION
desc: Looking inside the castle, nothing really seems out of place. Although without Tilith's protective barrier, you might have fallen prey to Afla Dilith.

raw.en: Looking inside the castle, nothing really seems out of place. Although without Tilith's protective barrier, you might have fallen prey to Afla Dilith.
raw.es: Miras dentro del castillo y parece que está todo en su lugar. Aunque sin la barrera protectora de Tilith, podrías haber sido presa de Afla Dilith.
raw.id: Melihat isi kastel, tidak ada yang aneh. Kalau tanpa penghalang dari Tilith yang melindungimu, kau mungkin terjebak Afla Dilith.
raw.pt: Ao olhar para dentro do castelo, nada parece muito fora de lugar. Mas sem a barreira protetora de Tilith, você pode se tornar vítima de Afla Dilith.
raw.th: มองเข้าไปในประสาท ทุกอย่างดูปกติดี แต่ตอนนี้ไม่มีเขตป้องกันของธิลิทแล้ว เจ้าอาจจะตกหลุมกับดักของอัฟลา ดิลิธ
raw.vi: Nhìn bên trong lâu đài, chẳng có gì dường như không ổn. Dẫu không có hàng rào bảo vệ của Tilith nhưng ngươi có thể đã trở thành con mồi của Afla Dilith.

id: Suara Tilith bertarung di pintu masuk sudah terdengar. Terinspirasi atas keberaniannya, kakimu berlari dengan kecepatan penuh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1362_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can hear Tilith fighting from the entrance. Inspired by her courage, your feet rush forward at full speed!

raw.en: You can hear Tilith fighting from the entrance. Inspired by her courage, your feet rush forward at full speed!
raw.es: Puedes oír a Tilith luchando desde la entrada. Su valor te inspira y arremetes a toda la velocidad.
raw.id: Suara Tilith bertarung di pintu masuk sudah terdengar. Terinspirasi atas keberaniannya, kakimu berlari dengan kecepatan penuh.
raw.pt: Você pode ouvir Tilith lutando da entrada. Inspirado pela coragem dela, seus pés avançam a toda velocidade!
raw.th: เจ้าสามารถได้ยินเสียงธิลิท ที่กำลังต่อสู้อยู่หน้าปราสาท รู้สึกถึงความกล้าหาญของเธอ เท้าของเจ้าวิ่งเต็มกำลัง
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể nghe thấy Tilith đang chiến đấu từ cửa ra vào. Được tiếp thêm sức mạnh bởi lòng dũng cảm của nàng, đôi chân của ngươi vội vàng tiến về trước hết tốc lực!

id: Selagi kau semakin masuk, suara perang di pintu masuk semakin samar. Kau masih bisa merasakan penghalang dari Tilith melindungimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1363_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you proceed further in, the sounds of battle coming from the entrance disappear. You can still feel Tilith's barrier protecting you, though.

raw.en: As you proceed further in, the sounds of battle coming from the entrance disappear. You can still feel Tilith's barrier protecting you, though.
raw.es: A medida que sigues avanzando, los sonidos de la batalla de la entrada desaparecen. Aún puedes sentir la protección de la barrera de Tilith.
raw.id: Selagi kau semakin masuk, suara perang di pintu masuk semakin samar. Kau masih bisa merasakan penghalang dari Tilith melindungimu.
raw.pt: Enquanto você segue mais para dentro, os sons da batalha da entrada desaparecem. Mas você ainda consegue sentir a barreira de Tilith o protegendo.
raw.th: เมื่อเจ้าเดินหน้าต่อไป เสียงการต่อสู้หน้าปราสาทก็จางหายไป แต่เจ้ายังรู้สึกถึงพลังอาณาเขตป้องกันของธิลิท
raw.vi: Khi ngươi tiến sâu thêm vào trong, âm thanh trận chiến vọng đến từ lối vào không còn nữa. Thế nhưng ngươi vẫn có thể cảm thấy rào chắn của Tilith đang bảo vệ ngươi.

id: Kau berhasil melewati bagian besar benteng. Setelah koridor ini, ada pusatnya. Tubuh sejati Dewa Sesat mungkin di sana.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1364_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've made your way through a big portion of the fortress. Past this corridor lies its center. The real body of the Fallen God is probably there.

raw.en: You've made your way through a big portion of the fortress. Past this corridor lies its center. The real body of the Fallen God is probably there.
raw.es: Has atravesado gran parte de la fortaleza. Luego de este pasillo, llegarás al centro. Probablemente, el verdadero cuerpo del Dios caído esté ahí.
raw.id: Kau berhasil melewati bagian besar benteng. Setelah koridor ini, ada pusatnya. Tubuh sejati Dewa Sesat mungkin di sana.
raw.pt: Você passou por grande parte do forte. Além deste corredor está o centro. O verdadeiro corpo do Deus Caído deve estar lá.
raw.th: เจ้าเดินผ่านกำแพงมากมาย แต่เดินทางประตูใหญ่ที่ตั้งอยู่ตรงกลาง ตัวตนเทพที่แท้จริงอาจจะอยู่ในนี้
raw.vi: Ngươi đã làm được theo cách của mình xuyên qua gần hết pháo đài. Qua hành lang này là trung tâm pháo đài. Cơ thể thực sự của Bốn Vị Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần có lẽ nằm ở đây.

id: Kau keluar, memasuki kamar yang tercakup dalam akar pohon. Langkah berikutnya akan membawamu ke jantung kastel, tapi pahlawan gelap memblokir jalan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1365_DESCRIPTION
desc: You exit into a room enveloped in tree roots. The next step should lead you to the heart of the castle, but a dark hero blocks your path.

raw.en: You exit into a room enveloped in tree roots. The next step should lead you to the heart of the castle, but a dark hero blocks your path.
raw.es: Entras a un cuarto cubierto por raíces de árboles. El siguiente paso debería llevarte al corazón del castillo, pero un héroe oscuro bloquea el camino.
raw.id: Kau keluar, memasuki kamar yang tercakup dalam akar pohon. Langkah berikutnya akan membawamu ke jantung kastel, tapi pahlawan gelap memblokir jalan.
raw.pt: Você entra em uma sala envolta em raízes de árvores. O próximo passo deve levar você ao coração do castelo, mas um herói sombrio bloqueia seu caminho.
raw.th: เจ้าเดินเข้าห้องที่ปกคลุมไปด้วยรากไม้ ห้องถัดไปน่าจะเป็นห้องใจกลางของประสาท แต่มีดาร์ค ฮีโร่ปกป้องทางไปอยู่
raw.vi: Ngươi thoát vào một căn phòng được bao phủ bởi rễ cây. Bước tiếp theo sẽ dẫn ngươi đến trái tim của lâu đài, nhưng một anh hùng hắc ám sẽ chặn ngươi lại.

id: Tiba saatnya untuk pertarungan akhir yang sebenarnya melawan Dewa Sesat terakhir, Dewa Beast Afla Dilith. Kalahkan dia dan kembalilah ke teman-teman!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1366_DESCRIPTION
desc: The time for the real final fight with the last Fallen God, the Beast God Afla Dilith, has come... Defeat him and return to your friends!

raw.en: The time for the real final fight with the last Fallen God, the Beast God Afla Dilith, has come... Defeat him and return to your friends!
raw.es: Ha llegado el momento de la batalla final contra el último Dios caído, el dios bestial Afla Dilith... ¡Derrótalo y vuelve con tus amigos!
raw.id: Tiba saatnya untuk pertarungan akhir yang sebenarnya melawan Dewa Sesat terakhir, Dewa Beast Afla Dilith. Kalahkan dia dan kembalilah ke teman-teman!
raw.pt: Chegou a hora da verdadeira batalha final com o último Deus Caído, o Deus Fera, Afla Dilith... Derrote-o e volte para seus amigos!
raw.th: ถึงเวลาต่อสู้กันเทพตัวสุดท้าย เทพมาร อัฟลา ดิลิธมาถึงแล้ว กำราบมันและกลับไปหาเพื่อนๆ ของเจ้า
raw.vi: Đã đến lúc diễn ra trận chiến cuối thực sự với vị Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần sau cùng, Thú Thần Afla Dilith... Hãy đánh bại hắn và quay về với bạn bè của ngươi!

id: Setelah mengunjungi kuil untuk kedua kalinya, kau merasa mendengar suara nyanyian gadis muda. Lagunya membuat ombak ganas lenyap seperti buih lautan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1370_DESCRIPTION
desc: After visiting the temple a second time, you think you hear the voice of a young girl singing. Her song made the rough waves vanish like the sea foam.

raw.en: After visiting the temple a second time, you think you hear the voice of a young girl singing. Her song made the rough waves vanish like the sea foam.
raw.es: Luego de visitar el templo por segunda vez, crees oír la voz de una joven cantando. Su canción hizo que las feroces olas desaparecieran como espuma.
raw.id: Setelah mengunjungi kuil untuk kedua kalinya, kau merasa mendengar suara nyanyian gadis muda. Lagunya membuat ombak ganas lenyap seperti buih lautan.
raw.pt: Depois de visitar o templo uma segunda vez, você pensa ter ouvido a voz de uma jovem cantando. A canção dela fez com que as ondas revoltas sumissem como a espuma no mar.
raw.th: หลังจากที่มาวัดนี้เป็นครั้งที่สอง เจ้าคิดว่า เจ้าได้ยินเสียงเด็กผู้หญิงร้องเพลง เสียงไพเราะมากจนกระทั่งความกังวลทุกอย่างได้หายไป
raw.vi: Sau khi viếng thăm ngôi đền trong ít giây, ngươi ngỡ như nghe thấy tiếng hát của một cô gái trẻ. Bài hát của nàng đã làm những con sóng dữ dội tan biến như bọt biển.

id: Raungan yang membuat bulu kuduk berdiri terdengar. Sepertinya banyak monster yang diam di kota ini, jadi tidak bisa keluar dengan mudah dari sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1400_DESCRIPTION
desc: A hair raising howling can be heard. It looks like many monsters seem to inhabit this town, so there seems to be no easy escape from here.

raw.en: A hair raising howling can be heard. It looks like many monsters seem to inhabit this town, so there seems to be no easy escape from here.
raw.es: Se oye un aullido espeluznante. Parece que muchos monstruos habitan esta ciudad, así que no será fácil escapar.
raw.id: Raungan yang membuat bulu kuduk berdiri terdengar. Sepertinya banyak monster yang diam di kota ini, jadi tidak bisa keluar dengan mudah dari sini.
raw.pt: Um uivo arrepiante pode ser ouvido. Parece que muitos monstros vivem nesta cidade, então não deve haver fuga fácil daqui.
raw.th: ต้องขนลุกเมื่อได้ยินเสียงเห่าหอน ดูเหมือนมอนสเตอร์ทั้งหลายจะเข้ามาอยู่ในเมืองนี้ และคงไม่ง่ายที่จะหนีออกไป
raw.vi: Có thể nghe được tiếng hú từ mái tóc dựng đứng. Dường như lũ quái chiếm cứ thị trấn này quá nhiều nên thoát khỏi đây chẳng hề dễ dàng chút nào.

id: Suara nyanyian merdu terdengar di udara. Apa ini berasal dari setan juga? Dan kenapa banyak sekali monster yang berkumpul di kota ini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1401_DESCRIPTION
desc: A beautiful singing voice lingers in the air. Could this be the work of a demon as well? And why have so many monsters gathered in this ghost town?

raw.en: A beautiful singing voice lingers in the air. Could this be the work of a demon as well? And why have so many monsters gathered in this ghost town?
raw.es: Una hermosa voz atraviesa el aire. ¿Será, acaso, obra de un demonio? Además, ¿por qué tantos monstruos se han agrupado en esta ciudad fantasma?
raw.id: Suara nyanyian merdu terdengar di udara. Apa ini berasal dari setan juga? Dan kenapa banyak sekali monster yang berkumpul di kota ini?
raw.pt: Uma bela voz cantante paira no ar. Será que é trabalho de um demônio também? E por que tantos monstros se juntaram nesta cidade fantasma?
raw.th: เสียงร้องอันไพเราะลอยมาในอากาศ นี่เป็นเสียงของปีศาจใช่มั้ย? แล้วทำไมถึงมีมอนสเตอร์อยู่ในเมืองผีมากขนาดนี้?
raw.vi: Một giọng hát đẹp vẫn còn vang vọng trong không trung. Phải chăng đó cũng là tác phẩm của một con quỷ? Và tại sao có rất nhiều quái vật tập trung tại thị trấn ma quái này?

id: Sangat aneh. Tidak peduli seberapa jauh kamu maju, kamu tetap balik ke tempat asal. Seperti yang pernah terjadi di hutan para peri.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1402_DESCRIPTION
desc: How strange. No matter how much you advance, you keep finding yourself back where you started. It's like being in the fairies' grove all over again.

raw.en: How strange. No matter how much you advance, you keep finding yourself back where you started. It's like being in the fairies' grove all over again.
raw.es: Qué extraño. Sin importar lo mucho que avances, siempre te encuentras en el lugar donde empezaste. Es como estar en la arboleda de las hadas otra vez.
raw.id: Sangat aneh. Tidak peduli seberapa jauh kamu maju, kamu tetap balik ke tempat asal. Seperti yang pernah terjadi di hutan para peri.
raw.pt: Que estranho. Não importa o quanto avança, você continua voltando para o ponto de partida. É como estar de volta ao recanto das fadas.
raw.th: แปลกจริง ไม่ว่าเจ้าจะเก่งขึ้นแค่ไหน ก็ยังจำตัวเองในตอนแรกเริ่มได้เสมอ หรือนี่จะอยู่ในสวนแห่งภูติเหมือนทุกๆ ครั้ง
raw.vi: Thật lạ lùng. Dù ngươi vượt lên trước bao nhiêu, ngươi vẫn thấy mình quay lại nơi ngươi đã bắt đầu. Giống như cứ quanh quẩn trong khu rừng của các nàng tiên.

id: Banyak sekali musuh. Apa yang membuat mereka datang? Selagi kamu berpikir, suara yang tajam dan menggelegar terdengar di sekitarmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1403_DESCRIPTION
desc: There are too many enemies. What could've led them here? As you think that to yourself, a piercing and thunderous sound resonates around you.

raw.en: There are too many enemies. What could've led them here? As you think that to yourself, a piercing and thunderous sound resonates around you.
raw.es: Hay demasiados enemigos. ¿Qué los habrá atraído hasta aquí? Mientras lo piensas, un sonido desgarrador y estruendoso resuena alrededor de ti.
raw.id: Banyak sekali musuh. Apa yang membuat mereka datang? Selagi kamu berpikir, suara yang tajam dan menggelegar terdengar di sekitarmu.
raw.pt: Há inimigos demais. O que pode tê-los atraído? Enquanto você pensa sobre isso sozinho, um som perfurante e estrondoso ressoa ao redor.
raw.th: มีศัตรูมากเกินไป ใครเรียกมันมาที่นี่? ลองคิดว่าเป็นเจ้าดูสิ มีเสียงสายฟ้าแทรกอยู่รอบๆ ตัวเจ้า
raw.vi: Có quá nhiều kẻ thù. Thứ gì đã khiến chúng kéo đến đây? Khi nghĩ đến điều đó, một âm thanh như sấm rền xuyên thấu tai ngươi.

id: Ringkikan seekor Pegasus terdengar di telingamu, suara suci yang tidak cocok dengan kota hantu ini. Perang dengan para gadis menunggumu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1404_DESCRIPTION
desc: The neigh of a Pegasus reaches your ears, a pure sound ill-fitted for this ghost town. A battle with the maidens awaits ahead.

raw.en: The neigh of a Pegasus reaches your ears, a pure sound ill-fitted for this ghost town. A battle with the maidens awaits ahead.
raw.es: El relincho de un Pegaso llega a tus oídos, un sonido puro y no compatible con esta ciudad fantasma. Te espera una batalla contra las doncellas.
raw.id: Ringkikan seekor Pegasus terdengar di telingamu, suara suci yang tidak cocok dengan kota hantu ini. Perang dengan para gadis menunggumu.
raw.pt: O relinchar de um pégaso chega a seus ouvidos, um som puro que não combina com esta cidade fantasma. Uma batalha com as damas aguarda adiante.
raw.th: เสียงของเปกาซัสแล่นเข้าหู เสียงอันบริสุทธิ์ในเมืองผี การต่อสู้กับเทพธิดารออยู่เบื้องหน้าแล้ว
raw.vi: Tiếng hí của Ngựa thần vọng đến tai ngươi, một âm thanh thuần khiết chẳng hợp tí nào với thành phố ma này. Một trận chiến với các thánh nữ đang chờ đợi phía trước.

id: Kamu bisa merasakan lebih banyak musuh yang menghalangi jalanmu sekarang. Kalau kamu beruntung, mengalahkan mereka adalah tiketmu keluar dari sini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1405_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can feel many more enemies obstructing your way now. If you're lucky enough, defeating the last hoard of them might be your ticket out of here.

raw.en: You can feel many more enemies obstructing your way now. If you're lucky enough, defeating the last hoard of them might be your ticket out of here.
raw.es: Puedes sentir que más enemigos te bloquean el camino. Derrotar a la última horda quizá sea tu boleto de salida para escapar de este lugar.
raw.id: Kamu bisa merasakan lebih banyak musuh yang menghalangi jalanmu sekarang. Kalau kamu beruntung, mengalahkan mereka adalah tiketmu keluar dari sini.
raw.pt: Você pode sentir muito mais inimigos bloqueando seu caminho agora. Se tiver sorte, derrotar a última horda deles pode ser sua passagem para fugir daqui.
raw.th: สัมผัสได้ถึงศัตรูจำนวนมากที่ขวางอยู่ ถ้าโชคดีพอ หากกำจัดศัตรูตัวสุดท้ายสำเร็จก็คงออกจากที่นี่ได้
raw.vi: Ngươi cảm nhận được thêm nhiều kẻ thù đang chặn ngươi lúc này. Nếu đủ may mắn, chiếm được kho báu cuối cùng của chúng có thể là tấm vé để ngươi thoát khỏi đây.

id: Kamu bisa melihat padang pasir luas di hadapanmu. Sepertinya tak berujung, tapi kamu harus mengambil jalan sulit ini untuk tetap maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1410_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see a vast desert in front of you. There seems to be no end to it, but you must take this cruel path in order to move forward.

raw.en: You can see a vast desert in front of you. There seems to be no end to it, but you must take this cruel path in order to move forward.
raw.es: Frente a ti puedes ver un vasto desierto. Parece que no tiene fin, pero debes tomar este cruel camino para seguir avanzando.
raw.id: Kamu bisa melihat padang pasir luas di hadapanmu. Sepertinya tak berujung, tapi kamu harus mengambil jalan sulit ini untuk tetap maju.
raw.pt: Você pode ver um vasto deserto adiante. Parece que ele não tem fim, mas é preciso passar por este caminho cruel para seguir em frente.
raw.th: คุณเห็นทะเลทรายกว้างใหญ่เบื้องหน้า ไม่มีจุดสิ้นสุด แต่ก็ต้องผ่านเส้นทางอันดหดร้ายนี้เพื่อมุ่งหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể thấy một sa mạc rộng lớn ở phía trước. Dường như nó là vô tận, nhưng ngươi phải đi con đường khắc nghiệt này để tiến về trước.

id: Kamu memastikan lokasi matahari agar tidak tersesat. Tidak sabar dan badan yang hampir mendidih, tetesan besar keringat jatuh dari dahimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1411_DESCRIPTION
desc: You confirm the sun's location to avoid losing your way. Short on patience and with your body almost boiling, beads of sweat fall from your forehead.

raw.en: You confirm the sun's location to avoid losing your way. Short on patience and with your body almost boiling, beads of sweat fall from your forehead.
raw.es: Confirmas la posición del sol para no perderte. Te queda poca paciencia y tienes el cuerpo al rojo vivo. Las gotas de sudor caen de tu frente.
raw.id: Kamu memastikan lokasi matahari agar tidak tersesat. Tidak sabar dan badan yang hampir mendidih, tetesan besar keringat jatuh dari dahimu.
raw.pt: Você confirma a localização do sol para evitar se perder. Com pouca paciência e com o corpo quase cozinhando, pingos de suor caem da sua testa.
raw.th: ดูพระอาทิตย์ไว้เพื่อไม่ให้หลงทาง แม้ร่างกายเหมือนจะถูกต้ม และเหงื่อไหล่ท่วมจากหน้าผากก็ตาม
raw.vi: Ngươi xác nhận vị trí mặt trời để tránh lạc lối. Ngươi chẳng còn kiên nhẫn và cả người như nóng bừng, mồ hôi nhỏ thành giọt từ trán.

id: Gumpalan pasir mulai menutupi bajumu. Kamu menelan butiran halus pasir yang terbawa angin lewat napasmu. Padang pasir bukanlah kesukaanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1412_DESCRIPTION
desc: A cloud of sand starts covering your clothes. You swallow the fine pieces of sand the wind picks up as you breathe. Deserts are still not your forte.

raw.en: A cloud of sand starts covering your clothes. You swallow the fine pieces of sand the wind picks up as you breathe. Deserts are still not your forte.
raw.es: Una nube de arena cubre tus prendas. Cuando respiras, tragas las finas partículas de arena que el viento levanta. Los desiertos no son tu fuerte.
raw.id: Gumpalan pasir mulai menutupi bajumu. Kamu menelan butiran halus pasir yang terbawa angin lewat napasmu. Padang pasir bukanlah kesukaanmu.
raw.pt: Uma nuvem de areia começa a cobrir suas roupas. Ao respirar, você engole os pequenos grãos de areia que o vento carrega. Desertos não são seus lugares favoritos.
raw.th: เริ่มมีทรายปกคลุมเสื้อผ้า ก็ยังอดทนเดินต่อไปขณะที่ยังหายใจ ทะเลทรายเป็นสถานที่ที่ไม่เหมาะกับคุณเลย
raw.vi: Một đám mây cát bắt đầu bao phủ quần áo của ngươi. Ngươi nuốt phải những hạt cát mịn lúc hít thở bởi gió cuốn lên. Sa mạc vẫn không phải là sở trường của ngươi.

id: Karena sinar matahari yang semakin terik, kabut panas mulai naik dari tanah. Jauh di depan fatamorgana yang goyah, terlihat bayangan musuh yang seram.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1413_DESCRIPTION
desc: As the sunshine gets hotter, heat haze begins to rise from beneath. Beyond the shaky mirage in front of you, you spy the creeping shadow of the enemy.

raw.en: As the sunshine gets hotter, heat haze begins to rise from beneath. Beyond the shaky mirage in front of you, you spy the creeping shadow of the enemy.
raw.es: El sol se hace más fuerte y una niebla cálida se alza desde el suelo. Tras el trémulo espejismo frente a ti, detectas la artera sombra enemiga.
raw.id: Karena sinar matahari yang semakin terik, kabut panas mulai naik dari tanah. Jauh di depan fatamorgana yang goyah, terlihat bayangan musuh yang seram.
raw.pt: Quando o sol fica mais quente, a névoa do calor começa a subir. Além da miragem tremida que você vê adiante, também é possível ver a sombra do inimigo.
raw.th: เมื่อแสงแดดแรงกล้าขึ้น ความร้อนเพิ่มขึ้น เกิดปรากฎการณ์มิราจเบื้องหน้า คุณตามเงาของศัตรูไป
raw.vi: Khi ánh nắng nóng gắt hơn, hơi nhiệt bắt đầu bốc lên từ bên dưới. Vượt qua ảo ảnh run rẩy trước mặt, ngươi lần theo vết bóng kẻ thù.

id: Di atas, cakrawala yang biru, panas tak berawan, di bawah pasir kuning. Selagi kamu menoleh ke belakang, semuanya jadi gelap. Badai pasir akan datang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1414_DESCRIPTION
desc: A cloudless, blue firmament above, and scorching, yellow sand beneath. As you look behind you, everything grows darker. A sandstorm is on its way.

raw.en: A cloudless, blue firmament above, and scorching, yellow sand beneath. As you look behind you, everything grows darker. A sandstorm is on its way.
raw.es: Arriba, un cielo azul y despejado. Abajo, arena amarilla y abrasadora. Miras atrás y todo se vuelve más oscuro. Se acerca una tormenta de arena.
raw.id: Di atas, cakrawala yang biru, panas tak berawan, di bawah pasir kuning. Selagi kamu menoleh ke belakang, semuanya jadi gelap. Badai pasir akan datang.
raw.pt: Um céu azul e sem nuvens acima e uma areia amarela e escaldante abaixo. Quando você olha para trás, tudo vai ficando escuro. Uma tempestade de areia está vindo.
raw.th: ไม่มีเมฆ มีเพียงผืนฟ้าสีคราม และทรายเบื้องล่าง เมื่อมองกลับไปด้านหลัง ทุกอย่างเต็มไปด้วยความดำมืด พายุทรายกำลังจะมา
raw.vi: Trên cao trời xanh thẳm chẳng gợn mây, dưới này cát vàng thiêu đốt. Khi ngươi nhìn lại phía sau mình, mọi thứ trở nên tối tăm hơn. Một cơn bão cát sắp đến.

id: Setelah meninggalkan padang pasir itu, kamu mencapai sungai yang sangat besar sehingga tepinya tak terlihat. Butuh usaha besar untuk menyeberanginya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1420_DESCRIPTION
desc: After leaving the great the desert behind, you come across a river so big that the shore seems invisible. It will take a lot of effort to cross it.

raw.en: After leaving the great the desert behind, you come across a river so big that the shore seems invisible. It will take a lot of effort to cross it.
raw.es: Tras dejar el gran desierto, te encuentras con un río tan grande que casi no se ve la orilla. Tendrás que esforzarte mucho para cruzarlo.
raw.id: Setelah meninggalkan padang pasir itu, kamu mencapai sungai yang sangat besar sehingga tepinya tak terlihat. Butuh usaha besar untuk menyeberanginya.
raw.pt: Depois de deixar o grande deserto para trás, você se depara com um rio tão grande que a margem parece invisível. Atravessá-lo vai exigir um grande esforço.
raw.th: หลังออกมาจากทะเลทรายได้ คุณข้ามแม่น้ำกว้างที่มองไม่เห็นฝั่ง คงต้องใช้ความพยายามสูงในการก้าวผ่านไป
raw.vi: Sau khi bỏ lại đại sa mạc phía sau, ngươi vượt qua một con sông rất lớn chẳng thấy bến bờ. Sẽ mất rất nhiều công sức để vượt qua nó.

id: Kadang, ikan sungai lompat sangat tinggi. Terkejut, kamu akhirnya melihat musuh mendekat. Kamu sadar sekarang kalau ikan itu mencoba memperingatkanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1421_DESCRIPTION
desc: At times, the river fish jump high up. Surprised by the sound, you finally see the enemy closing in. You realize now the fish were trying to warn you.

raw.en: At times, the river fish jump high up. Surprised by the sound, you finally see the enemy closing in. You realize now the fish were trying to warn you.
raw.es: A veces, los peces saltan del agua. Sorprendido por el sonido, ves a tus enemigos acercándose. Te das cuenta de que los peces querían alertarte.
raw.id: Kadang, ikan sungai lompat sangat tinggi. Terkejut, kamu akhirnya melihat musuh mendekat. Kamu sadar sekarang kalau ikan itu mencoba memperingatkanmu.
raw.pt: Às vezes os peixes do rio pulam bem alto. Surpreso com o som, você finalmente vê o inimigo se aproximando. Agora você percebe que os peixes tentavam alertar.
raw.th: ในตอนนี้ ปลาในแม่น้ำกระโจนขึ้นสูง มีเสียงอันน่าตกใจเมื่อคุณเห็นศัตรูใกล้เข้ามา คุณรู้ในทันทีว่าปลาพวกนั้นพยายามจะเตือนคุณ
raw.vi: Đôi khi, lũ cá sông nhảy vọt lên mặt nước. Ngạc nhiên bởi âm thanh đó, cuối cùng ngươi nhìn thấy kẻ thù đang kề bên. Ngươi nhận ra nãy giờ lũ cá đang cố gắng cảnh báo ngươi.

id: Setengah perjalanan menyeberangi sungai kamu mendengar suara retak dan permukaan sungai mulai membeku. Sepertinya musuh sudah datang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1422_DESCRIPTION
desc: Halfway up the river you hear a creaking noise and see that the surface of the river has begun to freeze. It seems the enemy is here.

raw.en: Halfway up the river you hear a creaking noise and see that the surface of the river has begun to freeze. It seems the enemy is here.
raw.es: A mitad del río oyes un sonido chirriante y ves que la superficie del río comienza a congelarse. Parece que el enemigo ha llegado.
raw.id: Setengah perjalanan menyeberangi sungai kamu mendengar suara retak dan permukaan sungai mulai membeku. Sepertinya musuh sudah datang.
raw.pt: Na metade do rio você ouve um rangido e percebe que a superfície do rio começou a congelar. Parece que o inimigo está aqui.
raw.th: เมื่อมาได้ครึ่งทาง คุณได้ยินเสียงประหลาดและเห็นผิวน้ำกลายเป็นน้ำแข็ง ดูเหมือนศัตรูจะอยู่ที่นี่
raw.vi: Ngươi nghe tiếng cọt kẹt ở nửa dòng sông phía trên và thấy bề mặt sông đã bắt đầu đóng băng. Dường như kẻ thù đang ở đây.

id: Selagi mengagumi kebesaran sungai ini, kamu teringat akan perang yang lalu. Walau kamu telah mengalahkan Empat Dewa Sesat, perang lain masih menunggu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1423_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you admire the grandeur of this river, you reminisce of battle. Even though you have defeated the Four Fallen Gods, other battles still lie ahead.

raw.en: As you admire the grandeur of this river, you reminisce of battle. Even though you have defeated the Four Fallen Gods, other battles still lie ahead.
raw.es: Mientras admiras la grandeza del río, recuerdas la batalla. Aunque has derrotado a los cuatro Dioses caídos, te aguardan otras batallas.
raw.id: Selagi mengagumi kebesaran sungai ini, kamu teringat akan perang yang lalu. Walau kamu telah mengalahkan Empat Dewa Sesat, perang lain masih menunggu.
raw.pt: Enquanto admira a grandeza do rio, você lembra da batalha. Mesmo que tenha derrotado os Quatro Deuses Caídos, outras batalhas aguardam adiante.
raw.th: แม้จะหลงใหลในความงดงามของแม่น้ำแห่งนี้ คุณก็ตองสู้อยู่ดี ถึงจะกำจัดจตุรเทพมารลงได้ แต่การต่อสู้อื่นๆ ก็ยังรออยู่
raw.vi: Khi thán phục sự hùng vĩ của dòng sông này, ngươi hồi tưởng lại về cuộc chiến. Dù ngươi đã đánh bại Bốn Vị Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần, vẫn còn nhiều trận chiến phía trước.

id: Angin kencang bertiup. Permukaan air beriak, dan jatuh dengan percikan besar. Mungkin tanda akan jalan di depan, yang membuatmu tidak nyaman.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1424_DESCRIPTION
desc: A strong wind blows. The water's surface ripples, and then crashes in a big splash. It may be a sign of the road up ahead, which makes you nervous.

raw.en: A strong wind blows. The water's surface ripples, and then crashes in a big splash. It may be a sign of the road up ahead, which makes you nervous.
raw.es: Sopla un viento fuerte. La superficie del agua se mueve y luego forma grandes olas. Quizá sea señal del camino futuro, así que te pones nervioso.
raw.id: Angin kencang bertiup. Permukaan air beriak, dan jatuh dengan percikan besar. Mungkin tanda akan jalan di depan, yang membuatmu tidak nyaman.
raw.pt: Um vento forte sopra. A superfície da água se agita e forma ondas que se quebram com violência. Pode ser um sinal da estrada adiante, o que me deixa nervoso.
raw.th: ลมแรงพัดมา ผิวน้ำสั่นไหว และระเบิดออก นี่เป็นสัญญาณให้มุ่งหน้าต่อไป และทำให้คุณประหม่า
raw.vi: Một cơn gió mạnh thổi đến. Mặt nước gợn sóng, và sau đó vỡ tan bắn tung tóe. Đó có thể là dấu hiệu của con đường phía trước khiến ngươi lo lắng.

id: Selagi kamu berjalan dalam hutan lebat, kamu tersesat. Jalan menuju masa depan yang bebas… Kamu harus membuat jalan sendiri untuk mencapainya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1430_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you walk through the thick forest, you get lost. The path to a free future... You'll have to make your own way to get there.

raw.en: As you walk through the thick forest, you get lost. The path to a free future... You'll have to make your own way to get there.
raw.es: Caminas por el espeso bosque y te pierdes. El camino a un futuro libre... Tendrás que forjar tu propia senda para llegar allí.
raw.id: Selagi kamu berjalan dalam hutan lebat, kamu tersesat. Jalan menuju masa depan yang bebas… Kamu harus membuat jalan sendiri untuk mencapainya.
raw.pt: Enquanto anda pela floresta densa, você se perde. O caminho para um futuro livre... Você vai ter que criar o próprio caminho para chegar lá.
raw.th: เมื่อต้องผ่านป่าทึบ คุณก็หลงทาง ทางเดินไปสู่อิสรภาพในอนาคต คุณต้องไปถึงที่นั่นให้ได้
raw.vi: Khi xuyên qua cánh rừng rậm rạp, ngươi bị lạc lối. Con đường dẫn đến tương lai tự do... Ngươi sẽ phải tự mình tìm cách đến đó.

id: Kamu tiba di suatu mata air di tengah hutan. Kamu berpikir untuk beristirahat, tapi musuh mulai bermunculan satu per satu. Waktu istirahat telah usai.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1431_DESCRIPTION
desc: You arrive at a place in the forest where a small spring bubbles. You consider taking a rest, but enemies start appearing one by one. Break's over.

raw.en: You arrive at a place in the forest where a small spring bubbles. You consider taking a rest, but enemies start appearing one by one. Break's over.
raw.es: Dentro del bosque encuentras una pequeña fuente burbujeante. Quieres descansar, pero los enemigos empiezan a aparecer uno a uno. Se acabó el descanso.
raw.id: Kamu tiba di suatu mata air di tengah hutan. Kamu berpikir untuk beristirahat, tapi musuh mulai bermunculan satu per satu. Waktu istirahat telah usai.
raw.pt: Você chega a um local na floresta onde borbulha uma pequena fonte. Você pensa em descansar, mas os inimigos começam a aparecer, um por um. Fim da pausa.
raw.th: คุณมาถึงสถานที่ ในป่าที่ไม้ผลิใบ คุณคิดว่าจะพักสักหน่อย แต่ศัตรูเริ่มปรากฎตัวขึ้นมาทีละตัว หารหยุดพักจบลงแล้ว
raw.vi: Ngươi đến một chỗ trong khu rừng nơi mùa xuân nhỏ đang sôi sục. Ngươi tính nghỉ ngơi nhưng kẻ thù bắt đầu xuất hiện từng tên một. Hết giờ nghỉ rồi.

id: Angin kuat bertiap di tengah hutan. Dedaunan yang bergesekan satu sama lain bergemuruh seperti ombak di lautan. Memang ini lautan pohon.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1432_DESCRIPTION
desc: A strong wind blows in the forest. As the leaves brush upon each other they sound like the waves of the ocean. It's a sea of trees indeed.

raw.en: A strong wind blows in the forest. As the leaves brush upon each other they sound like the waves of the ocean. It's a sea of trees indeed.
raw.es: Un viento fuerte atraviesa el bosque. Las hojas caen unas sobre otras y el sonido se asemeja a las olas en el océano. De hecho, es un mar de árboles.
raw.id: Angin kuat bertiap di tengah hutan. Dedaunan yang bergesekan satu sama lain bergemuruh seperti ombak di lautan. Memang ini lautan pohon.
raw.pt: Um vento forte sopra na floresta. O farfalhar das folhas soa como ondas no mar. É realmente um mar de árvores.
raw.th: ลมแรงพัดผ่านป่า ใบไม้พลิ้วไหวฟังเหมือนคลื่นทะเล นี่คือพลังที่อาจทำให้ป่าเปลี่ยนแปลงไปได้
raw.vi: Những cơn gió mạnh thổi trong rừng. Khi cọ xát lên nhau những chiếc lá tạo nên âm thanh như những con sóng biển. Đó thật sự là một biển cây.

id: Angin kencang bertiup di antara pepohonan, mengangkat daun tua dan membuat yang muda bergoyang. Ini kekuatan yang mengubah hutan menjadi baru.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1433_DESCRIPTION
desc: Breeze blows strongly through the trees, picking up old leaves, and fluttering new ones. This is the force that transforms the forest anew.

raw.en: Breeze blows strongly through the trees, picking up old leaves, and fluttering new ones. This is the force that transforms the forest anew.
raw.es: La brisa atraviesa los árboles con fuerza, levanta las hojas viejas y agita las nuevas. Esta es la fuerza que transforma el bosque otra vez.
raw.id: Angin kencang bertiup di antara pepohonan, mengangkat daun tua dan membuat yang muda bergoyang. Ini kekuatan yang mengubah hutan menjadi baru.
raw.pt: A brisa bate com força nas árvores, carregando folhas velhas e balançando as novas. Essa é a força que renova a floresta.
raw.th: พายุพัดต้นไม้แรงขึ้น พัดพาใบไม้ที่ร่วงหล่นลอยขึ้นมา และระลอกใหม่ก็มาอีก นี่คือพลังที่อาจทำให้ป่าเปลี่ยนแปลงไปได้
raw.vi: Cơn gió thổi mạnh qua những hàng cây, làm rớt rơi đám là vàng và đong đưa những chồi xanh. Đây chính là sức sống để cánh rừng xanh tươi trở lại.

id: Lautan pohon bergoyang tertiup angin. Bisa dikatakan kalau makhluk hidup ini merasa cemas akan masa depan dunia.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1434_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sea of trees sways as the wind hits it. One could say that even these living beings feel anxious about the future fate of the world.

raw.en: The sea of trees sways as the wind hits it. One could say that even these living beings feel anxious about the future fate of the world.
raw.es: El mar de árboles se mueve gracias al viento. Se podría decir que incluso estos seres vivos están ansiosos por el destino del mundo.
raw.id: Lautan pohon bergoyang tertiup angin. Bisa dikatakan kalau makhluk hidup ini merasa cemas akan masa depan dunia.
raw.pt: O mar de árvores balança com a força do vento. Dá para dizer que até esses seres vivos estão nervosos pelo destino do mundo.
raw.th: ทะเลแห่งต้นไม้แกว่งไกวเมื่อสายลมพัดผ่าน ไม่ว่าใครก็สามารถบอกได้สิ่งมีชีวิตเหล่านี้ รู้สึกกังวลเกี่ยวกับชะตากรรมในอานาคตของโลก
raw.vi: Cả biển rừng cây như lắc lư khi gió thổi đến. Có thể nói ngay cả những chúng sinh bé nhỏ này cũng lo lắng về số phận sau này của thế giới.

id: Batu kasar berkilap di sekitar menunjukkan bekas petir. Sepertinya mereka telah menyerapnya dalam badai tak ada henti. Jalan maju tidaklah mudah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1440_DESCRIPTION
desc: The rough, shiny rock around shows traces of lightning. It seems it has been absorbing it during the endless storms. Pressing forward won't be easy.

raw.en: The rough, shiny rock around shows traces of lightning. It seems it has been absorbing it during the endless storms. Pressing forward won't be easy.
raw.es: Las rocas ásperas y brillantes muestran restos de electricidad. Parece que la han absorbido durante las infinitas tormentas. Continuar no será fácil.
raw.id: Batu kasar berkilap di sekitar menunjukkan bekas petir. Sepertinya mereka telah menyerapnya dalam badai tak ada henti. Jalan maju tidaklah mudah.
raw.pt: A rocha brilhante e áspera em volta mostra vestígios de raios. Parece que ela absorveu os raios durante as tempestades incessantes. Seguir adiante não vai ser fácil.
raw.th: หินแข็งส่องสว่างรอบๆ แสดงร่องรอยของสายฟ้าฟาด ดูเหมือนว่ามันถูกดูดซับระหว่างพายุที่ไม่สิ้นสุด การก้าวต่อไปข้างหน้าไม่ใช่เรื่องง่าย
raw.vi: Tảng đá thô ráp, sáng bóng xung quanh cho thấy dấu vết sét đánh. Dường như nó đã hấp thụ sấm sét trong cơn bão vô tận đó. Dấn bước về trước sẽ chẳng dễ chút nào.

id: Selagi kamu mendaki tebing beraliran listrik, kamu melalui puncak setajam jarum. Kamu jadi merasa kalau jalan ini tanda masa depan yang akan datang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1441_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you climb an electrified cliff, you pass peaks as sharp as needles. You can't help but feel like this road is a premonition of the future to come.

raw.en: As you climb an electrified cliff, you pass peaks as sharp as needles. You can't help but feel like this road is a premonition of the future to come.
raw.es: Trepas el risco electrificado y ves picos tan afilados como agujas. No puedes evitar pensar que este camino parece una premonición.
raw.id: Selagi kamu mendaki tebing beraliran listrik, kamu melalui puncak setajam jarum. Kamu jadi merasa kalau jalan ini tanda masa depan yang akan datang.
raw.pt: Enquanto escala um penhasco eletrificado, você passa por picos afiados como agulhas. Você não consegue evitar pensar que esse caminho é uma premonição do futuro que vem pela frente.
raw.th: เมื่อปีนขึ้นไปยังหน้าผาสายฟ้า ผ่านยอดเขาส่วนที่แหลมคมเหมือนเข็ม คุณไม่อาจช่วยได้แต่ก็เหมือนจะเห็นนิมิตว่าอนาคตกำลังใกล้เข้ามา
raw.vi: Khi trèo lên vách đá cheo leo, ngươi vượt qua những đỉnh núi sắc nhọn như dao. Ngươi chẳng thể nào không thấy rằng con đường này là điềm báo tương lai sắp tới.

id: Petir dan guntur yang jatuh diserap oleh gunung. Gunung itu penuh dengannya setelah bertahun-tahun, mungkin saja akan meletus sebentar lagi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1442_DESCRIPTION
desc: The thunder and lightning that falls here is absorbed by the mountain. It has accumulated so much after the years that it might burst any minute now.

raw.en: The thunder and lightning that falls here is absorbed by the mountain. It has accumulated so much after the years that it might burst any minute now.
raw.es: La montaña absorbe los truenos y rayos del cielo. Ha acumulado tanto durante los años que parece que podría estallar en cualquier momento.
raw.id: Petir dan guntur yang jatuh diserap oleh gunung. Gunung itu penuh dengannya setelah bertahun-tahun, mungkin saja akan meletus sebentar lagi.
raw.pt: Os raios e trovões daqui são absorvidos pela montanha. Eles se acumularam tanto ao longo dos anos que podem explodir a qualquer momento.
raw.th: สายฟ้าฟาดลงมาที่นี่ถูกภูเขาดูดซับพลังงานไว้ มันกักเก็บพลังมานานหลายปีและกำลังจะระเบิดออก ณ บัดนี้
raw.vi: Sấm sét bổ xuống nơi đây đều bị các ngọn núi đón đỡ. Sau nhiều năm tích tụ vô số lôi điện giờ đây nó có thể nổ tung bất cứ lúc nào.

id: Kamu sampai ke puncak tertinggi Gn. Granakia, di mana seluruh Atharva dapat terlihat. Kamu melihat kastel raksasa di kejauhan. Apa itu markas Eriole?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1443_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've reached the Mt. Granakia's highest peak, where you can see the whole of Atharva. You see a giant castle in the distance. Is that Eriole's base?

raw.en: You've reached the Mt. Granakia's highest peak, where you can see the whole of Atharva. You see a giant castle in the distance. Is that Eriole's base?
raw.es: Llegaste al pico más alto del Monte  Granakia y ves la inmensidad de Atharva. A la distancia ves un castillo gigante. ¿Será la base de Eriole?
raw.id: Kamu sampai ke puncak tertinggi Gn. Granakia, di mana seluruh Atharva dapat terlihat. Kamu melihat kastel raksasa di kejauhan. Apa itu markas Eriole?
raw.pt: Você chegou ao pico mais alto do Monte Granakia, onde é possível ver Atharvia inteira. Você vê um castelo gigantesco ao longe. Essa é a base de Eriole?
raw.th: คุณมาถึงยอดเขากรานาเกีย ที่ซึ่งมองเห็นอธาวาได้ทั้งหมด คุณเห็นปราสาทใหญ่ยักษ์ข้างหน้า เอริดอเล่อยู่ที่นี่เหรอ?
raw.vi: Ngươi đã lên đến đỉnh cao nhất của Ngọn Granakia, nơi ngươi có thể thấy toàn bộ vùng Atharva. Ngươi thấy một lâu đài khổng lồ ở phía xa. Đó là căn cứ của Eriole?

id: Kamu bisa melihat Paris di dasar jurang. Sepertinya dia mengikutimu ke sini. Kamu diberi tahu untuk berbicara dengannya, tapi apa yang ada di benakmu?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1444_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see Paris at the bottom of the cliff. It seems she followed you here. You were told to talk to her, but what exactly do you have in mind?

raw.en: You can see Paris at the bottom of the cliff. It seems she followed you here. You were told to talk to her, but what exactly do you have in mind?
raw.es: Ves a Paris al pie del risco. Parece que te siguió hasta aquí. Te han dicho que hables con ella, ¿pero qué le dirás exactamente?
raw.id: Kamu bisa melihat Paris di dasar jurang. Sepertinya dia mengikutimu ke sini. Kamu diberi tahu untuk berbicara dengannya, tapi apa yang ada di benakmu?
raw.pt: Você pode ver as pérolas no fundo do desfiladeiro. Parece que ela seguiu você até aqui. Disseram para que você falasse com ela, mas o que você tem em mente?
raw.th: คุณเห็นปารีสที่จุดล่างสุดของหน้าผา เธอตามคุณมาที่นี่ คุณจะต้องพูดกับเธอ แต่คุณมีอะไรจะบอกกันแน่?
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể thấy Paris ở dưới đáy vách đá này. Dường như ả đã theo ngươi ở đây. Ngươi đã nói chuyện với ả, nhưng thực sự ngươi nghĩ gì vậy?

id: Setelah mendaki gunung, kamu mencapai kebun yang indah. Tapi, sepertinya tidak ada orang di sini, jadi bagaimana kebun ini tetap terawat?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1450_DESCRIPTION
desc: After climbing over the mountain, you reach a beautiful garden. However, no people seem to come here, so how has it been kept so well maintained?

raw.en: After climbing over the mountain, you reach a beautiful garden. However, no people seem to come here, so how has it been kept so well maintained?
raw.es: Tras trepar la montaña, llegas a un hermoso jardín. No obstante, parece que nadie viene aquí. ¿Cómo se ha mantenido tan bien?
raw.id: Setelah mendaki gunung, kamu mencapai kebun yang indah. Tapi, sepertinya tidak ada orang di sini, jadi bagaimana kebun ini tetap terawat?
raw.pt: Depois de passar pela montanha você chega a um lindo jardim. No entanto, parece e que ninguém vem aqui, então como ele está tão bem cuidado?
raw.th: หลังจากปีนภูเขาขึ้นมา ก็เห็นสวนอันงดงาม อย่างไรก็ตาม ดูเหมือนจะไม่มีใครเคยมาที่นี่ แล้วมันจะมีสภาพแบบนี้ได้อย่างไร?
raw.vi: Sau khi leo qua núi, ngươi gặp một khu vườn xinh đẹp. Tuy nhiên, dường như chẳng có ai nơi đây, làm sao khu vườn được chăm sóc tốt như vậy?

id: Rentetan bunga tertata indah di kebun itu. Bunga-bunga ini tidak mungkin tumbuh tanpa perawatan yang rutin, tapi…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1451_DESCRIPTION
desc: Beautiful flower beds are arranged next to each other in the garden. These amazing flowers couldn't have bloomed without lots of care, and yet...

raw.en: Beautiful flower beds are arranged next to each other in the garden. These amazing flowers couldn't have bloomed without lots of care, and yet...
raw.es: En el jardín, los macizos de hermosas flores se encuentran uno al lado del otro. No podrían haber florecido sin el cuidado de alguien y sin embargo...
raw.id: Rentetan bunga tertata indah di kebun itu. Bunga-bunga ini tidak mungkin tumbuh tanpa perawatan yang rutin, tapi…
raw.pt: Lindos canteiros de flores estão arranjados lado a lado no jardim. Essas flores incríveis não poderiam ter florescido sem muito carinho, ainda assim...
raw.th: ดอกไม้งามถูกจัดเรียงเป็นระเบียบอยู่ในสวน ดอกไม้แปลกประหลาดนี้ถึงไม่ดุแลก็ผลิบานได้ สินะ
raw.vi: Những luống hoa xinh tươi được sắp xếp cạnh nhau trong khu vườn. Những bông hoa tuyệt vời này chẳng thể nở nếu không chăm sóc nhiều, nhưng...

id: Kamu melihat air mancur di antara taman bunga. Airnya berkilau mengalir di tumpuannya yang diukir indah. Benar-benar pemandangan yang menakjubkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1452_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can see a fountain amidst the flower beds. The water sparkles as it flows from a beautifully carved pedestal. What a great spectacle to behold.

raw.en: You can see a fountain amidst the flower beds. The water sparkles as it flows from a beautifully carved pedestal. What a great spectacle to behold.
raw.es: Entre los macizos de flores ves una fuente. El agua refleja la luz mientras fluye de un pedestal bellamente esculpido. Es un espectáculo.
raw.id: Kamu melihat air mancur di antara taman bunga. Airnya berkilau mengalir di tumpuannya yang diukir indah. Benar-benar pemandangan yang menakjubkan.
raw.pt: Você pode ver uma fonte em meio aos canteiros de flores. A água brilha enquanto flui de um pedestal lindamente esculpido. Que espetáculo incrível de observar.
raw.th: คุณเห็นน้ำพุท่ามกลางหมู่มวลดอกไม้ สายน้ำพุ่งออกมาจากแท่นน้ำพุอันสวยงาม น่าตื่นตาตื่นใจนัก
raw.vi: Ngươi có thể thấy một đài phun nước giữa các luống hoa. Dòng nước lấp lánh chảy ra từ một chiếc bệ chạm khắc đẹp đẽ. Thật là một cảnh tượng tuyệt vời để chiêm ngưỡng.

id: Burung-burung kecil beterbangan, berkicau dengan indah. Satu tiba-tiba terbang dan ketika matamu mengikutinya, ada bayangan besar turun dari langit…
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1453_DESCRIPTION
desc: Small birds flutter about, chirping a song. One flees suddenly, and when you follow it with your eyes, you see a great shadow dropping from the sky...

raw.en: Small birds flutter about, chirping a song. One flees suddenly, and when you follow it with your eyes, you see a great shadow dropping from the sky...
raw.es: Pequeñas aves revolotean y cantan una canción. De repente, una de ellas escapa. La sigues con la mirada y ves una gran sombra caer desde el cielo...
raw.id: Burung-burung kecil beterbangan, berkicau dengan indah. Satu tiba-tiba terbang dan ketika matamu mengikutinya, ada bayangan besar turun dari langit…
raw.pt: Pequenos pássaros cantam uma canção por perto. Um deles foge de repente e, quando você o segue com o olhar, vê uma grande sombra descendo do céu...
raw.th: นกน้อยบินไปทั่ว ร้องเพลงไปพลาง นกตัวหนึ่งหลบหนีในทันที และเมื่อคุณมองตามไป ก็เห็นเงาใหญ่ยักษ์ลงมาจากท้องฟ้า
raw.vi: Những chú chim nhỏ bay chập chờn, hót líu lo một bài hát. Đột nhiên một con vọt trốn, và khi liếc mắt theo, ngươi sẽ thấy một cái bóng lớn rơi xuống từ bầu trời...

id: Aroma bunga, kicauan burung, dan keindahan rumput yang terpangkas rapi… Melihatnya sekarang, kebun ini cantik, kalau tidak bisa disebut sempurna.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1454_DESCRIPTION
desc: The floral aroma, the chirping of the birds, and the beauty of the trimmed hedges... Looking at it now, this is a beautiful, if not perfect, garden.

raw.en: The floral aroma, the chirping of the birds, and the beauty of the trimmed hedges... Looking at it now, this is a beautiful, if not perfect, garden.
raw.es: El aroma de las flores, el trino de las aves, la belleza de los setos cortados... Este es un jardín hermoso, muy cerca de la perfección.
raw.id: Aroma bunga, kicauan burung, dan keindahan rumput yang terpangkas rapi… Melihatnya sekarang, kebun ini cantik, kalau tidak bisa disebut sempurna.
raw.pt: O aroma de flores, o canto dos pássaros e a beleza das cercas vivas podadas... Olhando agora, esse jardim é lindo, se não for perfeito.
raw.th: กลิ่นดอกไม้หอม นกน้อยร้องเพลง และสวนอันงดงาม เมื่อมองดูแล้ว ก็สวยงาม แต่ก็ไม่ใช่เลิศเลอนัก
raw.vi: Mùi hương hoa, tiếng kêu của các loài chim, và vẻ đẹp của hàng rào đã được cắt tỉa... Trông lúc này, đây là một khu vườn xinh đẹp, nếu không muốn nói là hoàn hảo.

id: Apa kebun ini dibuat oleh manusia? Apa kebun ini bisa tetap indah tanpa orang yang merawatnya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1455_DESCRIPTION
desc: Could this garden have been made by human hands? How could it have remained so beautiful without any people left to care for it?

raw.en: Could this garden have been made by human hands? How could it have remained so beautiful without any people left to care for it?
raw.es: ¿Acaso este jardín fue hecho por manos humanas? ¿Cómo se ha podido conservar tan bien sin que ninguna persona cuide de él?
raw.id: Apa kebun ini dibuat oleh manusia? Apa kebun ini bisa tetap indah tanpa orang yang merawatnya?
raw.pt: Será que esse jardim foi feito por mãos humanas? Como ele pode ter continuado tão lindo sem pessoas para cuidar dele?
raw.th: หรือสวนนี้จะถูกมนุษย์สร้างขึ้น? แถมไม่มีคนดูแลแต่ก็ยังสวยงามอยู่ได้?
raw.vi: Liệu khu vườn này đã do bàn tay con người làm nên chăng? Làm sao nó có thể vẫn đẹp như vậy mà không có ai ở lại để chăm sóc?

id: Bunga kecil tertiup angin, kupu-kupu beterbangan, dan burung terbang tinggi di langit. Angin permulaan baru meninggalkan era lama di belakang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1456_DESCRIPTION
desc: Small flowers sway in the wind, butterflies flutter about, and the birds fly high in the sky. A wind of new beginnings is leaving the old age behind.

raw.en: Small flowers sway in the wind, butterflies flutter about, and the birds fly high in the sky. A wind of new beginnings is leaving the old age behind.
raw.es: Pequeñas flores se mecen en el viento, las mariposas revolotean y las aves vuelan en el alto cielo. Un nuevo viento deja atrás la vieja era.
raw.id: Bunga kecil tertiup angin, kupu-kupu beterbangan, dan burung terbang tinggi di langit. Angin permulaan baru meninggalkan era lama di belakang.
raw.pt: Pequenas flores balançam com o vento, borboletas voam ao redor e os pássaros voam alto no céu. Um vento de novos recomeços está deixando uma era antiga para trás.
raw.th: ดอกไม้เล็กๆพลิ้วไปตามลม ผีเสื้อโบยบิน และเหล่านกบินสูงขึ้นไปบนฟ้า สายลมแห่งการเริ่มต้นได้ทิ้งเหล่าผู้สูงอายุไว้เบื้องหลัง
raw.vi: Những bông hoa nhỏ đong đưa trong gió, lũ bướm chập chờn và các chú chim vút cao trên bầu trời. Một làn gió khởi đầu mới mẻ đang bỏ lại thời xưa cũ sau lưng.

id: Setelah melewati kebun yang indah, kamu sampai ke pemakaman yang muram. Di antara batu nisan yang diam membisu, ada suara memanggil dari keheningan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1460_DESCRIPTION
desc: Having passed the gorgeous garden, you reach a gloomy cemetery. Among the expressionless tombstones standing, a voice calls from within the silence.

raw.en: Having passed the gorgeous garden, you reach a gloomy cemetery. Among the expressionless tombstones standing, a voice calls from within the silence.
raw.es: Tras haber sorteado el hermoso jardín, llegas a un tenebroso cementerio. Entre las inexpresivas lápidas, una voz llama desde el silencio.
raw.id: Setelah melewati kebun yang indah, kamu sampai ke pemakaman yang muram. Di antara batu nisan yang diam membisu, ada suara memanggil dari keheningan.
raw.pt: Tendo passado pelo lindo jardim, você chega ao cemitério sombrio. Entre os túmulos sem expressão, uma voz chama, cortando o silêncio.
raw.th: เมื่อผ่านสวนอันงดงาม ก็พบกับสุสาน มีศิลาตั้งตระหง่าน และได้ยินเสียงของความเงียบ
raw.vi: Vượt qua khu vườn tuyệt đẹp, ngươi đến tới một nghĩa trang ảm đạm. Đứng giữa các ngôi mộ vô cảm, một giọng nói vọng ra từ im lặng.

id: Tesla berkata Paris tidak berguna untuk mereka sekarang. Kalau Eriole merasa seperti itu, apa yang mungkin dikejarnya…?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1461_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tesla said Paris was useless to them now. If Eriole truly feels that way, then just what could he be after...?

raw.en: Tesla said Paris was useless to them now. If Eriole truly feels that way, then just what could he be after...?
raw.es: Tesla dijo que Paris ya no les era útil. Si Eriole realmente piensa eso, ¿qué es lo que estará buscando?
raw.id: Tesla berkata Paris tidak berguna untuk mereka sekarang. Kalau Eriole merasa seperti itu, apa yang mungkin dikejarnya…?
raw.pt: Tesla disse que Paris era inútil para eles agora. Se Eriole se sente assim mesmo, então o que será que ele busca?
raw.th: เทสล่าบอกว่าปารีสนั้นไร้ประโยชน์แล้ว ถ้าเอริโอเล่คิดเช่นนั้นด้วย แล้วเขาจะทำอย่างไรต่อไป?
raw.vi: Tesla nói Paris đã vô ích đối với họ lúc này. Nếu Eriole thật sự cảm nhận theo cách đó, thì anh ta sẽ ra sao sau khi...?

id: Bagian dari pemakaman ini didedikasikan untuk prajurit yang mati dalam perang. Kamu bisa melihat dari batu nisan mereka, ada simbol pedang terukir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1462_DESCRIPTION
desc: This part of the cemetery seems to be dedicated to soldiers fallen in battle. You can see that their tombstones have a sword symbol carved onto them.

raw.en: This part of the cemetery seems to be dedicated to soldiers fallen in battle. You can see that their tombstones have a sword symbol carved onto them.
raw.es: Parece que esta parte del cementerio está dedicada a los soldados caídos en batalla. Sus tumbas tienen la imagen de una espada grabada en ellas.
raw.id: Bagian dari pemakaman ini didedikasikan untuk prajurit yang mati dalam perang. Kamu bisa melihat dari batu nisan mereka, ada simbol pedang terukir.
raw.pt: Esta parte do cemitério parece dedicada a soldados mortos em batalha. Você pode ver que suas lápides têm um símbolo de espada entalhado.
raw.th: สุสานแห่งนี้คงมีไว้สำหรับทหารที่เสียชีวิตในการต่อสู้ คุณจะเห็นว่าสิลาหลุมศพมีสัญลักษณ์ของดาบประทับอยู่ด้วย
raw.vi: Khu này của nghĩa trang dường như dành riêng cho những người lính tử trận. Ngươi có thể thấy một biểu tượng thanh kiếm được khắc trên bia mộ của họ.

id: Kalau perang saudara terjadi di Elgaia, banyak jiwa yang akan menjadi korban. Ini harus dicegah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1463_DESCRIPTION
desc: If a civil war breaks in Elgaia, many lives will be lost. This must be prevented at all costs.

raw.en: If a civil war breaks in Elgaia, many lives will be lost. This must be prevented at all costs.
raw.es: Si estalla una guerra en Elgaia, muchos morirán. Hay que prevenir este escenario cueste lo que cueste.
raw.id: Kalau perang saudara terjadi di Elgaia, banyak jiwa yang akan menjadi korban. Ini harus dicegah.
raw.pt: Se uma guerra civil se iniciar em Elgaia, muitas vidas serão perdidas. Isso deve ser evitado a todo custo.
raw.th: ถ้าเกิดสงครามกลางเมืองขึ้นที่เอลไกอา หลายชีวิตต้องเกิดการสูญเสีย ต้องป้องกันไม่ให้เกิดขึ้น
raw.vi: Nếu cuộc nội chiến nổ ra ở Elgaia, sẽ mất rất nhiều sinh mạng. Điều đó phải được bảo vệ bằng mọi giá.

id: Membaca beberapa kata yang bisa kamu lihat di batu nisan, kamu menyimpulkan bahwa ini dulunya adalah salah satu tempat paling penting di Atharva.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1464_DESCRIPTION
desc: Reading the few words you can make out from the headstones, you gather that this was once one of the most important places in Atharva.

raw.en: Reading the few words you can make out from the headstones, you gather that this was once one of the most important places in Atharva.
raw.es: Gracias a las pocas palabras que detectas en las lápidas, te das cuenta de que este fue, antaño, uno de los lugares más importantes de Atharva.
raw.id: Membaca beberapa kata yang bisa kamu lihat di batu nisan, kamu menyimpulkan bahwa ini dulunya adalah salah satu tempat paling penting di Atharva.
raw.pt: Lendo as poucas palavras inteligíveis das lápides, você percebe que esse já foi um dos lugares mais importantes de Atharva.
raw.th: อ่านไม่กี่คำจากป้ายหลุมศพก็เข้าใจได้ คุณรวบรวมความคิดได้ว่าครั้งหนึ่งที่นี่ต้องเป็นสถานที่สำคัญแห่งอธาวา
raw.vi: Đọc vài từ có thể nhận ra từ các bia mộ, ngươi biết rằng nơi này đã từng là một trong những địa điểm quan trọng nhất ở Atharva.

id: Kamu merasa bulu kudukmu berdiri. Merasakan keberadaan aura jahat, kamu melihat di sekitarmu. Kegelapan mendekat, musuh akan datang!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1465_DESCRIPTION
desc: You feel something cold run down your spine. Feeling an evil presence, you look around you. Darkness is closing in, the enemy's coming!

raw.en: You feel something cold run down your spine. Feeling an evil presence, you look around you. Darkness is closing in, the enemy's coming!
raw.es: Sientes que algo frío te recorre el cuerpo. Sientes una presencia maligna y te das vuelta. Se acerca la oscuridad, ¡los enemigos se aproximan!
raw.id: Kamu merasa bulu kudukmu berdiri. Merasakan keberadaan aura jahat, kamu melihat di sekitarmu. Kegelapan mendekat, musuh akan datang!
raw.pt: Você sente algo frio descer pela sua coluna. Ao sentir uma presença maligna, você olha ao redor. A escuridão está se aproximando, o inimigo está vindo!
raw.th: คุณรู้สึกว่าอากาศรอบตัวเย็นลง สัมผัสได้ถึงความชั่วร้าย คุณมองดูโดยรอบ ความมืดกำลังคืบคลานเข้ามาใกล้ ศัตรูกำลังมา!
raw.vi: Ngươi cảm thấy một thứ gì đó lạnh lẽo chạy dọc sống lưng. Cảm thấy sự hiện diện của ma quỷ, ngươi nhìn xung quanh mình. Bóng tối đang gần kề, kẻ thù đang đến!

id: Tak ada angin yang mencapai tempat ini, dan gerakanmu terasa berat. Bau lumut dan lembab terasa di udara.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1466_DESCRIPTION
desc: Not even the wind seems to reach this place, and your movements start to feel sluggish. The smell of moss and mold lingers in the air.

raw.en: Not even the wind seems to reach this place, and your movements start to feel sluggish. The smell of moss and mold lingers in the air.
raw.es: Parece que ni siquiera el viento llega a este lugar. Empiezas a moverte con mucha dificultad. El olor a musgo y moho recorre el aire.
raw.id: Tak ada angin yang mencapai tempat ini, dan gerakanmu terasa berat. Bau lumut dan lembab terasa di udara.
raw.pt: Nem mesmo o vento parece atingir este lugar, e seus movimentos começam a parecer lentos. O cheiro do musgo e do mofo pairam no ar.
raw.th: ไม่เพียงแต่สายลมพัดผ่านมาถึงที่นี่ การเคลื่อนไหวของคุณก็ดูเฉื่อยชาลงด้วย กลิ่นมอสและราโชยไปทั่วในอากาศ
raw.vi: Ngay cả gió cũng khó mà đến được chỗ này, và cử động của ngươi bắt đầu chậm chạp. Mùi rêu và nấm mốc vẫn còn lưu lại trong không khí.

id: Percikan perang telah dimulai. Kalahkan musuh yang ada di depanmu, dan maju ke kedalaman kastel Eriole!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1470_DESCRIPTION
desc: The spark of battle has been ignited. Defeat the enemies standing in your way, and head towards the depths of Eriole's castle!

raw.en: The spark of battle has been ignited. Defeat the enemies standing in your way, and head towards the depths of Eriole's castle!
raw.es: Han encendido la mecha de la batalla. ¡Derrota a los enemigos que están en tu camino y avanza hacia las profundidades del castillo de Eriole!
raw.id: Percikan perang telah dimulai. Kalahkan musuh yang ada di depanmu, dan maju ke kedalaman kastel Eriole!
raw.pt: A fagulha da batalha foi acesa. Derrote os inimigos que estão no seu caminho e vá até as profundezas do castelo de Eriole!
raw.th: ประกายไฟแห่งการต่อสู้ลุกโชนขึ้น จงกำจัดศัตรูตรงหน้า แล้วมุ่งหน้าไปยังส่วนลึกของปราสาทเอริโอเล่!
raw.vi: Tia lửa trận chiến đã được châm ngòi. Hãy đánh bại kẻ thù chặn đường ngươi, và hướng đến những nơi sâu thẳm của lâu đài Eriole!

id: Pedang besi dingin menghantammu, dan cakar api maju ke arahmu. Tidak peduli siapa musuhmu, kamu tidak boleh kalah!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1471_DESCRIPTION
desc: A cold steel blade strikes at you, and fiery claws rush towards you. No matter who the enemy may be, you must not falter!

raw.en: A cold steel blade strikes at you, and fiery claws rush towards you. No matter who the enemy may be, you must not falter!
raw.es: Una hoja de acero frío te golpea y garras llameantes se acercan a ti rápidamente. Sin importar quién sea el enemigo, ¡no debes titubear!
raw.id: Pedang besi dingin menghantammu, dan cakar api maju ke arahmu. Tidak peduli siapa musuhmu, kamu tidak boleh kalah!
raw.pt: Uma lâmina de aço gelada golpeia e garras flamejantes vêm na sua direção. Não importa quem possa ser o inimigo, você não pode fraquejar!
raw.th: คุณถูกจู่โจมจากคมดาบอันเยือกเย็น กรงเล็บอันร้อนแรงมุ่งมาที่คุณ ไม่ว่าจะเป็นศัตรูหน้าไหนก็อย่าลังเล!
raw.vi: Một lưỡi thép lạnh vụt đến và những móng vuốt hung hăng chộp về phía ngươi. Dù kẻ thù có là ai, ngươi cũng không được ngập ngừng!

id: Tinju menghancurkan lantai, dan tombak mencoba menusukmu selagi kamu menyerang balik. Musuh yang kuat berkumpul di sini, kamu harus maju!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1472_DESCRIPTION
desc: A fist cracks the floor open, and a lance tries to pierce you as you counterattack. Strong enemies have gathered here, but you must press on!

raw.en: A fist cracks the floor open, and a lance tries to pierce you as you counterattack. Strong enemies have gathered here, but you must press on!
raw.es: Un puño agrieta el suelo de un golpe y una lanza intenta atravesarte al contraatacar. Aquí se han apostado enemigos fuertes, ¡pero no puedes detenerte!
raw.id: Tinju menghancurkan lantai, dan tombak mencoba menusukmu selagi kamu menyerang balik. Musuh yang kuat berkumpul di sini, kamu harus maju!
raw.pt: Um punho destrói o chão e uma lança tenta atingir você durante o seu contra-ataque. Inimigos poderosos se juntaram aqui, mas você precisa avançar!
raw.th: พื้นแตกออก มีหอกที่พยายามจะจู่โจมใส่คุณพุ่งเข้ามา ศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งอยู่ที่นี่ แต่เจ้าก็ต้องมุ่งหน้าต่อไปให้ได้!
raw.vi: Nắm đấm phá vỡ lỗ hổng sàn, và một ngọn giáo vọt đâm tới khi ngươi đang phản công. Kẻ thù hùng mạnh đã tụ tập nơi đây, nhưng ngươi vẫn phải dấn bước!

id: Guntur terlihat di aula, dan pedang yang memblokir kegelapan bersinar dengan terang. Kalau kamu mau menghentikan revolusi, fokus ke musuhmu sekarang!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1473_DESCRIPTION
desc: Lightning flashes in the hall, and a sword that seems to block darkness shimmers brightly. If you want to stop the revolution, focus on the enemy now!

raw.en: Lightning flashes in the hall, and a sword that seems to block darkness shimmers brightly. If you want to stop the revolution, focus on the enemy now!
raw.es: La electricidad atraviesa la sala y una espada que bloquea la oscuridad brilla con fuerza. Si vas a detener la revolución, ¡concéntrate en el enemigo!
raw.id: Guntur terlihat di aula, dan pedang yang memblokir kegelapan bersinar dengan terang. Kalau kamu mau menghentikan revolusi, fokus ke musuhmu sekarang!
raw.pt: Relâmpagos brilham no salão e uma espada que parece bloquear a sombra está brilhando. Se você quiser parar a revolução, concentre-se no inimigo agora!
raw.th: เกิดแสงสว่างวาบขึ้นในห้องโถง และดาบที่ปิดกั้นความมืดก็เริ่มส่องสกาว ถ้าคุณอยากหยุดยั้งการปฏิวัติ ก็ต้องสนใจกับศัตรูตรงหน้าเอาไว้!
raw.vi: Ánh sáng nhấp nháy trong sảnh, rồi một thanh kiếm dường như ngăn chặn bóng tối chợt tỏa sáng rực rỡ. Hãy chú ý đến kẻ thù ngay nếu ngươi muốn dừng cuộc cách mạng này!

id: Cahaya menembus dinding, dan banyak anak panah yang diluncurkan. Musuhmu kuat, tapi kamu masih bersemangat. Cepatlah maju ke depan!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1474_DESCRIPTION
desc: Light pierces the walls, and countless arrows begin to rain down. The enemy is strong, but you still have morale. Hurry and make your way through!

raw.en: Light pierces the walls, and countless arrows begin to rain down. The enemy is strong, but you still have morale. Hurry and make your way through!
raw.es: La luz atraviesa los muros y millones de flechas caen desde el cielo. El enemigo es fuerte, pero tu moral está intacta. ¡Apresúrate y sigue avanzando!
raw.id: Cahaya menembus dinding, dan banyak anak panah yang diluncurkan. Musuhmu kuat, tapi kamu masih bersemangat. Cepatlah maju ke depan!
raw.pt: A luz atravessa as paredes e incontáveis flechas começam a cair. O inimigo é forte, mas você ainda tem moral. Apresse-se e abra caminho.
raw.th: ลำแสงผ่านทะลุผนัง มาพร้อมกับธนูนับไม่ถ้วนดั่งสายฝน พวกศัตรูช่างแข็งแกร่ง แต่คุณก็ยังมีกำลังใจ จงรีบผ่านมันไปให้ได้!
raw.vi: Ánh sáng xuyên qua các bức tường, và vô số mũi tên bắt đầu đổ xuống như mưa. Kẻ địch khá mạnh, nhưng ngươi vẫn đầy nhuệ khí. Hãy nhanh lên và vượt qua mọi thứ!

id: Pedang kembar berdansa di udara, dan satu serangan dari tombak berat menghancurkan lantai. Sedikit lagi kamu akan melawan Eriole di kedalaman kastel.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1475_DESCRIPTION
desc: Dual blades dance in the air, and one strike from a hefty lance breaks the floor open. Just a bit more till you face Eriole deep in the castle.

raw.en: Dual blades dance in the air, and one strike from a hefty lance breaks the floor open. Just a bit more till you face Eriole deep in the castle.
raw.es: Dos espadas danzan en el aire y el golpe de una pesada lanza parte el suelo. Falta muy poco para que te enfrentes a Eriole en el castillo.
raw.id: Pedang kembar berdansa di udara, dan satu serangan dari tombak berat menghancurkan lantai. Sedikit lagi kamu akan melawan Eriole di kedalaman kastel.
raw.pt: Lâminas gêmeas dançam no ar, e um ataque de uma lança pesada destrói o chão. Só mais um pouco até poder enfrentar Eriole no interior do castelo.
raw.th: ดาบคู่เริงระบำอยู่ในอากาศ และการโจมตีเพียงครั้งเดียวจากหอกที่หนัก ทำลายพื้นจนแจกออก อีกไม่นานคุณจะได้เผชิญหน้ากับเอริโอเล่ลึกเข้าไปในปราสาท
raw.vi: Song kiếm tung hoành trên không, và một đòn từ cây thương nặng phá tung sàn nhà ra. Chỉ một chút nữa để ngươi đối diện Eriole nơi sâu thẳm trong lâu đài.

id: Bayangan itu sekuat cahaya. Dunia menjadi terdistorsi, mungkin jahitannya pecah. Kamu hanyalah selangkah sebelum mencapai Eriole!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1476_DESCRIPTION
desc: The shadow overhead is just as strong as the light. The world is being distorted, probably tearing at the seams. You're just steps away from Eriole!

raw.en: The shadow overhead is just as strong as the light. The world is being distorted, probably tearing at the seams. You're just steps away from Eriole!
raw.es: Arriba, la sombra es tan fuerte como la luz. El mundo está distorsionado y es probable que sus cimientos estén partiéndose. ¡Estás a pasos de Eriole!
raw.id: Bayangan itu sekuat cahaya. Dunia menjadi terdistorsi, mungkin jahitannya pecah. Kamu hanyalah selangkah sebelum mencapai Eriole!
raw.pt: A sombra acima é tão forte quanto a luz. O mundo está sendo distorcido, provavelmente se arrebentando. Você está a passos de Eriole!
raw.th: เงาเบื้องหน้าแข็งแกร่งเหมือนแสงสว่าง โลกถูกทำให้บิดเบี้ยว อาจทะลุทะลวงชั้นหิน และดูเหมือนจะออกห่างจากเอริโอเล่!
raw.vi: Bóng tối trên đầu cũng lớn như ánh đèn. Thế giới đang bị vặn xoắn, có thể bị xé rách ở đường phân giới. Ngươi chỉ cần bước ra khỏi Eriole!

id: Ide Eriole tidak benar. Ide di mana revolusi berdarah akan mendatangkan masa depan penuh damai tidak mungkin benar. Dia harus dihentikan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1477_DESCRIPTION
desc: Eriole's ideas are warped. The idea that a bloody revolution can bring about a peaceful future cannot possibly be true. He must be stopped.

raw.en: Eriole's ideas are warped. The idea that a bloody revolution can bring about a peaceful future cannot possibly be true. He must be stopped.
raw.es: Los planes de Eriole son macabros. La idea de que una revolución sangrienta puede sembrar un futuro pacífico no puede ser verdad. Hay que detenerlo.
raw.id: Ide Eriole tidak benar. Ide di mana revolusi berdarah akan mendatangkan masa depan penuh damai tidak mungkin benar. Dia harus dihentikan.
raw.pt: As ideias de Eriole são deturpadas. A ideia de que uma revolução sangrenta possa trazer um futuro de paz não pode ser verdadeira. Ele precisa ser parado.
raw.th: ความคิดของเอริโอเล่นั้นก้าวไกล ความคิดที่ว่า เลือดจากการปฏิวัติจะนำมาซึ่งสันติภาพในอนาคตนั้นไม่มีทางเป็นจริง เขาต้องหยุดยั้งไว้
