raw.vi: Những ý tưởng của Eriole bị xuyên tạc. Ý tưởng rằng một cuộc cách mạng đẫm máu có thể mang lại tương lai hòa bình không thể nào đúng. Phải chặn hắn ta lại.

id: Kamu menemukan gua yang mengeluarkan miasma jahat. Ada tanda segel kuat di pintu masuknya, tapi sepertinya kamu bisa masuk dan keluar dengan bebas.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1480_DESCRIPTION
desc: You discover a cave dispersing an ominous miasma. There are traces of a strong seal at the entrance, but you seem to be able to come and go freely.

raw.en: You discover a cave dispersing an ominous miasma. There are traces of a strong seal at the entrance, but you seem to be able to come and go freely.
raw.es: Descubres una cueva que suelta un miasma ominoso. Hay rastros de un fuerte sello en la entrada, pero parece que tú puedes moverte sin ningún problema.
raw.id: Kamu menemukan gua yang mengeluarkan miasma jahat. Ada tanda segel kuat di pintu masuknya, tapi sepertinya kamu bisa masuk dan keluar dengan bebas.
raw.pt: Você descobre uma caverna com um odor horrível. Há indícios de um bloqueio forte na entrada, mas você parece capaz de ir e vir sem problemas.
raw.th: คุณพบกับถ้ำที่แพร่กระกายไอที่ชั่วร้าย มีร่องรอยของผนึกที่แข็งแกร่งอยู่ที่ททางเข้า แต่ดูเหมือนว่าคุณจะสามารถเข้าและออกได้ตามสะดวก
raw.vi: Ngươi phát hiện một hang động phát ra thứ chướng khí đáng ngại. Có dấu vết của một phong ấn cường đại tại lối vào, nhưng hình như ngươi vẫn có thể ra vào tự do.

id: Mendekati jantung hutan muram, terdengar teriakan naga kuno yang rumornya tersegel di dalam hutan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1500_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you approach the heart of the gloomy forest, you think you hear the cry of the ancient dragon rumored to be sealed within it.

raw.en: As you approach the heart of the gloomy forest, you think you hear the cry of the ancient dragon rumored to be sealed within it.
raw.es: Al acercarte al corazón del bosque sombrío, crees escuchar el llanto del dragón ancestral que, se rumorea, está prisionero dentro.
raw.id: Mendekati jantung hutan muram, terdengar teriakan naga kuno yang rumornya tersegel di dalam hutan.
raw.pt: Quando se aproxima do coração da floresta sombria, você pensa ter ouvido o rugido de um dragão antigo que dizem estar preso lá.
raw.th: เมื่อเข้าไปยังใจกลางป่าแห่งความเศร้ามอง คุณคิดว่าได้ยินเสียงร่ำไห้ของบังกรโบราณที่ลือกันว่าถูกผนึกไว้ยังที่แห่งนี้
raw.vi: Khi đến giữa khu rừng ảm đạm, dường như ngươi nghe tiếng gào khóc của con rồng cổ xưa được đồn đại bị phong ấn trong đó.

id: Setelah bertarung melawan naga, terdengar suara orang mati bernyanyi di sekitar. Sepertinya makhluk hutan ini bermaksud menghentikanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1501_DESCRIPTION
desc: After fighting away the dragons, you hear the voices of the deceased singing around you. It looks like the creatures of this forest mean to stop you.

raw.en: After fighting away the dragons, you hear the voices of the deceased singing around you. It looks like the creatures of this forest mean to stop you.
raw.es: Después de desterrar a los dragones, oyes las voces de los muertos cantar a tu alrededor. Parece que las criaturas del bosque intentan detenerte.
raw.id: Setelah bertarung melawan naga, terdengar suara orang mati bernyanyi di sekitar. Sepertinya makhluk hutan ini bermaksud menghentikanmu.
raw.pt: Depois de enfrentar e expulsar os dragões, você ouve as vozes dos mortos cantando para você. Parece que as criaturas desta floresta querem parar você.
raw.th: หลังต่อสู้กับมังกร คุณได้ยินเสียงแห่งความตายจากรอบตัว คล้ายกับว่าสิ่งต่างๆ ในป่านี้พยายามจะหยุดยั้งคุณ
raw.vi: Sau khi đuổi lũ rồng đi, ngươi nghe thấy như có giọng người chết ca hát vây quanh mình. Dường như lũ sinh vật trong cánh rừng này có ý chặn ngươi lại.

id: Terasa angker seakan ada yang mengawasimu. Apakah Ark? Tidak, ini dari makhluk yang tinggal di hutan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1502_DESCRIPTION
desc: You get the eerie feeling that someone's watching you. Could it be Ark? No, this stare is from the beings dwelling in the forest.

raw.en: You get the eerie feeling that someone's watching you. Could it be Ark? No, this stare is from the beings dwelling in the forest.
raw.es: Tienes la inquietante sensación de que alguien te está espiando. ¿Será Ark? No, esa mirada es de los seres que merodean el bosque.
raw.id: Terasa angker seakan ada yang mengawasimu. Apakah Ark? Tidak, ini dari makhluk yang tinggal di hutan.
raw.pt: Você tem um sentimento sinistro de que alguém está observando. Será que é o Ark? Não, esse olhar é dos seres que vivem na floresta.
raw.th: คุณรู้สึกกลัวเหมือนถูกใครจ้องมอง หรือจะเป็นอาร์ค? เปล่าเลย มันคือสิ่งที่อยู่ในป่าแห่งนี้ต่างหาก
raw.vi: Ngươi có cảm giác kỳ lạ rằng ai đó đang theo dõi mình. Đó có thể là Ark? Không, ánh nhìn này từ con gì đó ở trong rừng.

id: Hutan remang sunyi senyap. Saat telingamu mulai terbiasa, segerombolan burung tiba-tiba menjerit.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1503_DESCRIPTION
desc: The dim forest is full of silence. The moment you think your ears have grown accustomed to it, a flock of birds suddenly lets out a shrilling cry.

raw.en: The dim forest is full of silence. The moment you think your ears have grown accustomed to it, a flock of birds suddenly lets out a shrilling cry.
raw.es: El bosque a media luz está en silencio. Cuando crees que tus oídos se acostumbraron, una bandada suelta un canto estridente.
raw.id: Hutan remang sunyi senyap. Saat telingamu mulai terbiasa, segerombolan burung tiba-tiba menjerit.
raw.pt: A floresta escura está silenciosa. Você acha que seus ouvidos se acostumaram, e uma revoada de pássaros emite um som estridente.
raw.th: ป่าอันมืดมัวนี้เต็มไปด้วยความเงียบ และเมื่อหูของคุณคุ้นชินกับเสียง ฝูงนกก็ร่ำไห้โหยหวนขึ้นมา
raw.vi: Cánh rừng âm u tràn ngập im lặng. Khi ngươi nghĩ đôi tai mình đã trở nên quen thuộc với nó, một đàn chim đột nhiên phát ra tiếng gào khóc the thé.

id: Setelah sekumpulan burung telah pergi, ada sekelompok dewi bertarung. Mereka mempelajarimu, mencoba menerka kekuatanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1504_DESCRIPTION
desc: After the flock of birds has gone, you encounter a group of fighting goddesses. They study you as if trying to gauge your power.

raw.en: After the flock of birds has gone, you encounter a group of fighting goddesses. They study you as if trying to gauge your power.
raw.es: Luego del paso de la bandada, encuentras a un grupo de diosas guerreras. Te examinan como queriendo medir tu poder.
raw.id: Setelah sekumpulan burung telah pergi, ada sekelompok dewi bertarung. Mereka mempelajarimu, mencoba menerka kekuatanmu.
raw.pt: Quando os pássaros vão embora, você encontra um grupo de deusas guerreiras. Elas estudam você como se tentassem medir o seu poder.
raw.th: หลังจากฝูงนกจากไป คุณก็พบกับกลุ่มที่ต่อสู้กับเทพธิดา พวกเขาพยายามจะวัดพลังของคุณ
raw.vi: Sau khi đàn chim đã biến mất, ngươi gặp một nhóm các nữ chiến thần. Họ chăm chú đến ngươi như thể cố gắng đánh giá sức mạnh của ngươi.

id: Hampir keluar hutan. Ingin bertemu Tilith secepatnya untuk mengobrol. Tapi setan rawa mencegatmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1505_DESCRIPTION
desc: You're almost out of the forest. You want to meet Tilith as soon as possible to talk to her, but the demonic miasma around you refuses to allow it.

raw.en: You're almost out of the forest. You want to meet Tilith as soon as possible to talk to her, but the demonic miasma around you refuses to allow it.
raw.es: Casi has salido del bosque. Quieres reunirte pronto con Tilith para hablar con ella, pero el miasma demoníaco a tu alrededor te lo impide.
raw.id: Hampir keluar hutan. Ingin bertemu Tilith secepatnya untuk mengobrol. Tapi setan rawa mencegatmu.
raw.pt: Você está quase fora da floresta. Você quer encontrar com Tilith o quanto antes para falar com ela, mas o miasma demoníaco em volta o impede.
raw.th: คุณเกือบจะออกจากป่านี้ได้แล้ว คุณต้องการพบธิลิทโดยเร็วเพื่อจะพูดคุยกับเธอ แต่ฝูงปีศาจที่มีพิษสงรอบตัวคุณคงไม่ยอมให้ผ่านไปง่ายๆ
raw.vi: Ngươi gần như sắp ra khỏi cánh rừng. Ngươi muốn gặp Tilith càng sớm càng tốt để nói chuyện với nàng, nhưng độc khí ma quỷ quanh ngươi không cho phép.

id: Kombinasi sikap mengancam si Seria dan semua memorimu tentang Tilith membuatmu diam. Paling baik memang mengikuti si Dewi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1510_DESCRIPTION
desc: The combination of Seria's excessively threatening attitude and all your memories of Tilith leave you in silence. You best follow the Goddess anyway.

raw.en: The combination of Seria's excessively threatening attitude and all your memories of Tilith leave you in silence. You best follow the Goddess anyway.
raw.es: La combinación entre la actitud desafiante de Seria y todos tus recuerdos sobre Tilith te deja en silencio. Como sea, deberías seguir a la diosa.
raw.id: Kombinasi sikap mengancam si Seria dan semua memorimu tentang Tilith membuatmu diam. Paling baik memang mengikuti si Dewi.
raw.pt: A combinação da atitude extremamente ameaçadora da Seria com todas as memórias de Tilith deixam você em silêncio. É melhor que você siga a deusa de qualquer forma.
raw.th: การถูกคุกคามของซีเรีย และความทรงจำของคุณต่อธิลิทผสมปนเปกันจนคุณตกอยู่ในความเงียบ ทางที่ดีที่สุด คุณก็ควรจะติดตามเทพธิดาไป
raw.vi: Thái độ đe dọa quá mức của Seria kết hợp với tất cả những hồi ức của ngươi về Tilith khiến ngươi lặng im. Dù sao tốt nhất ngươi hãy theo các Nữ thần.

id: Kabut sepanas api, naik dari pasir, membuatmu berpikir apakah ini sebenarnya adalah api.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1511_DESCRIPTION
desc: The heat haze rising from the sand is as hot as fire itself. It even makes you wonder whether it is actually aflame.

raw.en: The heat haze rising from the sand is as hot as fire itself. It even makes you wonder whether it is actually aflame.
raw.es: El humo que se eleva desde la arena es caliente como el fuego. Te lleva a preguntarte si no estará de verdad en llamas.
raw.id: Kabut sepanas api, naik dari pasir, membuatmu berpikir apakah ini sebenarnya adalah api.
raw.pt: A névoa do calor que sobe da areia é tão quente quanto o próprio fogo. Ela até faz com que você se pergunte se ela não está em chamas.
raw.th: หมอกทรายร้อนระอุนั้นร้อนยิ่งกว่าไฟ ทำให้คุณสงสัยว่าทำไมอากาศจึงเป็นเช่นนี้
raw.vi: Hơi nhiệt bốc lên từ cát cũng nóng bỏng như ngọn lửa chính nó. Thậm chí khiến ngươi tự hỏi liệu nó thực sự có là ngọn lửa hay không.

id: Merasa panas di gurun itu normal, tapi panasnya tidak selevel ini. Seakan adalah firasat akan ada banyak musuh yang ingin menghentikanmu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1512_DESCRIPTION
desc: It is only normal to feel hot in a desert, but you've never felt this degree of heat before. It's a premonition of the enemies who want to stop you.

raw.en: It is only normal to feel hot in a desert, but you've never felt this degree of heat before. It's a premonition of the enemies who want to stop you.
raw.es: Tener calor en el desierto es normal, pero nunca antes habías sentido algo de esta magnitud. Es una premonición de los enemigos que quieren detenerte.
raw.id: Merasa panas di gurun itu normal, tapi panasnya tidak selevel ini. Seakan adalah firasat akan ada banyak musuh yang ingin menghentikanmu.
raw.pt: É totalmente normal sentir calor em um deserto, mas você nunca sentiu um calor desse nível. É uma premonição dos inimigos que querem acabar com você.
raw.th: เป็นปกติที่ทะเลทรายจะร้อน แต่คุณไม่เคยรู้สึกร้อนเช่นนี้มาก่อน เหมือนเป็นการเตือนล่วงหน้าจากศัตรูว่าคุณควรจะหยุดอยู่แค่นี้
raw.vi: Nóng ở sa mạc là bình thường, nhưng ngươi chưa bao giờ cảm thấy độ nóng này. Đó là điềm báo của kẻ thù, những kẻ muốn ngăn chặn ngươi.

id: Gurun panas menyengat menghabiskan energi. Sepertinya Tilith tak akan muncul di sini, tapi jika berjumpa lagi, kau harus mencoba berbicara dengannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1513_DESCRIPTION
desc: The scorching desert is draining your energy. It doesn't seem like Tilith will appear here, but if you meet her again, you should try talking to her.

raw.en: The scorching desert is draining your energy. It doesn't seem like Tilith will appear here, but if you meet her again, you should try talking to her.
raw.es: El desierto abrasador consume tu energía. Parece poco probable que Tilith aparezca aquí, pero si vuelves a verla, debes tratar de hablar con ella.
raw.id: Gurun panas menyengat menghabiskan energi. Sepertinya Tilith tak akan muncul di sini, tapi jika berjumpa lagi, kau harus mencoba berbicara dengannya.
raw.pt: O deserto escaldante está drenando sua energia. Não parece que a Tilith vai aparecer aqui mas, se você encontrá-la de novo, devia tentar falar com ela.
raw.th: ทะเลทรายที่ร้อนราวลุกไหม้ทำให้คุณหมดแรงไปเยอะ และไม่มีทีท่าว่าธิลิทจะปรากฎตัวขึ้นเลย แต่ถ้าพบเธออีกครั้งก็ต้องลองคุยกัน
raw.vi: Sa mạc thiêu đốt đang bòn rút năng lượng của ngươi. Dường như Tilith sẽ không xuất hiện ở đây, nhưng nếu ngươi gặp lại nàng, hãy nên thử nói chuyện.

id: Kau merasakan kehadiran seseorang. Tidak diragukan lagi, Tilith ada di dekat. Kau tidak ingin bertarung dengannya, tapi bagaimana nanti...?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1514_DESCRIPTION
desc: You feel a presence. There's no doubt that Tilith is near. You want to avoid a fight with her, but how will it all turn out...?

raw.en: You feel a presence. There's no doubt that Tilith is near. You want to avoid a fight with her, but how will it all turn out...?
raw.es: Sientes una presencia. No hay duda de que Tilith está cerca. Quieres evitar enfrentarla, pero... ¿resultará?
raw.id: Kau merasakan kehadiran seseorang. Tidak diragukan lagi, Tilith ada di dekat. Kau tidak ingin bertarung dengannya, tapi bagaimana nanti...?
raw.pt: Você sente uma presença. Não há dúvida de que a Tilith está por perto. Você quer evitar uma luta com ela, mas como que isso vai acabar?
raw.th: คุณรู้สึกได้ถึงใครคนหนึ่ง ไม่ต้องสงสัยเลยว่าธิลิทต้องอยู่ใกล้ๆ นี้ คุณไม่อยากต่อสู้กับเธอ แต่จะหยุดยั้งมันได้ยังไงล่ะ...?
raw.vi: Ngươi cảm thấy có gì đó hiện diện. Chẳng nghi ngờ gì nữa, Tilith đang gần đây. Ngươi muốn tránh cuộc chiến với nàng, nhưng mọi chuyện sẽ ra sao...?

id: Aliran sungai merah ada di depan, mengingatkanmu akan hutan merah dari petualangan sebelumnya. Di masa-masa sulit, Tilith masih berada di sisimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1520_DESCRIPTION
desc: A red river flows ahead. It reminds you of a red forest from your previous exploits. Just like during those hard times, Tilith is still by your side.

raw.en: A red river flows ahead. It reminds you of a red forest from your previous exploits. Just like during those hard times, Tilith is still by your side.
raw.es: Un río rojo corre delante de ti. Te transporta hacia un bosque rojo de tus anteriores proezas. Como en esos tiempos difíciles, Tilith sigue a tu lado.
raw.id: Aliran sungai merah ada di depan, mengingatkanmu akan hutan merah dari petualangan sebelumnya. Di masa-masa sulit, Tilith masih berada di sisimu.
raw.pt: Um rio vermelho corre adiante. Faz lembrar da floresta vermelha de jornadas anteriores. E como naquela época difícil, Tilith ainda está do seu lado.
raw.th: ที่แม่น้ำสีแดงด้านหน้า ทำให้คุณนึกถึงป่าที่เคยสำรวจมา นึกถึงช่วงยากลำบากในตอนนั้น ธิลิทก็ยังอยู่ข้างคุณ
raw.vi: Sông đỏ chảy về trước. Nó gợi đến cánh rừng đỏ thẫm ở lần ngươi thám hiểm trước đó. Cũng giống như những lúc khó khăn, Tilith vẫn sát cánh bên ngươi.

id: Apa yang menunggumu? Kau tidak yakin, tapi melihat ombak merah membuatmu merasa gelisah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1521_DESCRIPTION
desc: What could be awaiting you? You are not completely sure, but watching the crimson waves makes you all the more uneasy.

raw.en: What could be awaiting you? You are not completely sure, but watching the crimson waves makes you all the more uneasy.
raw.es: ¿Qué te podría estar esperando? No estás seguro, pero las olas carmesí te hacen sentir incómodo.
raw.id: Apa yang menunggumu? Kau tidak yakin, tapi melihat ombak merah membuatmu merasa gelisah.
raw.pt: O que pode estar esperando por você? Você não tem tanta certeza mas observar as ondas vermelhas o deixa mais desconfortável ainda.
raw.th: อะไรที่รอคุณอยู่? คุณก็ไม่แน่ใจ แต่จากคลื่นสีแดงฉานที่เห็นทำให้คุณรู้สึกว่ามันไม่ง่ายนัก
raw.vi: Chuyện gì có thể chờ đón ngươi nữa? Ngươi không chắc chắn lắm, nhưng nhìn những ngọn sóng đỏ thẫm khiến ngươi khó chịu hơn.

id: Cipratan merah yang dingin. Pertanda lawan kuat ada di depan. Waspadai sekelilingmu dan bersiaplah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1522_DESCRIPTION
desc: The red splash is freezing. You have now seen this omen of the strong opponents ahead a number of times. Beware of your surroundings and get ready.

raw.en: The red splash is freezing. You have now seen this omen of the strong opponents ahead a number of times. Beware of your surroundings and get ready.
raw.es: El agua roja está helada. Sabes bien que es un presagio de que te esperan fuertes enemigos. No bajes la guardia y prepárate.
raw.id: Cipratan merah yang dingin. Pertanda lawan kuat ada di depan. Waspadai sekelilingmu dan bersiaplah.
raw.pt: A água vermelha é congelante. Você já viu essa indicação dos fortes inimigos que estão por vir algumas vezes. Fique atento aos arredores e prepare-se.
raw.th: น้ำสีแดงที่สาดกระเซ็นถูกแช่แข็ง คุณมีลางเกี่ยวกับศัตรูที่แข็งแกร่งกว่าที่ผ่านมา จงระวังตัวและเตรียมพร้อมเข้าไว้
raw.vi: Bọt văng đỏ thẫm đang đông cứng lại. Giờ đây ngươi lại thấy trước vài lần điềm báo này về những đối thủ mạnh mẽ. Hãy cẩn thận xung quanh ngươi và chuẩn bị sẵn sàng.

id: Arus merah terlihat seperti darah. Jika manusia akan dihancurkan sekali lagi, lanskapnya mungkin menyerupai gambar ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1523_DESCRIPTION
desc: The red current looks just like blood. If humans were to be destroyed once again, the landscape would probably resemble an image like this one.

raw.en: The red current looks just like blood. If humans were to be destroyed once again, the landscape would probably resemble an image like this one.
raw.es: La corriente roja parece sangre. Si alguien destruyera a los humanos otra vez, el paisaje probablemente se vería como este.
raw.id: Arus merah terlihat seperti darah. Jika manusia akan dihancurkan sekali lagi, lanskapnya mungkin menyerupai gambar ini.
raw.pt: A corrente vermelha parece muito com sangue. Se os humanos fossem destruídos novamente, a paisagem pareceria com essa.
raw.th: สายน้ำสีแดงดูคล้ายเลือด หากมนุษย์ถูกล้างบางอีกครั้ง แผ่นดินก็คงจะมีลักษณะเช่นนี้
raw.vi: Dòng nước đỏ trông như máu tươi. Nếu con người một lần nữa bị diệt vong, khung cảnh này có lẽ sẽ giống như một bức ảnh như vậy thôi.

id: Pantulan sinar di air membuat sungai berkilau. Warnanya membuatmu merasa tidak nyaman sebelumnya, tapi mungkin sekarang terlihat indah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1524_DESCRIPTION
desc: The reflection of the light on the water makes the river sparkle. Its color made you uncomfortable before, but it may make for a beautiful view now.

raw.en: The reflection of the light on the water makes the river sparkle. Its color made you uncomfortable before, but it may make for a beautiful view now.
raw.es: El reflejo de la luz en el agua hace que el río resplandezca. Su color ya te hizo sentir incómodo, pero ahora ofrece una vista hermosa.
raw.id: Pantulan sinar di air membuat sungai berkilau. Warnanya membuatmu merasa tidak nyaman sebelumnya, tapi mungkin sekarang terlihat indah.
raw.pt: O reflexo da luz na água faz o rio brilhar. A cor dela o deixou desconfortável antes, mas agora pode formar uma bela paisagem.
raw.th: แสงสะท้อนผิวน้ำทำให้แม่น้ำเป็นประกายวิบวับ สีของมันที่ทำให้รู้สึกไม่สบายใจก่อนหน้านี้ กลับดูสวยงามขึ้นมาแล้ว
raw.vi: Ánh sáng phản chiếu trên mặt nước khiến dòng sông trở nên lấp lánh. Màu sắc nó trước kia làm ngươi khó chịu, nhưng giờ đây lại tạo nên cảnh tượng xinh đẹp.

id: Tiba di kota hantu. Mungkin sebelumnya adalah desa normal sebelum dihancurkan. Rumput tebal tumbuh di sisa-sisa jalanan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1530_DESCRIPTION
desc: You have arrived at a ghost town. It was probably a normal village before it was destroyed. Thick grass grows along the remnants of the streets.

raw.en: You have arrived at a ghost town. It was probably a normal village before it was destroyed. Thick grass grows along the remnants of the streets.
raw.es: Llegas a un pueblo fantasma. Antes de que lo arrasaran, probablemente haya sido una aldea normal. La hierba crece espesa sobre los restos de las calles.
raw.id: Tiba di kota hantu. Mungkin sebelumnya adalah desa normal sebelum dihancurkan. Rumput tebal tumbuh di sisa-sisa jalanan.
raw.pt: Você chegou em uma cidade fantasma. Provavelmente tenha sido um vilarejo normal antes de ser destruída. Grama grossa nasce no que restou das ruas.
raw.th: คุณมาถึงเมืองร้าง มันดูเป็นหมู่บ้านธรรมดาก่อนจะถูกทำลาย หญ้าขึ้นหนาทึบจนแทบไม่เห็นถนน
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đến một thị trấn ma. Có lẽ đó là một ngôi làng bình thường trước khi nó bị phá hủy. Đám cỏ mọc um tùm dọc theo những tàn tích trên đường phố.

id: Kau hanya khawatir tentang diinjak, tapi sekarang terlihat menara raksasa di kejauhan. Pastilah itu Menara Peramal.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1531_DESCRIPTION
desc: You were only worried about were stepped, but now you've noticed a gigantic tower in the distance. It must be the so-called Tower of the Oracle.

raw.en: You were only worried about were stepped, but now you've noticed a gigantic tower in the distance. It must be the so-called Tower of the Oracle.
raw.es: Solo te preocupaban tus pasos, pero ahora has visto una torre gigante en la distancia. Debe ser la llamada Torre del Oráculo.
raw.id: Kau hanya khawatir tentang diinjak, tapi sekarang terlihat menara raksasa di kejauhan. Pastilah itu Menara Peramal.
raw.pt: Você só estava preocupado com onde pisava, mas agora percebeu uma torre gigantesca ao longe. Deve ser o que chamam de Torre do Oráculo.
raw.th: คุณกังวลเรื่องการเดินทาง แต่ตอนนี้คุณมองเห็นหอคอยขนาดมหึมาอยู่เบื้องหน้าแล้ว ต้องเป็นที่ที่เรียกกันว่าหอคอยแห่งนักพยากรณ์แน่นอน
raw.vi: Ngươi chỉ lo nơi chúng ta bước đến, nhưng giờ đây ngươi đã nhận ra một tòa tháp khổng lồ ở phía xa. Chắc chắn cái đó gọi là Tháp Oracle.

id: Pemandangan hijau di sekitarmu semakin intens. Mungkin semua ini hanya ada di kepalamu, tapi mungkinkah serangga memperingatkanmu? Musuh ada di sini!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1532_DESCRIPTION
desc: The greenery around you has grown louder. It could all be in your head, but is it possible that the insects are trying to warn you? The enemy's here!

raw.en: The greenery around you has grown louder. It could all be in your head, but is it possible that the insects are trying to warn you? The enemy's here!
raw.es: Los ruidos inundan la vegetación. Podría ser tu imaginación, ¿pero acaso los insectos estarán intentando advertirte algo? ¡El enemigo está aquí!
raw.id: Pemandangan hijau di sekitarmu semakin intens. Mungkin semua ini hanya ada di kepalamu, tapi mungkinkah serangga memperingatkanmu? Musuh ada di sini!
raw.pt: A vegetação por aqui cresceu bastante. Pode ser coisa da sua cabeça, mas será possível que os insetos estejam tentando alertar você? O inimigo está aqui!
raw.th: ต้นไม้เขียวขจีขึ้นเต็มไปหมด คุณน่าจะรู้ แต่จะเป็นไปได้มั้ยที่เหล่าแมลงพยายามจะเตือนคุณ? ว่าศัตรูอยู่ที่นี่!
raw.vi: Cây cỏ xung quanh ngươi đã trở nên to lớn hơn. Mọi thứ đều có thể ở trong đầu ngươi, nhưng phải chăng lũ côn trùng đang cố cảnh báo ngươi? Kẻ thù ở đây!

id: Manusia belum sepenuhnya mengerti konsep dewa. Melihat Tilith, kau merasa tidak banyak perbedaannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1533_DESCRIPTION
desc: Humans don't fully understand the concept of a god yet. However, looking at Tilith you can't help but to feel there's not much of a difference.

raw.en: Humans don't fully understand the concept of a god yet. However, looking at Tilith you can't help but to feel there's not much of a difference.
raw.es: Los humanos aún no entienden el concepto de 'dios'. Sin embargo, al ver a Tilith, no puedes evitar sentir que no hay mucha diferencia.
raw.id: Manusia belum sepenuhnya mengerti konsep dewa. Melihat Tilith, kau merasa tidak banyak perbedaannya.
raw.pt: Humanos ainda não entendem o conceito de um deus. Mas olhando para a Tilith você sente não há muita diferença.
raw.th: มนุษย์ไม่อาจเข้าใจความคิดทั้งหมดของเทพ อย่างไรก็ตาม เมื่อมองธิลิทแล้ว ก็ดูไม่แปลกใจนัก
raw.vi: Con người vẫn chưa hiểu hết được khái niệm của một vị thần. Tuy nhiên, nhìn Tilith ngươi không thể không cảm thấy chẳng có nhiều khác biệt.

id: Di pinggiran desa ada kuil kecil. Saat melewatinya, kau melihat menara di depan. Ark menantimu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1534_DESCRIPTION
desc: In the outskirts of the village lies a small shrine. As you go past it, you lay your eyes upon the tower standing ahead. Ark awaits you.

raw.en: In the outskirts of the village lies a small shrine. As you go past it, you lay your eyes upon the tower standing ahead. Ark awaits you.
raw.es: En las afueras de la aldea yace un pequeño santuario. Al rebasarlo, posas los ojos sobre la torre que se yergue a la distancia. Ark te espera.
raw.id: Di pinggiran desa ada kuil kecil. Saat melewatinya, kau melihat menara di depan. Ark menantimu.
raw.pt: Há um pequeno templo nos arredores do vilarejo. Quando passa por ele você enxerga a torre adiante. Ark o aguarda.
raw.th: ที่พื้นที่นอกหมู่บ้านมีสุสานเล็กๆ เมื่อคุณเดินผ่านและมองไปยังหอคอยที่ตั้งอยู่เบื้องหน้า นั่นล่ะ อาร์คกำลังรอคุณอยู่
raw.vi: Ở vùng ngoại ô ngôi làng nằm bên một ngôi đền nhỏ. Khi đi qua đấy, ngươi để mắt thấy tòa tháp sừng sững phía trước. Ark đang chờ ngươi.

id: Apa motivasi Ark yang sesungguhnya? Mengapa mencoba menguji kekuatan Pemanggil? Atau ia mencoba mengakhiri segalanya di sini?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1540_DESCRIPTION
desc: What could Ark's real motives be? Why is he attempting to test the Summoners' power? Or could he be trying to end it all here?

raw.en: What could Ark's real motives be? Why is he attempting to test the Summoners' power? Or could he be trying to end it all here?
raw.es: ¿Cuáles serán los motivos reales de Ark? ¿Por qué quiere poner a prueba el poder de los invocadores? ¿Estará intentando terminar todo de una vez?
raw.id: Apa motivasi Ark yang sesungguhnya? Mengapa mencoba menguji kekuatan Pemanggil? Atau ia mencoba mengakhiri segalanya di sini?
raw.pt: Quais seriam as reais motivações do Ark? Por que ele quer testar o poder dos invocadores? Ou será que quer acabar com tudo aqui mesmo?
raw.th: จริงๆ แล้วอาร์คคิดจะทำอะไรกันแน่? ทำไมเขาต้องการทดสอบพลังของซัมมอนเนอร์? หรือเขาต้องการจบทุกสิ่งลงที่นี่?
raw.vi: Động cơ thực sự của Ark là gì? Tại sao anh ta cố gắng kiểm tra sức mạnh của Người Triệu Hồi? Hoặc có thể anh ta cố gắng kết thúc tất cả ở đây?

id: Musuhmu kuat. Tapi kau tidak hanya akan bertarung saja. Kemampuanmu menghentikan 4 Dewa Sesat tidak main-main, dan Ark tahu itu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1541_DESCRIPTION
desc: The enemy is strong. However, you won't just stop fighting. Your ability to stop the Four Fallen Gods was no hoax, but Ark is well aware of that.

raw.en: The enemy is strong. However, you won't just stop fighting. Your ability to stop the Four Fallen Gods was no hoax, but Ark is well aware of that.
raw.es: El enemigo es fuerte. Pero tú no te detendrás tan fácilmente. Tu habilidad para detener a los Cuatro Dioses Caídos no es broma, y Ark lo sabe bien.
raw.id: Musuhmu kuat. Tapi kau tidak hanya akan bertarung saja. Kemampuanmu menghentikan 4 Dewa Sesat tidak main-main, dan Ark tahu itu.
raw.pt: O inimigo é forte. Mas você não vai simplesmente parar de lutar. Sua habilidade ao derrotar os Quatro Deuses Caídos não foi brincadeira, mas o Ark sabe bem disso.
raw.th: ศัตรูแข็งแกร่งมาก แต่คุณก็หยุดต่อสู้ไม่ได้ พลังในการหยุดยั้งจตุรเทพมารของคุณไม่ใช่เรื่องโกหก แต่อาร์คเองก็รู้เรื่องนี้นี่นา
raw.vi: Kẻ thù mạnh. Tuy nhiên, ngươi sẽ không ngừng chiến. Năng lực của ngươi để chặn bốn Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần chẳng phải trò lừa, nhưng Ark cũng biết điều đó.

id: Awan guntur meraung dalam tembok menara. Kau mengaktifkan jebakan atau ini kekuatan musuh? Kau harus bisa melaluinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1542_DESCRIPTION
desc: Thunder clouds roar within the walls of the tower. Did you set off a trap, or could this be the enemy's power? Either way, you must push through.

raw.en: Thunder clouds roar within the walls of the tower. Did you set off a trap, or could this be the enemy's power? Either way, you must push through.
raw.es: Las nubes rugen dentro de los muros de la torre. ¿Será una trampa o este podría ser el poder del enemigo? Sea como sea, debes seguir adelante.
raw.id: Awan guntur meraung dalam tembok menara. Kau mengaktifkan jebakan atau ini kekuatan musuh? Kau harus bisa melaluinya.
raw.pt: Nuvens de tempestade ecoam nas paredes da torre. Será que você ativou uma armadilha ou é esse o poder do inimigo? Seja o que for, você deve seguir adiante.
raw.th: เมฆสายฟ้าร้องคำรามอยู่ภายในกำแพงของหอคอย นี่คือกับดัก หรือพลังของศัตรู? แต่ยังไงซะคุณก็ต้องผ่านมันไปให้ได้
raw.vi: Mây sấm chớp gầm thét trong bức tường tòa tháp. Phải chăng ngươi đặt bẫy, hay đó là sức mạnh của kẻ thù? Dù thế nào chăng nữa, ngươi phải vượt qua. Dù thế nào chăng nữa, ngươi phải vượt qua.

id: Kau hampir mencapai puncak menara. Dan merasakan hawa kuat. Apakah makhluk yang disebut-sebut Ark menunggu di depan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1543_DESCRIPTION
desc: You're close to the top of the tower. As you continue forth, you feel a strong presence. Could the beings Ark mentioned be waiting ahead?

raw.en: You're close to the top of the tower. As you continue forth, you feel a strong presence. Could the beings Ark mentioned be waiting ahead?
raw.es: Estás cerca de la cima de la torre. A medida que avanzas, sientes una fuerte presencia. ¿Será que los seres que Ark mencionó te esperan delante?
raw.id: Kau hampir mencapai puncak menara. Dan merasakan hawa kuat. Apakah makhluk yang disebut-sebut Ark menunggu di depan?
raw.pt: Você está perto do topo da torre. Enquanto segue adiante você sente uma presença poderosa. Será que os seres que o Ark citou aguardam adiante?
raw.th: คุณขึ้นไปเกือบชั้นบนสุดของหอคอยแล้ว ขณะกำลังมุ่งหน้าไป คุณรู้สึกได้ถึงบางอย่าง หรือว่าอาร์คกำลังรอคอยอยู่?
raw.vi: Ngươi đã gần đến đỉnh tháp. Khi tiếp tục dấn bước, ngươi cảm thấy một sự hiện diện mạnh mẽ. Liệu có phải thứ Ark đã đề cập đang chờ đợi phía trước?

id: Seperti apa musuh-musuh itu? Banyak yang terhubung dengan Ark. Artinya musuh berikutnya adalah...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1544_DESCRIPTION
desc: What could have those enemies been? Many seemed to have been related to Ark somehow. That must mean that the next enemy is...

raw.en: What could have those enemies been? Many seemed to have been related to Ark somehow. That must mean that the next enemy is...
raw.es: ¿Quiénes habrán sido esos enemigos? Muchos de ellos estaban, de alguna manera, relacionados con Ark. Eso significa que el próximo enemigo es...
raw.id: Seperti apa musuh-musuh itu? Banyak yang terhubung dengan Ark. Artinya musuh berikutnya adalah...
raw.pt: O que poderiam ter sido aqueles inimigos? Muitos pareciam ter algum tipo de relação com Ark. Isso deve querer dizer que o próximo inimigo é...
raw.th: พวกศัตรูนี่มันยังไงกันนะ หลายตัวดูมีความเกี่ยวข้องกับอาร์ค หรือนี่หมายความว่า ศัตรูคนต่อไปคือ...
raw.vi: Những kẻ thù đó liệu có thể là ai? Nhiều kẻ dường như có liên quan tới Ark như thế nào đó. Điều đó nghĩa là kẻ thù tiếp theo là...

id: Perkataan Ark berdampak kuat. Apa rencana Lucius dengan manusia sekarang? Tidak ada pilihan lain selain mencarinya dan bertanya langsung.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1550_DESCRIPTION
desc: Ark's words had a strong impact. What does Lucius plan to do with humanity now? There's no choice but to seek him and ask him directly.

raw.en: Ark's words had a strong impact. What does Lucius plan to do with humanity now? There's no choice but to seek him and ask him directly.
raw.es: Las palabras de Ark tuvieron un fuerte impacto. ¿Qué planeará hacer Lucius con la humanidad ahora? No hay opción más que buscarlo y preguntárselo.
raw.id: Perkataan Ark berdampak kuat. Apa rencana Lucius dengan manusia sekarang? Tidak ada pilihan lain selain mencarinya dan bertanya langsung.
raw.pt: As palavras de Ark tiveram um forte impacto. Qual será o plano de Lucius para a humanidade agora? Não há escolha senão ir atrás dele e perguntar diretamente.
raw.th: คำพูดของอาร์คมีผลกระทบอันใหญ่หลวง ลูเซียสคิดจะทำอะไรกับมนุษยชาติกันแน่? ไม่มีทางเลือกแต่ก็ต้องไปหาและถามเขาให้ได้
raw.vi: Những lời của Ark đã có tác động mạnh mẽ. Lucius dự tính làm gì với loài người bây giờ? Chẳng có lựa chọn nào ngoài việc tìm và hỏi anh ta trực tiếp.

id: Saat Ark membuka topengnya, tekadnya tercermin di wajahnya. Mampukah kau mendengar informasi penting lainnya dari Ark lagi?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1551_DESCRIPTION
desc: When Ark removed his mask, his determination was written all over his face. Will you be able to hear any more important information from him again?

raw.en: When Ark removed his mask, his determination was written all over his face. Will you be able to hear any more important information from him again?
raw.es: Cuando Ark se quitó la máscara, su determinación se le notaba en la cara. ¿Compartirá contigo más información importante en el futuro?
raw.id: Saat Ark membuka topengnya, tekadnya tercermin di wajahnya. Mampukah kau mendengar informasi penting lainnya dari Ark lagi?
raw.pt: Quando Ark tirou a máscara, a determinação dele estava estampada no rosto. Será que você vai ouvir mais informações importantes dele?
raw.th: เมื่ออาร์คถอดหน้ากาก การตัดสินใจของเขาก็ปรากฎอยู่บนใบหน้า คุณจะได้ยินข้อมูลสำคัญเช่นนี้จากเขาอีกหรือไม่?
raw.vi: Khi Ark bỏ mặt nạ của mình, quyết tâm của anh in hằn trên khắp khuôn mặt. Liệu ngươi sẽ có thể nghe lại được mọi thông tin quan trọng từ anh ấy?

id: Tilith melongo mendngar perkataan Ark tentant Lucius. Sepertinya ia bahkan tidak mengetahui apa-apa tentang tuannya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1552_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tilith seems completely at a loss about what Ark said regarding Lucius. It seems even she doesn't know everything about her master.

raw.en: Tilith seems completely at a loss about what Ark said regarding Lucius. It seems even she doesn't know everything about her master.
raw.es: Tilith parece desconcertada sobre lo que Ark dijo acerca de Lucius. Parece que ni ella lo sabe todo sobre su amo.
raw.id: Tilith melongo mendngar perkataan Ark tentant Lucius. Sepertinya ia bahkan tidak mengetahui apa-apa tentang tuannya.
raw.pt: A Tilith parece completamente perdida com relação ao que o Ark disso para o Lucius. Parece que nem mesmo ela sabe tudo sobre o próprio mestre.
raw.th: ธิลิทเสียใจอย่างมากเมื่อได้ยินสิ่งที่อาร์คพูดเกี่ยวกับลูเซียส ดูเหมือนเธอจะไม่รู้อะไรเกี่ยวกับอาจารย์ของเธอเลย
raw.vi: Tilith dường như á khẩu trước những gì Ark nói về Lucius. Có vẻ như ngay cả nàng cũng chẳng biết mọi thứ về sư phụ của mình.

id: Ketegangan membuat semuanya di ujung tanduk. Apakah ini murka para pahlawan? Sosok Ark perlahan terlihat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1553_DESCRIPTION
desc: A tension in the air is putting everything on edge. Is this the wrath of the heroes? Ark's figure is slowly becoming visible.

raw.en: A tension in the air is putting everything on edge. Is this the wrath of the heroes? Ark's figure is slowly becoming visible.
raw.es: Una tensión en el ambiente está poniendo a todos nerviosos. ¿Esta es la ira de los héroes? La figura de Ark se vuelve visible lentamente.
raw.id: Ketegangan membuat semuanya di ujung tanduk. Apakah ini murka para pahlawan? Sosok Ark perlahan terlihat.
raw.pt: Uma tensão no ar está deixando a situação nervosa. Essa é a ira dos heróis? A silhueta de Ark está ficando visível aos poucos.
raw.th: สถานการณ์ดูตึงเครียด หรือนี่คือความโกรธของเหล่าวีรุบุรษ? ขณะที่ร่างของอาร์คก็เริ่มเลือนหายไป
raw.vi: Bầu không khí căng thẳng khiến mọi thứ căng như dây đàn. Đây có phải là sự phẫn nộ của các anh hùng? Bóng hình của Ark đang dần hiện rõ.

id: Kutukan Karna Masta... Memanggil tadinya dipercaya adalah kekuatan yang diberikan Lucius, tapi sepertinya lebih rumit daripada itu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1554_DESCRIPTION
desc: The curse of Karna Masta... Summoning was believed to be a power granted by Lucius, but things seem more complicated than that.

raw.en: The curse of Karna Masta... Summoning was believed to be a power granted by Lucius, but things seem more complicated than that.
raw.es: La maldición de Karma Masta... Se creía que la invocación era un poder otorgado por Lucius, pero parece que las cosas son más complicadas.
raw.id: Kutukan Karna Masta... Memanggil tadinya dipercaya adalah kekuatan yang diberikan Lucius, tapi sepertinya lebih rumit daripada itu.
raw.pt: A maldição de Karna Masta... Acreditava-se que a invocação teria sido um poder concedido por Lucius, mas parece que as coisas não são tão simples.
raw.th: คำสาปของคาร์น่า มาสตาร์...การอันเชิญที่เชื่อว่าจะได้รับพลังจากลูเซียส แต่มันซับซ้อนกว่านั้น
raw.vi: Lời nguyền của Karna Masta... Việc triệu tập được cho là một quyền năng do Lucius trao tặng, nhưng mọi thứ có vẻ phức tạp hơn.

id: Sejarah yang ada hanyalah sebagian kecil dari sejarah seutuhnya. Pengetahuan baru apa yang menanti di masa depan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1555_DESCRIPTION
desc: The history left behind is only a small portion of the history that has actually taken place. What new knowledge could be awaiting in the future?

raw.en: The history left behind is only a small portion of the history that has actually taken place. What new knowledge could be awaiting in the future?
raw.es: La historia oculta es solo una pequeña porción de la historia acontecida. ¿Qué nuevo conocimiento podría aguardar en el futuro?
raw.id: Sejarah yang ada hanyalah sebagian kecil dari sejarah seutuhnya. Pengetahuan baru apa yang menanti di masa depan?
raw.pt: A história descoberta é só uma pequena parte da história que realmente aconteceu. Qual nova informação pode estar esperando por você no futuro?
raw.th: ประวัติศาสตร์ที่ถูกลืมเป็นเพียงส่วนเล็กๆ ที่ถูกประวัติศาสตร์อื่นแทนที่ แล้วหน้าประวัติศาสตร์แบบไหนล่ะที่กำลังจะเกิดขึ้น?
raw.vi: Lịch sử còn lại chỉ là một phần nhỏ của những gì đã thực sự diễn ra. Những tri thức mới mẻ nào có thể đang chờ đợi trong tương lai?

id: Tilith berkata ia menjadi murid Lucius setelah perang besar dengan para dewa. Mungkin ada banyak hal yang bahkan Tilith tidak tahu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1556_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tilith said she became Lucius's disciple after the great war with the gods. There may be even more things Tilith doesn't know than initially thought.

raw.en: Tilith said she became Lucius's disciple after the great war with the gods. There may be even more things Tilith doesn't know than initially thought.
raw.es: Tilith dijo que se volvió discípula de Lucius después de la gran guerra contra los dioses. Todavía debe haber más cosas que Tilith no sabe.
raw.id: Tilith berkata ia menjadi murid Lucius setelah perang besar dengan para dewa. Mungkin ada banyak hal yang bahkan Tilith tidak tahu.
raw.pt: A Tilith disse que se tornou discípula de Lucius depois da grande guerra contra os deuses. Pode ter ainda mais que a Tilith não saiba do que achávamos.
raw.th: ธิลิทบอกว่าเธอมาเป็นศิษย์ของลูเซียสหลังจากสงครามแห่งเทพ ซึ่งน่าจะมีเรื่องที่เธอไม่รู้เรื่องมากกว่าที่คิด
raw.vi: Tilith cho biết nàng đã trở thành đệ tử của Lucius sau đại chiến với các vị thần. Có thể còn nhiều thứ khác Tilith chưa biết so với suy nghĩ ban đầu.

id: Sepertinya perang melawan Lucius sudah jelas sekarang. Jika kau bisa meyakinkan Tilith...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1560_DESCRIPTION
desc: It seems a fight against Lucius is imminent now. If only you could convince Tilith otherwise...

raw.en: It seems a fight against Lucius is imminent now. If only you could convince Tilith otherwise...
raw.es: La pelea contra Lucius parece inminente. Si tan solo pudieras convencer a Tilith...
raw.id: Sepertinya perang melawan Lucius sudah jelas sekarang. Jika kau bisa meyakinkan Tilith...
raw.pt: Parece que uma luta contra Lucius está próxima. Se você pudesse ao menos convencer a Tilith do contrário...
raw.th: ดูเหมือนการต่อสู้กับลูเซียสเริ่มใกล้เข้ามา และเพียงคุณโน้มน้าวธิลิทได้สำเร็จ...
raw.vi: Dường như giờ đây sắp xảy ra một cuộc chiến chống lại Lucius. Chỉ ngươi mới có thể thuyết phục Tilith bằng không...

id: Tempat ini katanya adalah lokasi orang menerima perintah ilahi dari para dewa. Pastilah ini tempat spesial bagi Ksatria Oracle Ark.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1561_DESCRIPTION
desc: This place is said to have been where people received divine commands from the gods. It must be a special place for the Oracle Knight Ark.

raw.en: This place is said to have been where people received divine commands from the gods. It must be a special place for the Oracle Knight Ark.
raw.es: Se dice que este es el lugar donde la gente recibía órdenes divinas de los dioses. Debe ser un lugar especial para Ark, el Caballero del Oráculo.
raw.id: Tempat ini katanya adalah lokasi orang menerima perintah ilahi dari para dewa. Pastilah ini tempat spesial bagi Ksatria Oracle Ark.
raw.pt: Dizem que esse era o lugar em que as pessoas recebiam ordens dos deuses. Deve ser um lugar especial para o Cavaleiro do Oráculo Ark.
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าที่นี่คือสถานที่รับคำสั่งจากเทพ ต้องเป็นสถานที่สำคัญของอาร์ค อัศวินนักพยากรณ์แน่ๆ
raw.vi: Nơi này được cho là nơi mọi người nhận những mệnh lệnh thiêng liêng từ các vị thần. Nó phải là một nơi đặc biệt cho Hiệp sĩ Oracle Ark.

id: Eksterior kokoh batu karang sepertinya ingin mengusir orang, tapi mungkin menguji apa kau cukup kuat untuk memanjatnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1562_DESCRIPTION
desc: The rocks' tough exterior seems to want to keep people away, but it may be testing if you have enough strength to finish the dreaded climb.

raw.en: The rocks' tough exterior seems to want to keep people away, but it may be testing if you have enough strength to finish the dreaded climb.
raw.es: La escarpada superficie de la roca parece querer alejar a la gente, pero podría ser una prueba de fuerza para llevar a cabo el temido ascenso.
raw.id: Eksterior kokoh batu karang sepertinya ingin mengusir orang, tapi mungkin menguji apa kau cukup kuat untuk memanjatnya.
raw.pt: O exterior áspero das rochas parece querer afastar as pessoas, mas pode também estar testando se você tem força suficiente para terminar a escalada.
raw.th: กองหินด้านนอกเหมือนไม่ต้องการให้ใครเข้ามาที่นี่ หรือนี่จะเป็นการทดสอบว่ามีพลังมากพอจะก้าวข้ามมันไปได้หรือไม่
raw.vi: Vẻ ngoài thô ráp của mỏm đá dường như khiến mọi người tránh xa, nhưng nó đầy thách đố nếu ngươi đủ mạnh leo qua dốc đá tử thần.

id: Berapa bulan berlalu sejak gunung ini kehilangan tujuan aslinya? Kegelapan pekat melingkupi jalur di pegunungan ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1563_DESCRIPTION
desc: How many moons have passed since this mountain lost its original purpose? The darkness that lingers in these mountain paths is quite dense.

raw.en: How many moons have passed since this mountain lost its original purpose? The darkness that lingers in these mountain paths is quite dense.
raw.es: ¿Cuántas lunas habrán pasado desde que esta montaña perdió su propósito original? La oscuridad que cubre estos caminos de montaña es bastante densa.
raw.id: Berapa bulan berlalu sejak gunung ini kehilangan tujuan aslinya? Kegelapan pekat melingkupi jalur di pegunungan ini.
raw.pt: Quantos anos passaram desde o momento em que esta montanha perdeu seu propósito original? A escuridão que habita os caminhos desta montanha é bem densa.
raw.th: ผ่านมากี่คืนแล้วที่ภูเขาแห่งนี้สูญเสียวัตถุประสงค์ดั้งเดิมของมันไป? ความมืดที่ยังคงค้างอยู่ในเส้นทางภูเขานี้ค่อนข้างขุ่นมัว
raw.vi: Đã mất bao nhiêu mùa trăng trôi qua từ khi ngọn núi này mất đi mục đích ban đầu của nó? Bóng tối hiện diện ở những con đường núi ngày càng trở nên âm u.

id: Bayangan mengintai di bubungan di bawah. Sosok bertameng hitam pekat mungkin adalah ksatria sendirian dari Enam Pahlawan. Waktunya perang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1564_DESCRIPTION
desc: A shadow lurks in the ridge below. This figure clad in jet black armor is perhaps the lone knight the Six Heroes mentioned. It's time for battle.

raw.en: A shadow lurks in the ridge below. This figure clad in jet black armor is perhaps the lone knight the Six Heroes mentioned. It's time for battle.
raw.es: Una sombra acecha la cresta. La figura ataviada con armadura negra es quizá el caballero solitario que los Seis Héroes mencionaron. Es hora de luchar.
raw.id: Bayangan mengintai di bubungan di bawah. Sosok bertameng hitam pekat mungkin adalah ksatria sendirian dari Enam Pahlawan. Waktunya perang.
raw.pt: Há uma sombra na cordilheira abaixo. A figura de armadura negra pode ser o cavaleiro solitário que os Seis Heróis mencionaram. Chegou a hora da batalha.
raw.th: เงาลึกลับที่สันเขาด้านล่าง และแต่งตัวชุดดำนี้ต้องเป็นอัศวินที่หกวีรบุรุษได้กล่าวไว้ ได้เวลาต่อสู้แล้ว
raw.vi: Một bóng đen ẩn nấp ở sườn núi bên dưới. Bóng dáng mặc giáp đen này có lẽ là hiệp sĩ đơn độc trong Sáu Vị Anh Hùng đã nói. Đấy là thời khắc bắt đầu trận chiến.

id: Selagi menuruni tebing curam, setan-setan mengejar. Tinggal sedikit lagi untuk mencapai Kawah Gaia Besar tempat Lucius menanti.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1565_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you make your climb down the steep cliff, demons come after you. Only a little bit more until you reach the Grand Gaia Crater where Lucius awaits.

raw.en: As you make your climb down the steep cliff, demons come after you. Only a little bit more until you reach the Grand Gaia Crater where Lucius awaits.
raw.es: Los demonios te persiguen a medida que desciendes el escarpado acantilado. Falta poco para alcanzar el Cráter de Gran Gaia, donde Lucius aguarda.
raw.id: Selagi menuruni tebing curam, setan-setan mengejar. Tinggal sedikit lagi untuk mencapai Kawah Gaia Besar tempat Lucius menanti.
raw.pt: Enquanto você desce o desfiladeiro, demônios o perseguem. Só mais um pouco até chegar à Cratera de Grand Gaia, onde Lucius aguarda.
raw.th: เมื่อคุณปีนหน้าผาได้สำเร็จ ปีศาจก็โผล่มาทันที มีเวลาไม่มากนักก่อนจะไปยังปล่องภูเขาไฟแห่งแกรนไกอาที่ลูเซียสรอคุณอยู่
raw.vi: Khi ngươi leo xuống vách đá dốc đứng, lũ quỷ sẽ theo dõi ngươi. Chỉ còn một chút để ngươi đến được Miệng Núi Lửa Grand Gaia nơi Lucius đang chờ đợi.

id: Jika saja Lucius mempertimbangkan ulang keputusan untuk menghancurkan manusia, perang akan dapat dihidari... Apa mentalitas ini terlalu idealis?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1566_DESCRIPTION
desc: If only Lucius would reconsider his decision of destroying humanity, a battle could be avoided... Is this mentality perhaps too idealistic?

raw.en: If only Lucius would reconsider his decision of destroying humanity, a battle could be avoided... Is this mentality perhaps too idealistic?
raw.es: Si tan solo Lucius reconsiderara su decisión de destruir a la humanidad, se podría evitar la batalla... ¿Pensar esto será demasiado idealista?
raw.id: Jika saja Lucius mempertimbangkan ulang keputusan untuk menghancurkan manusia, perang akan dapat dihidari... Apa mentalitas ini terlalu idealis?
raw.pt: Se Lucius reconsiderasse a decisão de destruir a humanidade uma batalha poderia ser evitada... Por acaso essa mentalidade é utópica demais?
raw.th: ถ้าเพียงลูเซียสคิดใหม่อีกครั้งเรื่องการทำลายล้างมนาย์ การต่อสู้ครั้งนี้คงไม่เกิด...หรือจิตใจของเขาจะยึดมั่นอุดมการณ์มากเกินไป?
raw.vi: Chỉ khi nào Lucius xem lại quyết định tiêu diệt loài người của mình, trận chiến mới có thể tránh được... Hay tâm lý này có lẽ quá lý tưởng?

id: Perang akhirnya dimulai. Lucius sepertinya tidak berniat mendengarkan manusia. Perkataan Tilith juga mengkhawatirkan...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1570_DESCRIPTION
desc: The battle has finally begun. Lucius seems to have no intentions of listening to humans. Tilith's words are also cause for concern...

raw.en: The battle has finally begun. Lucius seems to have no intentions of listening to humans. Tilith's words are also cause for concern...
raw.es: Finalmente, la batalla ha comenzado. Lucius parece no tener intención de escuchar a los humanos. Las palabras de Tilith son motivo de preocupación...
raw.id: Perang akhirnya dimulai. Lucius sepertinya tidak berniat mendengarkan manusia. Perkataan Tilith juga mengkhawatirkan...
raw.pt: A batalha finalmente começou. Parece que o Lucius não tinha intenção de ouvir os humanos. As palavras de Tilith também são motivo de preocupação...
raw.th: การต่อสู้ได้เริ่มขึ้น ลูเซียสไม่มีทีท่าจะฟังมนุษย์เลย แม้แต่ธิลิท
raw.vi: Trận chiến rốt cuộc đã bắt đầu. Lucius dường như không có ý định lắng nghe con người. Những lời nói của Tilith cũng đang gây lo ngại...

id: Jika Lucius kalah, hanya Tilith yang sanggup mengontrol gerbang. Kau harus memikirkan strategi balasan untuk mengatasi bencana tersegel di dalamnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1571_DESCRIPTION
desc: If Lucius is defeated, only Tilith will be able to control the gate. You must think of a countermeasure to deal with the sealed calamities within.

raw.en: If Lucius is defeated, only Tilith will be able to control the gate. You must think of a countermeasure to deal with the sealed calamities within.
raw.es: Si Lucius cae vencido, solo Tilith será capaz de controlar el portal. Debes idear una estrategia para lidiar con las calamidades que esperan dentro.
raw.id: Jika Lucius kalah, hanya Tilith yang sanggup mengontrol gerbang. Kau harus memikirkan strategi balasan untuk mengatasi bencana tersegel di dalamnya.
raw.pt: Se Lucius for derrotado, somente Tilith poderá controlar o portal. Você precisa pensar em como lidar com as calamidades que estão presas.
raw.th: หากลูเซียสถูกกำจัด ก็จะมีเพียงธิลิทที่สามารถคุมประตูนี้ได้ คุณต้องคิดเรื่องการตอบโต้ที่จะผนึกความชั่วร้ายเอาไว้ข้างใน
raw.vi: Nếu Lucius bị đánh bại, chỉ có Tilith mới có thể điều khiển cánh cửa. Ngươi phải nghĩ ra biện pháp đối phó xử lý hiểm họa đang bị phong ấn bên trong.

id: Kau sudah menang melawan keempat Dewa Sesat. Namun kini kau mengerti bahwa kekuatan Lucius melampaui semua dewa yang pernah kau kalahkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1572_DESCRIPTION
desc: You were victorious against all Four Fallen Gods. However, now you fully understand that Lucius's power surpasses that of any previously defeated god.

raw.en: You were victorious against all Four Fallen Gods. However, now you fully understand that Lucius's power surpasses that of any previously defeated god.
raw.es: Derrotaste a los Cuatro Dioses Caídos. No obstante, ahora entiendes que el poder de Lucius sobrepasa al de todos los dioses derrotados.
raw.id: Kau sudah menang melawan keempat Dewa Sesat. Namun kini kau mengerti bahwa kekuatan Lucius melampaui semua dewa yang pernah kau kalahkan.
raw.pt: Você foi vitorioso contra os Quatro Deuses Caídos. Mas agora você entende totalmente que o poder de Lucius ultrapassa o de qualquer deus já derrotado.
raw.th: คุณคือผู้ชนะจตุรเทพมาร แต่ตอนนี้คุณรู้ซึ้งว่าพลังของลูเซียสนั้นเหนือกว่าเทพมารที่เคยกำจัดมา
raw.vi: Ngươi đã thắng chống lại cả bốn Đọa Lạc Chúa Thần. Tuy nhiên, giờ đây ngươi hoàn toàn hiểu rằng sức mạnh Lucius vượt xa các thần đã đánh bại trước đó.

id: Dewa dan manusia sepertinya berbeda cara pandang. Jika dewa ingin menghancurkan manusia, tidak ada pilihan lain selain menghentikan mereka.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1573_DESCRIPTION
desc: Gods and humans seem to be looking at things quite differently. However, if they mean to destroy humanity, you've no choice but to stop them.

raw.en: Gods and humans seem to be looking at things quite differently. However, if they mean to destroy humanity, you've no choice but to stop them.
raw.es: Los dioses y los humanos ven las cosas de formas muy diferentes. Pero si su intención es destruir a la humanidad, no tienes opción más que detenerlos.
raw.id: Dewa dan manusia sepertinya berbeda cara pandang. Jika dewa ingin menghancurkan manusia, tidak ada pilihan lain selain menghentikan mereka.
raw.pt: Parece que deuses e humanos estão olhando para as coisas de forma diferente. No entanto, se eles querem destruir a humanidade, você não tem escolha a não ser impedir.
raw.th: เทพและมนุษย์ต่างมีมุมมองที่ต่างกัน แต่ถ้านั่นจะหมายถึงการทำลายล้างมนุษย์ คุณก็จำเป็นต้องหยุดยั้งพวกเขา
raw.vi: Các vị thần và con người dường như chú ý đến mọi việc khá khác biệt. Tuy nhiên, nếu họ có ý định tiêu diệt loài người, ngươi chỉ còn cách ngăn họ.

id: Lucius tidak berbicara banyak. Apakah dia menipu semua orang? Atau manusia dengan egois punya harapan tersendiri akan Lucius?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1574_DESCRIPTION
desc: Lucius doesn't speak much. Did he fool everyone? Or did humans selfishly come up with their own expectations of him?

raw.en: Lucius doesn't speak much. Did he fool everyone? Or did humans selfishly come up with their own expectations of him?
raw.es: Lucius no habla mucho. ¿Acaso engañó a todo el mundo? ¿O los humanos crearon expectativas egoístas sobre él?
raw.id: Lucius tidak berbicara banyak. Apakah dia menipu semua orang? Atau manusia dengan egois punya harapan tersendiri akan Lucius?
raw.pt: Lucius não fala muito. Ele enganou a todos? Ou os humanos inventaram suas próprias expectativas com relação a ele?
raw.th: ลูเซียสไม่พูดพร่ำมากนัก หรือเขาจะหลอกทุกคน? หรือเพราะความเห็นแก่ตัวของคนทำให้คาดหวังในตัวเขากัน?
raw.vi: Lucius chẳng hề nói nhiều. Ông đã đánh lừa tất cả mọi người? Hay loài người ích kỷ chỉ nghĩ đến mong đợi của họ về ông?

id: Kau ingin tahu apakah Karl dan yang lain tidak terluka. Mereka pasti bertemu banyak musuh kuat menuju ke sini. Cepat, kau harus mencapai Lucius!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1575_DESCRIPTION
desc: You wonder if Karl and the others are unharmed. They must have crossed many a powerful enemy on the way here. Quickly, you must reach Lucius!

raw.en: You wonder if Karl and the others are unharmed. They must have crossed many a powerful enemy on the way here. Quickly, you must reach Lucius!
raw.es: Te preguntas si Karl y los demás están a salvo. Debieron haber encontrado muchos enemigos poderosos en su camino. ¡Rápido, debes encontrar a Lucius!
raw.id: Kau ingin tahu apakah Karl dan yang lain tidak terluka. Mereka pasti bertemu banyak musuh kuat menuju ke sini. Cepat, kau harus mencapai Lucius!
raw.pt: Você se pergunta se Karl e os outros estão bem. Eles devem ter passado por muitos inimigos poderosos para chegar aqui. Rápido, você precisa chegar ao Lucius!
raw.th: คุณสงสัยว่าพวกคาร์ลจะปลอดภัยหรือไม่ พวกเขาต้องผ่านศัตรูมามากมายก่อนจะมาถึงที่นี่ ดังนั้นคุณต้องรีบกำจัดลูเซียสโดยเร็ว!
raw.vi: Ngươi tự hỏi nếu Karl và người khác đều không hề hấn gì. Chắc họ đã vượt qua nhiều kẻ thù mạnh trên đường tới đây. Nhanh, ngươi phải gặp Lucius!

id: Kawah Gaia Besar... Inikah tempat banyak bencana tersegel? Tidak ada waktu untuk melamun sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1576_DESCRIPTION
desc: Grand Gaia's Crater... Is this the place where countless calamities lie sealed within? No, now is not the time for distractions.

raw.en: Grand Gaia's Crater... Is this the place where countless calamities lie sealed within? No, now is not the time for distractions.
raw.es: El Cráter de Gran Gaia... ¿Será este el lugar donde yacen incontables calamidades? No, ahora no es momento para distracciones.
raw.id: Kawah Gaia Besar... Inikah tempat banyak bencana tersegel? Tidak ada waktu untuk melamun sekarang.
raw.pt: Cratera de Grand Gaia... Este é o lugar onde incontáveis calamidades estão presas? Não, agora não é hora para distrações.
raw.th: ที่ปล่องภูเขาไฟแกรนไกอาเต็มไปด้วยความชั่วร้ายที่กักเก็บอยู่ด้านใน? แต่ตอนนี้ไม่มีเวลาจะลังเลแล้ว
raw.vi: Miệng Núi Lửa Grand Gaia... Đây có phải là nơi vô số hiểm họa bị phong ấn bên trong? Không, giờ không phải lúc kiếm chuyện.

id: Tilith telah memimpinmu ke sini. Itu kehendak Lucius. Namun kini kau harus melawan dengan kehendakmu sendiri!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1577_DESCRIPTION
desc: Tilith has led you all the way here. That was Lucius's will. However, now you must fight with your own will in mind!

raw.en: Tilith has led you all the way here. That was Lucius's will. However, now you must fight with your own will in mind!
raw.es: Tilith te ha guiado hasta aquí. Esa fue la voluntad de Lucius. No obstante, ¡es momento de pelear por tu propia voluntad!
raw.id: Tilith telah memimpinmu ke sini. Itu kehendak Lucius. Namun kini kau harus melawan dengan kehendakmu sendiri!
raw.pt: Tilith o trouxe até aqui. Era a vontade de Lucius. No entanto, agora você precisa lutar pensando na sua própria vontade!
raw.th: ที่ธิลิทนำคุณมาที่นี่นั้นเป็นความต้องการของลูเซียส อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณต้องต่อสู้ด้วยความมุ่งมั่นในตัวคุณเอง!
raw.vi: Tilith đã dẫn tất cả các ngươi đến đây. Đó là ý muốn của Lucius. Tuy nhiên, giờ đây ngươi phải chiến đấu bằng chính ý chí của ngươi!

id: Kau telah mencapai sejauh ini di wilayah yang disegel para dewa. Yang ada di dalamnya adalah hasil eksperimen yang menyinggung keilahian mereka.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_1580_DESCRIPTION
desc: You have reached the depths of this territory sealed by the gods. Within it lies the results of an experiment that offends their divinity...

raw.en: You have reached the depths of this territory sealed by the gods. Within it lies the results of an experiment that offends their divinity...
raw.es: Has llegado a las profundidades de este territorio protegido por los dioses. Dentro, yacen los resultados de un experimento que ofende su divinidad...
raw.id: Kau telah mencapai sejauh ini di wilayah yang disegel para dewa. Yang ada di dalamnya adalah hasil eksperimen yang menyinggung keilahian mereka.
raw.pt: Você chega às profundezas deste território isolado pelos deuses. Dentro estão os resultados de uma experiência que ofende a divindade deles...
raw.th: คุณได้มาถึงส่วนลึกของดินแดนนี้ที่ถูกผนึกโดยเทพเจ้า ภายในนั้นมีผลลัพท์ของการทดลองที่ลบหลู่ความเป็นเทพของพวกนั้นหลับไหลอยู่...
raw.vi: Ngươi đã đến nơi sâu thẳm của lãnh địa này đang bị các vị thần phong ấn. Nơi đó chứa kết quả của một thí nghiệm xúc phạm thần thánh...

id: Tanah suci dari mana semua makhluk berasal. Rasakan Karma yang memenuhinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100000_DESCRIPTION
desc: The sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up some of the overflowing Karma.

raw.en: The sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up some of the overflowing Karma.
raw.es: En este lugar sagrado nacen todos los seres vivos... ¡Empápate del karma que emana de él!
raw.id: Tanah suci dari mana semua makhluk berasal. Rasakan Karma yang memenuhinya.
raw.pt: A terra sagrada de onde todos os seres vivos saem. Absorva um pouco do karma abundante.
raw.th: พื้นดินศักดิ์สิทธิ์จากทุกชีวิตถือกำเนิดขึ้น ดื่มด่ำกับบางส่วนของคาม่าที่พรั่งพรูออกมา
raw.vi: Các vùng đất linh thiêng mà từ đó tất cả các sinh vật được sinh ra. Hãy ngâm mình vào dòng suối Karma đang chảy

id: Lebih jauh di dalam tanah suci dar mana semua makhluk berasal. Rasakan lebih lagi Karma yang memenuhinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Further within the sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up even more of the overflowing Karma.

raw.en: Further within the sacred grounds from which all living beings originate. Soak up even more of the overflowing Karma.
raw.es: Adéntrate aún más en el lugar sagrado donde nacen todos los seres vivos... ¡Empápate de aún más karma!
raw.id: Lebih jauh di dalam tanah suci dar mana semua makhluk berasal. Rasakan lebih lagi Karma yang memenuhinya.
raw.pt: Mais a fundo na terra sagrada de onde todos os seres vivos saem. Absorva mais ainda do karma em abundância.

raw.vi: Xa hơn nữa nhưng trong phạm vi các vùng đất linh thiêng mà từ đó tất cả các sinh vật được sinh ra. Hãy ngâm mình nhiều hơn nữa vào dòng suối Karma đang chảy

id: Daerah tersembunyi di suaka yang menjaga semua makhluk hidup. Sekarang kesempatanmu untuk mendapatkan Karma lebih dari yang kamu impikan!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100002_DESCRIPTION
desc: A hidden domain in the sanctuary that watches over all living things. Now's your chance to get more Karma than you could ever imagine!

raw.en: A hidden domain in the sanctuary that watches over all living things. Now's your chance to get more Karma than you could ever imagine!
raw.es: Un oculto dominio en el santuario cuida de todos los seres vivos. ¡Esta es tu oportunidad de obtener más Karma del que jamás imaginaste!
raw.id: Daerah tersembunyi di suaka yang menjaga semua makhluk hidup. Sekarang kesempatanmu untuk mendapatkan Karma lebih dari yang kamu impikan!
raw.pt: Um domínio escondido no santuário que observa tudo o que é vivo. Agora é sua chance de conseguir mais Karma do que pode imaginar!
raw.th: อาณาเขตซึ่งถูกซ่อนอยู่ในสถานที่ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ที่คุ้มครองสิ่งมีชีวิตทั้งหมด ตอนนี้เป็นโอกาศของคุณที่จะได้รับคาม่ามากกว่าที่คุณเคยวาดฝันเอาไว้!
raw.vi: Một chỗ ẩn kín trong khu bảo tồn luôn theo dõi mọi sinh vật sống. Bây giờ là cơ hội của ngươi để lấy thêm nhiều Karma hơn cả những gì ngươi có thể tưởng tượng!

id: Katanya ini tempat jiwa diperkuat. Inilah kesempatanmu untuk mendapatkan pengalaman sebagai Pemanggil dan juga Karma.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100050_DESCRIPTION

raw.vi: Một lần một tuần, các nữ thần Nymphs, Spirits và Idols lại gặp mặt nhau. Sử dụng cơ hội này để lấy một số Chất liệu tạo ra sự tiến hóa của muôn loài.

id: Katanya mereka yang bercita rasa tinggi mengadakan pesta untuk pamer panci favorit mereka. Katanya panci-panci ini adalah bahan evolusi yang langka...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100103_DESCRIPTION
desc: It is said that those with good taste hold lavish parties to display their favorite pots. It is rumored that these pots are also very rare evolution materials...

raw.en: It is said that those with good taste hold lavish parties to display their favorite pots. It is rumored that these pots are also very rare evolution materials...
raw.es: Se dice que aquellos con buen gusto organizan fiestas generosas para mostrar sus potes favoritos. Dicen que esos potes también son materiales para evolución muy raros...

raw.pt: Dizem que aqueles com bom gosto fazem festas luxuosas para exibir seus vasos preferidos. Há rumores de que esses vasos também sejam materiais de evolução raros...
raw.th: ว่ากันว่าผู้ที่มีรสนิยมดีจัดงานเลี้ยงฟุ่มเฟือยเพื่อแสดงไหใบโปรดของพวกเขา ลือกันว่าไหเหล่านี้ยังเป็นวัตถุดิบของการวิวัฒนาการที่หายากมาก ...
raw.vi: Người ta nói rằng những kẻ có khiếu thẩm mỹ thường dùng các thứ xa hoa để thể hiện những cái bình ưa thích của họ. Nghe đồn rằng các bình này cũng làm từ những loại vật liệu tiến hóa cực hiếm...

id: Gua berbahaya penuh jebakan untuk menjerat yang berani masuk. Meski berbahaya, banyak yang masih masuk demi harta karun.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100200_DESCRIPTION
desc: A dangerous cave full of traps to ensnare those who dare enter. Despite its dangers, many still venture after its treasures.

raw.en: A dangerous cave full of traps to ensnare those who dare enter. Despite its dangers, many still venture after its treasures.
raw.es: Una peligrosa cueva llena de astutas trampas. Pese al peligro, muchos se aventuran a su interior en busca de riquezas.
raw.id: Gua berbahaya penuh jebakan untuk menjerat yang berani masuk. Meski berbahaya, banyak yang masih masuk demi harta karun.
raw.pt: Uma caverna cheia de armadilhas para pegar quem ousar entrar. Apesar dos perigos, muitos ainda se aventuram em busca dos tesouros dela.
raw.th: ถ้ำอันตราย ที่เต็มไปด้วยกับดักที่จะจับกุมผู้บุกรุก แม้จะมีอันตราย แต่หลายคนก็ยังออกเดินทางมาเพื่อทรัพย์สมบัติ
raw.vi: Một chiếc hang nguy hiểm đầy cạm bẫy luôn cài những ai dám đi vào trong. Bất chấp sự nguy hiểm của nó, nhiều người vẫn mạo hiểm vào để tìm kho báu.

id: Semakin dalam memasuki gua bahaya penuh jebakan. Gunung harta karun atau lautan putus asa, siapa yang tahu apa yang menunggu!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100201_DESCRIPTION
desc: Further into the dangerous, trap-filled cave. Mountains of treasure or oceans of despair, who knows what awaits!

raw.en: Further into the dangerous, trap-filled cave. Mountains of treasure or oceans of despair, who knows what awaits!
raw.es: En las profundidades de esta cueva plagada de trampas, montones de tesoros esperan a quien ose entrar. Eso, o un destino aciago.
raw.id: Semakin dalam memasuki gua bahaya penuh jebakan. Gunung harta karun atau lautan putus asa, siapa yang tahu apa yang menunggu!
raw.pt: Mais a fundo na caverna perigosa e cheia de armadilhas. Montanhas de tesouros ou mares de sofrimento, não dá para saber o que espera!
raw.th: ต่อไปเป็นถ้ำอันตราย ที่เต็มไปด้วยกับดัก ภูเขาแห่งสมบัติ หรือมหาสมุทรแห่งความสิ้นหวัง ใครจะรู้ว่าอะไรรอคอยอยู่!
raw.vi: Đi sâu vào trong hang nguy hiểm đầy cạm bẫy đó, bạn sẽ nhìn các ngọn núi chứa kho báu hoặc một vùng biển không có gì. Ai biết được điều gì đang đợi mình phía trước

id: Banyak rahasia di gua yang penuh jebakan ini. Apa kamu takut terkurung dalam keputusasaan, atau berharap untuk menemukan kekayaan!?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100202_DESCRIPTION
desc: There are many secrets in this trap-filled cave. Do you fear getting trapped in despair, or are you hopeful to find riches!?

raw.en: There are many secrets in this trap-filled cave. Do you fear getting trapped in despair, or are you hopeful to find riches!?
raw.es: Esta cueva repleta de trampas guarda muchos secretos. ¿Sientes miedo de ser capturado o esperas encontrar riquezas?
raw.id: Banyak rahasia di gua yang penuh jebakan ini. Apa kamu takut terkurung dalam keputusasaan, atau berharap untuk menemukan kekayaan!?
raw.pt: Há muitos segredos nesta caverna cheia de armadilhas. Você tem medo de ficar preso no sofrimento ou esperança de encontrar riquezas?
raw.th: มันมีความลับมากมายในถ้ำที่เต็มไปด้วยกับดัก คุณกลัวที่จะถูกดักอยู่ในความสิ้นหวังหรือไม่ หรือคุณเชื่อมั่นว่าจะพบความร่ำรวย?
raw.vi: Có rất nhiều bí mật trong chiếc hang đầy cạm bẫy này. Ngươi có sợ mắc kẹt trong tuyệt vọng, hay ngươi vẫn hy vọng tìm thấy sự giàu có?

id: Hidup di antara bayangan, harga dirinya sebagai ninja menjamin kontak minimal dengan orang lain. Beberapa susah ditaklukkan.

desc: Living among the shadows, his pride as a ninja warrants him little contact with others. Few are harder to pin down than he.

raw.en: Living among the shadows, his pride as a ninja warrants him little contact with others. Few are harder to pin down than he.
raw.es: Este ninja que vive al amparo de las sombras rehúye el contacto con los demás. Dar con él es prácticamente imposible.

raw.th: อาศัยอยู่ท่ามกลางเงามืด ความภาคภูมิใจในฐานะนินจาของเขา ทำให้ไม่ค่อยยอมติดต่อกับคนอื่น ๆ มีน้อยคนที่จะตามหาตัวได้ยากกว่าเขา

id: Bertindak pada malam hari, tidak ada yang tak bisa diraihnya. Siapa yang tahu bagaimana cara menangkapnya.

desc: Acting under the cover of night, there's no objective he can't achieve. Who knows what it'd take to capture such a man.

raw.en: Acting under the cover of night, there's no objective he can't achieve. Who knows what it'd take to capture such a man.
raw.es: Al amparo de las sombras, no hay objetivo que se le resista. ¿Quién podrá derrotar a tan formidable enemigo?

raw.pt: Agindo sob o manto da noite, não há objetivo que ele não alcance. Quem sabe o que seria necessário para capturar tal homem.

raw.vi: Hành động trong màn đêm sẽ gúp anh ta đạt được mọi mục tiêu mà mình muốn. Ai biết làm thế nào để bắt được người đàn ông này.

id: Diselimuti oleh kegelapan yang merah membara, hanya yang paling kuat bisa menggoda orang ini, yang latihannya membersihkannya dari semua keinginan.

raw.es: Una abrasadora oscuridad lo protege. Solo los más valientes logran incitar a la lucha a este hombre desprovisto de sentimientos.

raw.th: ปกคลุมในความมืดสีแดงแผดเผา มีเพียงผู้ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุด อาจจะปลุกเร้าชายคนนี้ ผู้ได้รับการฝึกเพื่อกำจัดทุกแรงปรารถนาทิ้งไปจนหมด
raw.vi: Được bao bọc bởi màn đêm màu đỏ, chỉ những ai mạnh nhất mới có thể khuấy đảo được người đàn ông này, trình độ của người đó sẽ đánh tan mọi ý đồ của người đàn ông đó.

id: Pria yang jiwanya penuh kegelapan dan menguasai disiplin sepenuhnya. Untuk melihat kilau merah di bayangan dianggap kematian pasti seseorang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100803_DESCRIPTION
desc: A man whose soul that is one with the darkness and mastered total discipline within. To see a red glow in the shadows would deem one's certain death.

raw.en: A man whose soul that is one with the darkness and mastered total discipline within. To see a red glow in the shadows would deem one's certain death.
raw.es: Un hombre cuya alma está ligada a la oscuridad y que ha alcanzado un nivel máximo de disciplina. Ver un destello rojizo en las sombras es sinónimo de una muerte segura.
raw.id: Pria yang jiwanya penuh kegelapan dan menguasai disiplin sepenuhnya. Untuk melihat kilau merah di bayangan dianggap kematian pasti seseorang.
raw.pt: Um homem que tem a alma unida com a escuridão e que dominou totalmente a disciplina dentro de si. Ver um brilho vermelho em meio às sombras era uma sentença de morte.
raw.th: ชายผู้มีจิตวิญญาณเป็นหนึ่งเดียวกับความมืดและสำเร็จการฝึกฝนทั้งหมดภายใน ถ้าใครได้เห็นสีแดงเรืองในเงามืดนั่นย่อมหมายถึงความตาย
raw.vi: Một người đàn ông có linh hồn hắc ám và bị thần phục hoàn toàn bởi giới luật bên trong. Thấy một quầng sáng đỏ trong bóng tối cũng giống như là tử thần tuyệt mạng của người đó.

id: Berontak terhadap warisannya sebagai ahli besi dalam masa mudanya, akan butuh lebih dari kemauan kuat untuk menjadikan orang ini sekutu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100900_DESCRIPTION
desc: Rebelling against his heritage as a blacksmith in his younger days, it'd take a lot more than strong wits to gain this man's allegiance.

raw.en: Rebelling against his heritage as a blacksmith in his younger days, it'd take a lot more than strong wits to gain this man's allegiance.
raw.es: En su juventud renegó de sus raíces de herrero, así que deberás usar algo más que ingenio para lograr que se alíe contigo.
raw.id: Berontak terhadap warisannya sebagai ahli besi dalam masa mudanya, akan butuh lebih dari kemauan kuat untuk menjadikan orang ini sekutu.
raw.pt: Se rebelando contra sua herança como ferreiro em sua juventude, é preciso muito mais do que uma inteligência afiada para ganhar a fidelidade deste homem.
raw.th: ต่อต้านการสืบทอดการเป็นช่างตีเหล็กในช่วงวัยเยาว์ มันต้องใช้มากกว่าปัญญาที่แข็งแกร่ง เพื่อจะได้รับความจงรักภักดีของผู้ชายคนนี้
raw.vi: Cuộc nổi loạn chống lại nhà thờ của người thợ rèn đó đã chứng minh mạnh mẽ cho lòng trung thành của người đàn ông này.

id: Menciptakan jalannya sendiri sebagai pandai besi, ia mengakui kekuatan mentah yang dimiliki orang lain.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100901_DESCRIPTION
desc: Creating his own path as a blacksmith, he has come to acknowledge the raw strength that others possess.

raw.en: Creating his own path as a blacksmith, he has come to acknowledge the raw strength that others possess.
raw.es: Se ha labrado su fama como herrero y es capaz de reconocer la fuerza en estado puro que otros poseen.
raw.id: Menciptakan jalannya sendiri sebagai pandai besi, ia mengakui kekuatan mentah yang dimiliki orang lain.
raw.pt: Criando seu próprio caminho como ferreiro, ele passou a reconhecer a força bruta que os outros possuem.
raw.th: เขาสร้างเส้นทางของตัวเองเพื่อเป็นช่างตีเหล็ก ในที่สุดเขาก็ได้รู้ถึงพลังดิบที่ผู้อื่นครอบครอง
raw.vi: Tạo ra con đường riêng cho mình như là một thợ rèn, anh ta phải thừa nhận những điểm mạnh mà người khác có.

id: Dia segera dikenal sebagai Dewa Besi, meski kekuatannya hanya ditunjukkan kepada orang tertentu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100902_DESCRIPTION
desc: He soon came to be known as the God Arm, though this power he only showed to those he deemed worthy.

raw.en: He soon came to be known as the God Arm, though this power he only showed to those he deemed worthy.
raw.es: Su fama pronto le valió el sobrenombre de ejecutor divino. Solo revela su poder ante quienes considera merecedores de ello.
raw.id: Dia segera dikenal sebagai Dewa Besi, meski kekuatannya hanya ditunjukkan kepada orang tertentu.
raw.pt: Ele logo se tornou conhecido como o Braço Divino, um poder que ele só mostrava aos que julgava merecedores.
raw.th: ไม่นานเขาก็เป็นที่รู้จักกันในนามของแขนพระเจ้า อย่างไรก็ดีเขาจะแสดงพลังนี้ให้กับผู้ที่คู่ควรได้เห็นเท่านั้น
raw.vi: Anh ta bỗng được biết tới như là Cánh tay của Chúa trời mặc dù anh ta chỉ thể hiện sức mạnh khi cần thiết.

id: Lord Tukang, orang-orang memanggilnya. Ia membuat senjata ampuh untuk melawan invasi para dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100903_DESCRIPTION
desc: Smith Lord, people called him. For he forged an almighty weapon to fight against the gods' invasion.

raw.en: Smith Lord, people called him. For he forged an almighty weapon to fight against the gods' invasion.
raw.es: La gente solía llamarlo Señor Herrero. Fue él quien forjó un arma todopoderosa para luchar contra la invasión de los dioses.
raw.id: Lord Tukang, orang-orang memanggilnya. Ia membuat senjata ampuh untuk melawan invasi para dewa.
raw.pt: As pessoas o chamavam de Lorde Artesão. Pois ele forjou uma arma onipotente para combater a invasão dos deuses.
raw.th: ผู้คนเรียกเขาว่า จ้าวแห่งช่างตีเหล็ก เพราะว่าเขาได้สร้างอาวุธทรงพลังเพื่อใช้รับมือกับการรุกรานของเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Chúa tể Smith, mọi người đã gọi ông như vậy. Bởi ông đã rèn được một thứ vũ khí toàn năng để chiến đấu chống lại cuộc xâm lược của các vị thần.

id: Bajak laut sebrutal kecantikannya. Banyak yang telah mencoba, dan gagak, untuk mencairkan hati esnya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_101000_DESCRIPTION
desc: A pirate as brutal as she is beautiful. Many have tried, and failed, to thaw her impenetrable icy heart...

raw.en: A pirate as brutal as she is beautiful. Many have tried, and failed, to thaw her impenetrable icy heart...
raw.es: Una pirata tan letal como bella. Muchos han intentado conquistar su frío corazón, pero ninguno lo ha logrado...
raw.id: Bajak laut sebrutal kecantikannya. Banyak yang telah mencoba, dan gagak, untuk mencairkan hati esnya.
raw.pt: Uma pirata tão brutal quanto bela. Muitos tentaram derreter o coração impenetrável dela mas falharam...
raw.th: โจรสลัดที่ทั้งโหดร้ายและทั้งสวยงาม หลายคนได้พยายาม และก็ล้มเหลวที่จะละลายหัวใจน้ำแข็งของเธอ...
raw.vi: Một nữ cướp biển hung bạo nhưng có sắc đẹp. Nhiều người đã thử và thất bại trước trái tim băng giá của cô ta.

id: Sifat ganas dan dinginnya terkenal di seluruh lautan. Konon bahkan Raja Laut tidak bisa mengubah penampilannya yang dingin.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_101001_DESCRIPTION
desc: Her ferocity and coldness of character are notorious throughout the seas. Rumor has it that even the Sea King was unable to dent her frosty exterior.

raw.en: Her ferocity and coldness of character are notorious throughout the seas. Rumor has it that even the Sea King was unable to dent her frosty exterior.
raw.es: Su crueldad y frialdad son famosas en todos los mares. Cuentan que ni el dios de los mares pudo romper su gélida coraza.
raw.id: Sifat ganas dan dinginnya terkenal di seluruh lautan. Konon bahkan Raja Laut tidak bisa mengubah penampilannya yang dingin.
raw.pt: A ferocidade e a frieza de caráter dela são notórios além dos oceanos. Dizem que nem o Rei do Oceano foi capaz de abalar o exterior congelado dela.
raw.th: ความรุนแรงและความเย็นชาของบุคคลิกเธอ เป็นที่รู้จักไปทั่วทั้งท้องทะเล มีข่าวลือว่าแม้แต่ราชันย์แห่งท้องทะเล ยังไม่กล้าแม้แต่จะแหยมกับเธอ
raw.vi: Tính hung dữ và lạnh lùng của cô ta đã nổi tiếng khắp các vùng biển. Người ta đồn rằng thậm chí cả Vua Biển cũng không có khả năng đánh bại vẻ ngoài lạnh lùng của cô ta

id: Serangan dan ejekannya membekukan hati dari musuh dan sekutunya. Kapten dari armada bajak laut yang besar, dia hanya punya waktu untuk orang yang paling kuat.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_101002_DESCRIPTION
desc: Her attacks and insults freeze the hearts of both enemies and allies alike. Captain of a huge fleet of pirate ships, she has no time for any but the strongest of individuals.

raw.en: Her attacks and insults freeze the hearts of both enemies and allies alike. Captain of a huge fleet of pirate ships, she has no time for any but the strongest of individuals.
raw.es: Sus ataques e insultos penetran en el corazón tanto de sus aliados como de sus rivales. Esta capitana de flota pirata solo se enfrentará a los oponentes más duros.
raw.id: Serangan dan ejekannya membekukan hati dari musuh dan sekutunya. Kapten dari armada bajak laut yang besar, dia hanya punya waktu untuk orang yang paling kuat.
raw.pt: Os ataques e insultos dela congelam os corações tanto de inimigos quanto de aliados. Comandante de uma frota enorme de navios, ela não tem tempo para ninguém mais do que os mais fortes.
raw.th: การโจมตีและคำดูถูกของเธอตรึงใจทั้งศัตรูและเพื่อนร่วมทีม  กัปตันของฝูงเรือโจรสลัดขนาดมหึมา เธอไม่สนใจใครนอกจากผู้ที่แข็งแกร่งที่สุด
raw.vi: Những cuộc tấn công của cô ta đã làm tê cứng mọi trái tim của kẻ thù và đồng bọn. Là thuyền trưởng của các tàu cướp biển lớn, cô ta không có thời gian cho bất cứ công việc cá nhân nào.

id: Es terbentuk di tanah yang diinjaknya, badai salju ganas dan topan es membelah musuhnya. Kemarahan bekunya menantang para dewa.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_101003_DESCRIPTION
desc: Frost forms on the ground she treads, fierce gales and icy blizzards tear through her foes. Her frozen wrath challenging the gods.

raw.en: Frost forms on the ground she treads, fierce gales and icy blizzards tear through her foes. Her frozen wrath challenging the gods.
raw.es: Donde camina deja escarcha y los fieros vendavales y gélidos granizos despedazan a sus enemigos. Su ira helada desafía a los dioses.
raw.id: Es terbentuk di tanah yang diinjaknya, badai salju ganas dan topan es membelah musuhnya. Kemarahan bekunya menantang para dewa.
raw.pt: O gelo se forma no chão em que ela pisa; fortes ventanias e gélidas nevascas dilaceram seus inimigos. Sua ira gélida desafiava os deuses.
raw.th: น้ำแข็งก่อตัวขึ้นบนพื้นที่เธอย่ำ ลมแรงและพายุน้ำแข็งเฉือนผ่านศัตรูของเธอ น้ำแข็งของเธอกราดเกรี้ยวท้าทายเทพเจ้า
raw.vi: Sương giá đọng lại trên mặt đất theo từng bước chân nàng, những cơn gió giật mãnh liệt cùng các trận bão tuyết băng giá gào rú quanh những kẻ thù của nàng. Cơn thịnh nộ băng giá của nàng đang thách thức các vị thần.

id: Petinju yang memulai perjalanan epik untuk menemukan asal-usulnya. Tinjunya membabakbelurkan siapa pun yang berani mendekatinya.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_101100_DESCRIPTION
desc: A boxer who set out on an epic journey to discover her origins. Her fists make mincemeat out of any who dare to approach her.

raw.en: A boxer who set out on an epic journey to discover her origins. Her fists make mincemeat out of any who dare to approach her.
raw.es: Una boxeadora que partió en un viaje épico para descubrir sus orígenes. Sus puños pueden hacer picadillo a cualquiera que se acerque.
raw.id: Petinju yang memulai perjalanan epik untuk menemukan asal-usulnya. Tinjunya membabakbelurkan siapa pun yang berani mendekatinya.
raw.pt: Uma pugilista que partiu em uma épica jornada para descobrir suas origens. Seus punhos acabam com qualquer um que se aproximar.
raw.th: จอมยุทธสาวผู้ออกเดินทางครั้งยิ่งใหญ่ เพื่อค้นหาต้นกำเนิดของเธอ กำปั้นของเธอทำให้ใครก็ตามที่กล้าหือ กลายเป็นเนื้อบด
raw.vi: Một nữ võ sĩ quyền anh đã quyết định đi tìm nguồn gốc của mình. Cú đấm đầu tiên của cô ta có thể làm tan xương nát thịt của bất cứ ai dám tiến gần tới cô ta.
